    const timer = {
      timeout: function(fn2, ms) {
        try {
          if (_timerRaw && typeof _timerRaw.timeout === "function") return _timerRaw.timeout(fn2, ms);
          if (_timerRaw && typeof _timerRaw.setTimeout === "function") return _timerRaw.setTimeout(fn2, ms);
          return setTimeout(fn2, ms);

            return setTimeout(fn2, ms);
          } catch (e22) {
            return null;
          }
        }
      },
      setTimeout: function(fn2, ms) {
        return timer.timeout(fn2, ms);
      },
      // #1220：宿主那支 timer 服务本来就有 interval，但客户端这片包装从前只转发 timeout/setTimeout，
      //   于是 src/refresh/rooms/client/refresh-timer.js 那条 5 秒节拍判「没有 interval 出口」直接不排，
      //   #891 的「初始化完成后自动重算」因此从没跑过（真机 probe.loop 全是 reason=no-timer）。
      //   与 timeout 同一条降级链：宿主有 interval 就用宿主的，没有就退回页面自己的 setInterval。
      interval: function(fn2, ms) {
        try {
          if (_timerRaw && typeof _timerRaw.interval === "function") return _timerRaw.interval(fn2, ms);
          return setInterval(fn2, ms);
        } catch (e3) {
          try {
            return setInterval(fn2, ms);
          } catch (e22) {
            return null;
          }
        }
      },
      // 撤销一支计时器句柄。宿主那支服务（cordis 的 timer）交回的是**一支可调用的撤销器函数**，
      //   对它调全局 clearTimeout 不报错、也撤不掉（#1115 实测）；装了 dispose 的对象与页面自己的
      //   数字句柄又各是另一档，所以按形状分三档，顺序不能反：先认显式 dispose，再才是调用句柄本身。
      //   这一套判断与 src/refresh/contract/host-timer-ports.ts 的 cancelHostTimer 是同一份约定 ——
      //   客户端这片是拼进 src/client/index.ts 的叶子（构建剥行首 export 直接拼文本），不能用 import
      //   引那份共享源码，所以这里照抄一份；改一处要同时改另一处，两边都有门禁钉着。
      clearTimeout: function(id) {
        try {
          if (id && typeof id.dispose === "function") {
            id.dispose();
            return;
          }
          if (typeof id === "function") {
            id();
            return;
          }
          if (id !== void 0 && id !== null) clearTimeout(id);
        } catch (e3) {
        }
      }

    const vcSetTheme = function(theme) {
      try {
        const root = typeof document !== "undefined" ? document.querySelector("[data-vc-root]") : null;
        if (!root) return theme;
        if (theme === "dark" || theme === "light") root.setAttribute("data-vc-theme", theme);
        else root.removeAttribute("data-vc-theme");
        return theme;
      } catch (e3) {
        return theme;
      }
    };

    function utf8Bytes(str) {

    function truncateTitleUtf8(prefix, title, maxBytes) {
      const sep = " ";
      const base = prefix + sep;
      const baseBytes = utf8Bytes(base);
      if (utf8Bytes(title) + baseBytes <= maxBytes) return title;
      const ellipsis = "…";
      const ellipsisBytes = utf8Bytes(ellipsis);
      let acc = 0;
      let out = "";
      for (const ch of title) {
        const b3 = utf8Bytes(ch);
        if (baseBytes + acc + b3 + ellipsisBytes > maxBytes) break;
        acc += b3;
        out += ch;
      }
      return out.trimEnd() + ellipsis;
    }

Please advance this map with the wayfinder skill.

## Start
- [ ] Treat claimable issues as whatever you read back one by one: read each open sub-issue's assignee and which issues block it, work the frontier out yourself by the skill's definition, then read the candidate issue's body.

- [ ] If no issue is claimable, say why and stop; if what remains is still only fog but you can turn it into an issue, create the issue, write down which issues block it, then stop.

## Advancing
- [ ] The skill takes the first claimable issue in order; this time order them by how many downstream issues each unlocks, breaking ties by issue number.
- [ ] When you need me to decide something, put the options, their costs and your recommendation in that issue's comments, and repeat them in your reply; then stop and wait.

## Closing issues
- [ ] Record the conclusion in the issue first: decisions go in the issue's resolution comment; research findings go in a new note under research/. Before writing back to the map's Decisions so far, re-read the body (another session may have just changed it), and append only one line: "issue title (link): conclusion".
- [ ] If the write-back is rejected (the tool says the body changed), re-read the latest body, merge your line into it, and write again, keeping what others just wrote.
- [ ] After writing, read it back and check four things: the question in the issue is answered directly; the conclusion is verifiable (file path, command output, or observed result); the issues that should exist have been created and say which issues block them; and Not yet specified has been updated for what this session found (graduated items removed, new fog added). Close the issue only when all four hold.

      function parseEventEntry(name, value) {

      return out;
    }
    function judgeStage(s3) {
      if (s3.repo.bare) return decide("block", ["bare-repo"]);
      if (s3.unstagedCount === 0) return decide("block", ["nothing-to-stage"]);
      const mid = midReasons(s3);
      if (mid.length > 0) return decide("warn", mid);
      return decide("allow", ["ok"]);
    }
    function judgeCommit(s3) {
      if (s3.repo.bare) return decide("block", ["bare-repo"]);
      if (s3.conflictCount > 0) return decide("block", ["conflicts-unresolved"]);
      if (s3.stagedCount === 0) return decide("block", ["nothing-staged"]);
      const mid = midReasons(s3);
      if (s3.identity.detached) return decide("warn", ["detached-head", ...mid]);
      if (mid.length > 0) return decide("warn", mid);
      return decide("allow", ["ok"]);
    }
    function judgePull(s3) {
      if (s3.repo.bare) return decide("block", ["bare-repo"]);
      if (s3.identity.detached) return decide("block", ["detached-head"]);
      if (s3.identity.sync === "no-upstream") return decide("block", ["no-upstream"]);
      if (s3.identity.sync === "upstream-gone") return decide("block", ["upstream-gone"]);
      if (s3.conflictCount > 0) return decide("block", ["conflicts-unresolved"]);
      const mid = midReasons(s3);
      if (mid.length > 0) return decide("block", mid);
      if (s3.stagedCount > 0 || s3.unstagedCount > 0) return decide("warn", ["dirty-tree"]);
      if (s3.identity.basisMs === null) return decide("warn", ["basis-unknown"]);
      return decide("allow", ["ok"]);
    }
    function judgePush(s3) {
      if (s3.repo.bare) return decide("block", ["bare-repo"]);
      if (s3.identity.detached) return decide("block", ["detached-head"]);
      if (s3.identity.sync === "no-upstream") return decide("block", ["no-upstream"]);
      if (s3.identity.sync === "upstream-gone") return decide("block", ["upstream-gone"]);
      if (s3.conflictCount > 0) return decide("block", ["conflicts-unresolved"]);
      const mid = midReasons(s3);
      if (mid.length > 0) return decide("block", mid);
      if (s3.identity.behind > 0) return decide("block", ["behind-remote"]);
      if (s3.identity.basisMs === null) return decide("warn", ["basis-unknown"]);
      return decide("allow", ["ok"]);
    }
    function judgeFetch(s3) {
      if (s3.repo.bare) return decide("block", ["bare-repo"]);
      return decide("allow", ["ok"]);
    }
    function judge(screen, op) {
      switch (op) {
        case "stage":
          return judgeStage(screen);
        case "commit":
          return judgeCommit(screen);
        case "pull":
          return judgePull(screen);
        case "push":
          return judgePush(screen);
        case "fetch":
          return judgeFetch(screen);
        default:
          return decide("block", ["unknown-operation"]);
      }
    }
    const RULES_SOURCE = "src/shared/version-control/src/rules.ts";
    const VC_COMMIT_MODES = ["staged", "all", "amend", "fixup", "squash"];
    const VC_COMMIT_MODE_KEYS = {
      staged: "vc.commit.mode.staged",
      all: "vc.commit.mode.all",
      amend: "vc.commit.mode.amend",
      fixup: "vc.commit.mode.fixup",
      squash: "vc.commit.mode.squash"
    };
    const VC_COMMIT_MODE_CAPS = {
      staged: "2.1",
      all: "2.2",
      amend: "2.3",
      fixup: "2.4",
      squash: "2.4"
    };
    const COMMIT_TARGET_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9._/@^~-]{1,120}$/;
    function commitPlanDefault() {
      return { mode: "staged", target: "", skipHooks: false, sign: false, signoff: false };
    }
    function commitPlanOf(raw) {
      const r3 = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
      const mode = String(r3.mode === void 0 || r3.mode === null ? "" : r3.mode);
      return {
        mode: VC_COMMIT_MODES.indexOf(mode) >= 0 ? mode : "staged",
        target: String(r3.target === void 0 || r3.target === null ? "" : r3.target).trim(),
        skipHooks: r3.skipHooks === true,
        sign: r3.sign === true,
        signoff: r3.signoff === true
      };
    }
    function commitPlanProblem(raw) {
      const p3 = commitPlanOf(raw);
      if (p3.target !== "" && (p3.target.charAt(0) === "-" || !COMMIT_TARGET_PATTERN.test(p3.target))) return "bad-commit-target";
      if (p3.mode === "fixup" || p3.mode === "squash") {
        if (p3.target === "") return "need-commit-target";
      }
      return null;
    }
    function commitDecisionOf(decision, plan, screen) {
      const verdict = decision && decision.verdict ? String(decision.verdict) : "block";
      const reasons = Array.isArray(decision && decision.reasons) ? decision.reasons.slice() : [];
      const hasHead = !(screen && screen.repo && screen.repo.hasCommits === false);
      const without = function(item) {
        return reasons.filter(function(x4) {
          return x4 !== item;
        });
      };
      if (plan.mode === "amend") {
        const left = without("nothing-staged");
        if (!hasHead) return { verdict: "block", reasons: left.concat(["nothing-to-amend"]) };
        if (left.length === 0) return { verdict: "allow", reasons: ["ok"] };
        return { verdict: verdict === "warn" ? "warn" : verdict === "allow" ? "allow" : "block", reasons: left };
      }
      if (plan.mode === "all") {
        const changes = Number(screen && screen.stagedCount ? screen.stagedCount : 0) + Number(screen && screen.unstagedCount ? screen.unstagedCount : 0);
        const left = changes > 0 ? without("nothing-staged") : reasons;
        if (left.length === 0) return { verdict: "allow", reasons: ["ok"] };
        return { verdict: verdict === "warn" ? "warn" : verdict === "allow" ? "allow" : "block", reasons: left };
      }
      return decision;
    }
    function commitPlanDangerous(raw) {
      const mode = commitPlanOf(raw).mode;
      return mode === "amend" || mode === "fixup" || mode === "squash";
    }
    function commitArgvOf(raw, message) {
      const p3 = commitPlanOf(raw);
      const msg = String(message === void 0 || message === null ? "" : message);
      const argv = ["commit"];
      if (p3.mode === "all") argv.push("-a");
      else if (p3.mode === "amend") argv.push("--amend");
      else if (p3.mode === "fixup") argv.push("--fixup=" + p3.target);
      else if (p3.mode === "squash") argv.push("--squash=" + p3.target);
      if (p3.sign) argv.push("-S");
      if (p3.signoff) argv.push("-s");
      if (p3.skipHooks) argv.push("--no-verify");
      if (p3.mode === "fixup") return argv;
      if (p3.mode === "amend" && msg.trim() === "") {
        argv.push("--no-edit");
        return argv;
      }
      argv.push("-m", msg);
      return argv;
    }
    function commitTrailerOf(identity) {
      const id = identity && typeof identity === "object" ? identity : {};
      const name = String(id.name === void 0 || id.name === null ? "" : id.name).trim();
      const email = String(id.email === void 0 || id.email === null ? "" : id.email).trim();
      if (name === "" || email === "") return "";
      return "Signed-off-by: " + name + " <" + email + ">";
    }

    const CAPABILITY_LEDGER_SOURCE = "src/shared/version-control/src/capability-ledger.ts";
    const VERSION_FLOOR = { major: 2, minor: 11, patch: 0 };
    const LOCK_PRUNABLE_FLOOR = { major: 2, minor: 31, patch: 0 };
    function parseVersion(text2) {
      const m3 = /(\d+)\.(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?/.exec(String(text2 || ""));
      if (!m3) return null;
      return { major: Number(m3[1]), minor: Number(m3[2]), patch: m3[3] === void 0 ? 0 : Number(m3[3]) };
    }
    function capabilityAtLeast(v3, floor) {
      if (v3.major !== floor.major) return v3.major > floor.major;
      if (v3.minor !== floor.minor) return v3.minor > floor.minor;
      return v3.patch >= floor.patch;
    }
    function capabilityTierFor(v3) {
      if (!v3) return "unsupported";
      if (!capabilityAtLeast(v3, VERSION_FLOOR)) return "unsupported";
      if (!capabilityAtLeast(v3, LOCK_PRUNABLE_FLOOR)) return "degraded";
      return "full";
    }
    function capabilityAvailability(cap, version) {
      const needed = cap.minVersion;
      const parsed = version === null || version === "" ? null : typeof version === "string" ? parseVersion(version) : version;
      if (!parsed || !capabilityAtLeast(parsed, VERSION_FLOOR)) return { state: "hidden", needed, alternative: cap.versionAlternative };
      const minimum = parseVersion(needed);
      if (!minimum || !capabilityAtLeast(parsed, minimum)) {
        return { state: cap.versionPolicy === "degrade" ? "degraded" : "hidden", needed, alternative: cap.versionAlternative };
      }
      return { state: "full", needed, alternative: null };
    }

    function firstScreenShapeOk(snapshot) {
      if (!firstScreenVersionOk(snapshot)) return false;
      if (typeof snapshot.readAtMs !== "number" || !isFinite(snapshot.readAtMs)) return false;
      if (!isPlainObject(snapshot.slices)) return false;
      const keys = Object.keys(snapshot.slices).slice().sort();
      const want = FIRST_SCREEN_SLICES.slice().sort();
      if (keys.length !== want.length) return false;
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < want.length; i3 += 1) if (keys[i3] !== want[i3]) return false;
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < FIRST_SCREEN_SLICES.length; i3 += 1) {
        const slice = snapshot.slices[FIRST_SCREEN_SLICES[i3]];
        if (!isPlainObject(slice)) return false;
        if (slice.state === "ok") {
          if (slice.data === null || slice.data === void 0) return false;
          if (slice.error !== null && slice.error !== void 0) return false;
        } else if (slice.state === "err") {
          if (!isPlainObject(slice.error)) return false;
          if (typeof slice.error.kind !== "string" || slice.error.kind === "") return false;
          if (typeof slice.error.message !== "string") return false;
        } else {
          return false;
        }
      }
      return true;
    }

    function textOf(value) {
      return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
    }
    function bad(reason, message) {
      return { ok: false, reason, message };
    }
    function syncRemoteProblem(name) {
      if (name === "") return "远端名不能为空";
      if (name.length > 100) return "远端名超过 100 个字符";
      if (name.charAt(0) === "-") return "远端名不能以减号开头";
      if (/[\s\u0000-\u001f]/.test(name)) return "远端名不能包含空白或控制字符";
      if (name === "." || name === ".." || name.indexOf("..") >= 0) return "远端名不能包含两个连续的点";
      return "";
    }
    function syncRefProblem(name) {
      if (name === "") return "引用名不能为空";
      if (name.length > 200) return "引用名超过 200 个字符";
      if (name.charAt(0) === "-") return "引用名不能以减号开头";
      if (/[\s\u0000-\u001f]/.test(name)) return "引用名不能包含空白或控制字符";
      if (name.indexOf("..") >= 0) return "引用名不能包含两个连续的点";
      if (name.indexOf("@{") >= 0) return "引用名不能包含 @{";
      if (/[~^:?*\[\\]/.test(name)) return "引用名不能包含 git 的保留符号";
      if (name.charAt(name.length - 1) === "/") return "引用名不能以斜杠结尾";
      return "";
    }
    function syncOidProblem(oid) {
      if (oid === "") return "强推必须带远端当场的提交号作为租约基准";
      if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{7,64}$/.test(oid)) return "租约基准不是合法的十六进制提交号";
      return "";
    }
    function syncRefspecProblem(refspec) {
      if (refspec === "") return "refspec 不能为空";
      if (refspec.length > 300) return "refspec 超过 300 个字符";
      if (refspec.charAt(0) === "-") return "refspec 不能以减号开头";
      if (/[\s\u0000-\u001f]/.test(refspec)) return "refspec 不能包含空白或控制字符";
      if (refspec.indexOf("..") >= 0) return "refspec 不能包含两个连续的点";
      return "";
    }
    function syncUpstreamProblem(upstream) {
      if (upstream === "") return "拉取必须指定上游分支，例如 origin/main";
      const cut = upstream.indexOf("/");
      if (cut <= 0 || cut === upstream.length - 1) return "上游分支必须写成「远端/分支」两段";
      const remoteProblem = syncRemoteProblem(upstream.slice(0, cut));
      if (remoteProblem !== "") return remoteProblem;
      const refProblem = syncRefProblem(upstream.slice(cut + 1));
      if (refProblem !== "") return refProblem;
      return "";
    }
    function basePlan(entry, plan) {
      return Object.assign({
        action: entry.action,
        id: entry.id,
        op: entry.op,
        level: entry.level,
        needsConfirm: entry.needsConfirm === true,
        commandText: entry.commandText,
        remote: "origin",
        branch: "",
        localBranch: "",
        upstream: "",
        ref: "",
        refKind: "",
        mode: "",
        leaseBranch: "",
        leaseOid: "",
        forceIfIncludes: false,
        versionNeed: "",
        versionNote: "",
        targetText: "",
        taskArgs: {}
      }, plan || {});
    }
    function syncPlanOf(action, input) {
      const entry = syncActionOf(action);
      if (entry === null) return bad("unknown-action", "不认识的同步动作：" + String(action));
      const a3 = input === void 0 || input === null ? {} : input;
      const remote = textOf(a3.remote) === "" ? "origin" : textOf(a3.remote);
      const remoteProblem = syncRemoteProblem(remote);
      if (remoteProblem !== "") return bad("bad-remote", remoteProblem);
      if (entry.action === "fetch") {
        const all = a3.all === true;
        const prune = a3.prune === true;
        const tags = a3.tags === true;
        const refspecs = a3.refspecs === void 0 || a3.refspecs === null ? [] : a3.refspecs;
        if (!Array.isArray(refspecs)) return bad("bad-args", "refspecs 必须是数组");
        if (all && refspecs.length > 0) return bad("bad-args", "--all 与具体引用不能同时使用");
        const refs = [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < refspecs.length; i3 = i3 + 1) {
          const ref = textOf(refspecs[i3]);
          const refProblem = syncRefspecProblem(ref);
          if (refProblem !== "") return bad("bad-ref", refProblem);
          refs.push(ref);
        }
        return {
          ok: true,
          plan: basePlan(entry, {
            remote,
            branch: "",
            taskArgs: { remote, all, prune, tags, refspecs: refs },
            targetText: "远端 " + remote
          })
        };
      }
      if (entry.action === "pull-merge" || entry.action === "pull-rebase" || entry.action === "pull-ff-only") {
        const upstream = textOf(a3.upstream);
        const upstreamProblem = syncUpstreamProblem(upstream);
        if (upstreamProblem !== "") return bad("bad-upstream", upstreamProblem);
        const cut = upstream.indexOf("/");
        const mode = entry.action === "pull-merge" ? "merge" : entry.action === "pull-rebase" ? "rebase" : "ff-only";
        return {
          ok: true,
          plan: basePlan(entry, {
            remote: upstream.slice(0, cut),
            upstream,
            branch: upstream.slice(cut + 1),
            mode,
            taskArgs: { upstream, mode },
            targetText: "上游 " + upstream
          })
        };
      }
      if (entry.action === "delete-remote-ref") {
        const kind = textOf(a3.refKind) === "tag" ? "tag" : textOf(a3.refKind) === "branch" ? "branch" : "";
        if (kind === "") return bad("bad-args", "删除远端引用时必须说明删分支还是删标签");
        const name = textOf(a3.name);
        const refProblem = syncRefProblem(name);
        if (refProblem !== "") return bad("bad-ref", refProblem);
        const ref = (kind === "tag" ? "refs/tags/" : "refs/heads/") + name;
        return {
          ok: true,
          plan: basePlan(entry, {
            remote,
            branch: kind === "branch" ? name : "",
            ref,
            refKind: kind,
            taskArgs: { remote, deleteRef: ref },
            targetText: (kind === "tag" ? "远端标签 " : "远端分支 ") + remote + "/" + name
          })
        };
      }
      if (entry.action === "force-push") {
        const localBranch2 = textOf(a3.localBranch);
        const branch2 = textOf(a3.branch) === "" ? localBranch2 : textOf(a3.branch);
        if (syncRefProblem(localBranch2) !== "") return bad("bad-branch", syncRefProblem(localBranch2) || "本地分支不合法");
        if (syncRefProblem(branch2) !== "") return bad("bad-branch", syncRefProblem(branch2) || "远端分支不合法");
        const leaseOid = textOf(a3.leaseOid);
        const oidProblem = syncOidProblem(leaseOid);
        if (oidProblem !== "") return bad("bad-lease", oidProblem);
        const forceIfIncludes = a3.forceIfIncludes === true;
        return {
          ok: true,
          plan: basePlan(entry, {
            remote,
            branch: branch2,
            localBranch: localBranch2,
            leaseBranch: branch2,
            leaseOid,
            forceIfIncludes,
            versionNeed: "2.30",
            versionNote: forceIfIncludes ? "" : "本机 git 低于 2.30，本次强推只带 --force-with-lease，少一道 --force-if-includes 保护。",
            taskArgs: { remote, localBranch: localBranch2, branch: branch2, forceWithLease: { branch: branch2, oid: leaseOid }, forceIfIncludes },
            targetText: "远端分支 " + remote + "/" + branch2 + "（租约基准 " + leaseOid + "）"
          })
        };
      }
      if (entry.action === "push-tags") {
        const mode = textOf(a3.tags) === "tags" ? "tags" : "follow-tags";
        return {
          ok: true,
          plan: basePlan(entry, {
            remote,
            mode,
            taskArgs: { remote, tags: mode },
            targetText: "远端 " + remote + " 的标签（" + (mode === "tags" ? "推送全部标签" : "随提交推送标签") + "）"
          })
        };
      }
      const localBranch = textOf(a3.localBranch);
      const branch = textOf(a3.branch) === "" ? localBranch : textOf(a3.branch);
      const localProblem = syncRefProblem(localBranch);
      if (localProblem !== "") return bad("bad-branch", localProblem);
      const branchProblem = syncRefProblem(branch);
      if (branchProblem !== "") return bad("bad-branch", branchProblem);
      const taskArgs = { remote, localBranch, branch };
      if (entry.action === "push-upstream") taskArgs.setUpstream = true;
      if (entry.action === "atomic-push") taskArgs.atomic = true;
      return {
        ok: true,
        plan: basePlan(entry, {
          remote,
          branch,
          localBranch,
          taskArgs,
          targetText: "远端分支 " + remote + "/" + branch
        })
      };
    }
    function stableOf(value) {
      if (value === null || value === void 0) return "null";
      const kind = typeof value;
      if (kind === "string") return JSON.stringify(value);
      if (kind === "number" || kind === "boolean") return String(value);
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        const parts = [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < value.length; i3 = i3 + 1) parts.push(stableOf(value[i3]));
        return "[" + parts.join(",") + "]";
      }
      if (kind === "object") {
        const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
        const parts = [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < keys.length; i3 = i3 + 1) parts.push(JSON.stringify(keys[i3]) + ":" + stableOf(value[keys[i3]]));
        return "{" + parts.join(",") + "}";
      }
      return JSON.stringify(String(value));
    }

    function syncVersionAtLeast(version, major, minor) {
      const text2 = textOf(version);
      const found = /([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)/.exec(text2);
      if (found === null) return false;
      const gotMajor = parseInt(found[1], 10);
      const gotMinor = parseInt(found[2], 10);
      if (gotMajor !== major) return gotMajor > major;
      return gotMinor >= minor;
    }

    const BLOCKING = {
      "unknown-action": true,
      "bare-repo": true,
      "detached-head": true,
      "mid-operation": true,
      "no-remote": true,
      "conflicts-unresolved": true,

    function syncReasonTextOf(reason) {
      const id = String(reason === void 0 || reason === null ? "" : reason);

    function pushReason(list, reason) {
      if (list.indexOf(reason) < 0) list.push(reason);
    }
    function judgeSync(scene, plan) {
      const s3 = scene === void 0 || scene === null ? {} : scene;
      const reasons = [];
      if (!plan || typeof plan.action !== "string") {
        pushReason(reasons, "bad-plan");
        return { decision: "block", reasons, blockingReasons: reasons.slice(), warningReasons: [], confirmRequired: false };
      }
      const action = plan.action;
      const isFetch = action === "fetch";
      if (s3.bare === true) pushReason(reasons, "bare-repo");
      if (!isFetch && s3.detached === true) pushReason(reasons, "detached-head");
      if (!isFetch && s3.midOperation === true) pushReason(reasons, "mid-operation");
      const remotes = Array.isArray(s3.remotes) ? s3.remotes : [];
      if (s3.remotesKnown !== false && plan.remote && remotes.indexOf(plan.remote) < 0) pushReason(reasons, "no-remote");
      if (action === "pull-merge" || action === "pull-rebase" || action === "pull-ff-only") {
        if (s3.conflicts === true) pushReason(reasons, "conflicts-unresolved");
        if (s3.upstreamGone === true) pushReason(reasons, "upstream-gone");
      }
      if (action === "force-push") {
        if (typeof plan.leaseOid !== "string" || plan.leaseOid === "") pushReason(reasons, "force-lease-required");
        else if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F]{7,64}$/.test(plan.leaseOid)) pushReason(reasons, "baseline-bad");
      }
      const blocking = [];
      const warning = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < reasons.length; i3 = i3 + 1) {
        if (BLOCKING[reasons[i3]] === true) blocking.push(reasons[i3]);
        else warning.push(reasons[i3]);
      }
      if (action === "delete-remote-ref" && s3.currentBranch && plan.branch && plan.branch === s3.currentBranch) pushReason(warning, "delete-current");
      if ((action === "pull-merge" || action === "pull-rebase") && s3.dirty === true) pushReason(warning, "dirty-tree");
      const decision = blocking.length > 0 ? "block" : warning.length > 0 ? "warn" : plan.needsConfirm === true ? "warn" : "allow";
      return { decision, reasons: blocking.concat(warning), blockingReasons: blocking, warningReasons: warning, confirmRequired: decision === "warn" };
    }
    function verbOf(action) {
      if (action === "fetch") return "获取";
      if (action === "pull-merge" || action === "pull-rebase" || action === "pull-ff-only") return "拉取";
      if (action === "delete-remote-ref") return "删除远端引用";
      if (action === "force-push") return "强推";
      if (action === "atomic-push") return "原子推送";
      if (action === "push-tags") return "推送标签";
      if (action === "push-upstream") return "推送并设置上游";
      return "推送";
    }

    function syncConfirmOf(plan, extra) {
      const e3 = extra === void 0 || extra === null ? {} : extra;
      const action = plan && typeof plan.action === "string" ? plan.action : "";
      const verb = verbOf(action);
      let target = plan && typeof plan.targetText === "string" ? plan.targetText : "";
      if (action === "force-push") {
        const remote = plan && typeof plan.remote === "string" ? plan.remote : "origin";

      }
      let what = "";
      let wont = "";
      let reversible = "";

        what = "会从远端 " + (plan && plan.remote ? plan.remote : "origin") + " 取回新对象，并更新本地记录下来的远端跟踪引用。";
        wont = "不会合并进当前分支，也不会改动工作区文件。";
        reversible = "可取回的内容留在本地对象库里，重新获取不会重复下载全部内容。";
      } else if (action === "pull-merge" || action === "pull-rebase" || action === "pull-ff-only") {
        const mode = action === "pull-rebase" ? "变基" : action === "pull-ff-only" ? "只快进" : "合并";
        what = "会先把远端更新取回来，再以" + mode + "方式并入当前分支" + (plan && plan.upstream ? "（上游 " + plan.upstream + "）" : "") + "。";
        wont = "不会自动解决冲突；冲突会停下并如实报告，也不会丢弃你未提交的改动。";
        reversible = action === "pull-rebase" ? "变基可用 reflog 找回原来的提交；冲突留在工作区等你手动处理。" : "合并结果可以用 git reset 回到合并前的提交；冲突留在工作区等你手动处理。";
      } else if (action === "delete-remote-ref") {
        const kind = plan && plan.refKind === "tag" ? "标签" : "分支";
        what = "会删除远端 " + (plan ? plan.remote : "origin") + " 上的" + kind + " " + (plan && plan.ref ? plan.ref : "") + "。";
        wont = "不会删除本地同名" + kind + "，也不会改动工作区。";
        reversible = kind === "标签" ? "删掉后可以重新推送同一个标签指回原对象。" : "删掉后如果还记得原提交号，可以重新推送该引用指回原提交；否则只能等本地还有记录时恢复。";
      } else if (action === "force-push") {
        what = "会把" + target + "，用租约确认远端没有在你预检之后被别人改动过。";
        wont = "不会在没有租约的情况下强推，也不会覆盖你预检之后才出现的远端新提交（租约对不上会直接失败）。";
        reversible = "远端原来的提交号写在确认卡里；推错时可以按这个号用同样的租约强推回去。";
      } else if (action === "atomic-push") {
        what = "会把本地分支" + (plan && plan.localBranch ? " " + plan.localBranch : "") + " 原子地推到" + target + "：所有引用要么全成，要么全不成。";
        wont = "不会只成功一半；任何一条引用被拒绝时，其余引用也不会落下去。";
        reversible = "远端没收到就什么也没变；收到后可以按远端新提交号回退。";
      } else if (action === "push-tags") {

        reversible = "推错的标签可以删掉重推；远端指针记录会留在面板里。";
      } else if (action === "push-upstream") {
        what = "会把本地分支推到" + target + "，并把本地分支的上游设为它。";
        wont = "不会改动其他分支，也不会强推覆盖远端已有提交。";
        reversible = "推送被拒时什么也不会变；成功后可随时用上游信息拉回。";
      } else {
        what = "会把本地分支推到" + target + "。";
        wont = "不会强推覆盖远端已有提交，也不会改动其他分支。";
        reversible = "推送被拒时什么也不会变；成功后可随时用上游信息拉回。";
      }
      return { verb, target, what, wont, reversible };
    }

    function migratePathProblem(value) {
      const text2 = mgTextOf(value);
      if (text2 === "") return "路径不能为空";
      if (text2.length > 2048) return "路径超过 2048 个字符";
      if (text2.indexOf("\0") >= 0) return "路径里不许有 NUL 字符";
      if (/^[-+]/.test(text2) === true) return "路径不许以短横线或加号开头";
      const segments = text2.split(/[\\/]/);
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < segments.length; i3 = i3 + 1) {
        if (segments[i3] === "..") return "路径里不许有上跳段（..）";
      }
      if (/^(?:[A-Za-z]:[\\/]|[\\/])/.test(text2) === false) return "路径必须是绝对路径（例如 D:/备份/repo.bundle）";
      return "";
    }
    function migrateRefProblem(value) {
      const text2 = mgTextOf(value);
      if (text2 === "") return "引用不能为空";
      if (text2.length > 300) return "引用超过 300 个字符";
      if (text2.charAt(0) === "-" || text2.charAt(0) === "+") return "引用不许以短横线或加号开头";
      if (/[\s\u0000-\u001f]/.test(text2) === true) return "引用里不许有空白或控制字符";
      return "";
    }
    function migrateBranchProblem(value) {
      const text2 = mgTextOf(value);
      if (text2 === "") return "初始分支名不能为空";
      if (text2.length > 200) return "初始分支名超过 200 个字符";
      if (text2.charAt(0) === "-" || text2.charAt(0) === "/") return "初始分支名不许以短横线或斜杠开头";
      if (/[\s\u0000-\u001f]/.test(text2) === true) return "初始分支名里不许有空白或控制字符";
      if (text2.indexOf("..") >= 0) return "初始分支名里不许有连续两个点";
      if (text2.indexOf("@{") >= 0) return "初始分支名里不许有 @{";
      if (/[~^:?*\[\\]/.test(text2) === true) return "初始分支名里不许有 git 的保留符号";
      if (text2.charAt(text2.length - 1) === "/") return "初始分支名不许以斜杠结尾";
      return "";
    }
    function migrateUrlProblem(value) {
      const text2 = mgTextOf(value);
      if (text2 === "") return "svn 地址不能为空";
      if (text2.length > 2048) return "svn 地址超过 2048 个字符";
      if (/[\s\u0000-\u001f]/.test(text2) === true) return "svn 地址里不许有空白或控制字符";
      if (text2.charAt(0) === "-") return "svn 地址不许以短横线开头";
      if (/^(?:https?|svn|svn\+ssh|file|ssh|git):\/\//.test(text2) === false) return "svn 地址必须以 http(s)://、svn://、svn+ssh:// 或 file:// 开头";
      return "";
    }
    function migrateVersionAtLeast(version, major, minor) {
      const text2 = mgTextOf(version);
      const found = /([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)/.exec(text2);
      if (found === null) return false;
      const gotMajor = parseInt(found[1], 10);
      const gotMinor = parseInt(found[2], 10);
      if (gotMajor !== major) return gotMajor > major;
      return gotMinor >= minor;
    }

      return Object.assign({

    function migratePlanOf(action, input) {
      const entry = migrateActionOf(action);
      if (entry === null) return mgBad("unknown-action", "不认识的迁移动作：" + String(action));
      const a3 = input === void 0 || input === null ? {} : input;

        const branchProblem = migrateBranchProblem(branch);
        if (branchProblem !== "") return mgBad("bad-branch", branchProblem);
        const initMode = mgTextOf(a3.initMode) === "rename" ? "rename" : "initial-branch";
        return {
          ok: true,
          plan: mgBasePlan(entry, {
            path: mgTextOf(a3.path),
            branch,
            bare: a3.bare === true,
            initMode,
            versionNeed: initMode === "initial-branch" ? "2.28" : "2.11",

          })
        };
      }
      if (entry.action === "archive") {
        const pathProblem = migratePathProblem(a3.outputPath);
        if (pathProblem !== "") return mgBad("bad-path", pathProblem);
        const ref = mgTextOf(a3.ref) === "" ? "HEAD" : mgTextOf(a3.ref);
        const refProblem = migrateRefProblem(ref);
        if (refProblem !== "") return mgBad("bad-ref", refProblem);
        return {
          ok: true,
          plan: mgBasePlan(entry, {
            outputPath: mgTextOf(a3.outputPath),
            ref,
            pathAbsent: [mgTextOf(a3.outputPath)],
            taskArgs: { outputPath: mgTextOf(a3.outputPath), ref },

          })
        };
      }
      if (entry.action === "bundle-create") {

      }
      if (entry.action === "fast-export") {

    function mgStableOf(value) {
      if (value === null || value === void 0) return "null";
      const kind = typeof value;
      if (kind === "string") return JSON.stringify(value);
      if (kind === "number" || kind === "boolean") return String(value);
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        const parts = [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < value.length; i3 = i3 + 1) parts.push(mgStableOf(value[i3]));
        return "[" + parts.join(",") + "]";
      }
      if (kind === "object") {
        const keys = Object.keys(value).sort();
        const parts = [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < keys.length; i3 = i3 + 1) parts.push(JSON.stringify(keys[i3]) + ":" + mgStableOf(value[keys[i3]]));
        return "{" + parts.join(",") + "}";
      }
      return JSON.stringify(String(value));
    }

    function cloneIsLocalPath(value) {

    }

    function cloneMaskedUrl(url) {
      const s3 = url === void 0 || url === null ? "" : String(url).trim();
      if (s3 === "") return "";
      let out = s3;
      try {
        const at = out.lastIndexOf("@");
        const scheme = out.indexOf("://");
        if (at > 0 && scheme > 0) {
          const head = out.slice(0, scheme + 3);
          const userinfo = out.slice(scheme + 3, at);
          const colon = userinfo.indexOf(":");
          const tail = out.slice(at);
          out = head + (colon >= 0 ? userinfo.slice(0, colon) + ":***" : userinfo) + tail;
        }
        out = out.replace(/([?&](?:token|access_token|password|passwd|auth)=)[^&#]*/gi, "$1***");
      } catch (e3) {
        return "（地址形状无法安全展示，已隐藏）";
      }
      return out;
    }

    const worktreeJudge = function(op, ctx2) {
      const o3 = String(op || "");
      const c3 = ctx2 || {};
      const rows = Array.isArray(c3.rows) ? c3.rows : [];
      const availability = c3.availability;
      const version = worktreeVersionOf(availability);
      const reasons = [];
      let warned = false;
      const block = function(r3) {
        reasons.push(r3);

      };
      const warn = function(r3) {
        reasons.push(r3);
        warned = true;
      };
      const allow = function() {
        if (reasons.length === 0) reasons.push("ok");
        return { decision: warned ? "warn" : "allow", reasons, version };
      };
      if (version.state === "hidden") return block("version-too-old");
      if (version.state === "unknown") return block("version-unknown");
      if (version.state === "degraded" && (o3 === "lock" || o3 === "unlock")) warn("version-unknown");
      if (o3 === "list" || o3 === "list-plain") return allow();

          const bp = worktreeBranchProblem(c3.branch);
          if (bp) return block(bp);

        }

      }
      if (o3 === "prune") {

        if (n2 < 0) return block("worktree-not-listed");
        return allow();
      }
      if (target === "") return block("path-blank");
      if (!row) return block("worktree-not-listed");
      if (o3 === "remove" || o3 === "move") {
        if (row.current === true) return block("worktree-is-current");
        if (row.locked === true) return block("worktree-locked");
      }
      if (o3 === "remove") {
        if (typeof c3.dirtyCount === "number" && c3.dirtyCount > 0) warn("worktree-dirty");

      }

        return allow();
      }

        if (ddp) return block(ddp);
        return allow();
      }
      return block("path-bad");
    };

    function submoduleStableValue(value) {
      function walk(v3) {
        if (v3 === void 0 || v3 === null) return "null";
        if (typeof v3 === "number") return isFinite(v3) ? String(v3) : "null";
        if (typeof v3 === "boolean") return v3 ? "true" : "false";
        if (typeof v3 === "string") return JSON.stringify(v3);
        if (Array.isArray(v3)) return "[" + v3.map(walk).join(",") + "]";
        if (typeof v3 === "object") {
          const keys = Object.keys(v3).sort();
          const parts = [];
          for (const k4 of keys) parts.push(JSON.stringify(k4) + ":" + walk(v3[k4]));
          return "{" + parts.join(",") + "}";
        }
        return "null";
      }
      return walk(value);
    }
    function submodulePathProblem(value) {
      if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0) return "path-blank";
      if (value.length > 4096) return "path-bad";
      if (/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(value)) return "path-bad";
      if (/^[-+]/.test(value)) return "path-bad";
      if (/^[\\/]/.test(value)) return "path-bad";
      if (/^[A-Za-z]:/.test(value)) return "path-bad";
      const segments = value.split(/[\\/]/);
      for (const seg of segments) if (seg === "..") return "path-bad";
      return null;
    }
    function submoduleUrlProblem(value) {
      if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0) return "url-blank";
      if (value.length > 4096) return "url-bad";
      if (/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f\s]/.test(value)) return "url-bad";
      if (/^[-+]/.test(value)) return "url-bad";
      return null;
    }
    function submoduleBranchProblem(value) {
      if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0) return "branch-blank";
      if (value.length > 4096) return "branch-bad";
      if (/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f\s]/.test(value)) return "branch-bad";
      if (/^[-+]/.test(value)) return "branch-bad";
      if (value.indexOf("..") >= 0 || value.indexOf(":") >= 0) return "branch-bad";
      return null;
    }
    function submoduleUrlHasCredentials(value) {
      const text2 = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
      return /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^/@]*:[^/@]*@/.test(text2);
    }
    function submoduleRedactUrl(value) {
      let text2 = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
      if (submoduleUrlHasCredentials(text2)) text2 = text2.replace(/^([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/)[^/@]*@/, "$1**@");
      return text2.length > 400 ? text2.slice(0, 400) + "…" : text2;
    }

    function submoduleParseStatus(text2) {
      const s3 = typeof text2 === "string" ? text2 : "";
      const lines = s3.split(/\r?\n/);
      const rows = [];
      for (const raw of lines) {
        const line = String(raw);
        if (line.length < 3) continue;
        const mark = line.charAt(0);
        if (mark !== " " && mark !== "-" && mark !== "+" && mark !== "U") continue;
        const rest = line.slice(1);
        const spaceAt = rest.indexOf(" ");
        if (spaceAt < 0) continue;
        const oid = rest.slice(0, spaceAt);
        let path = rest.slice(spaceAt + 1);
        let describe = "";
        const close = path.lastIndexOf(")");
        const open = path.lastIndexOf(" (", close);
        if (close === path.length - 1 && open >= 0) {
          describe = path.slice(open + 2, close);
          path = path.slice(0, open);
        }
        path = path.trim();
        if (path.length === 0) continue;
        const states = { " ": "clean", "-": "uninitialized", "+": "different", "U": "conflict" };
        rows.push({ path, oid, state: states[mark], describe });
      }
      return { ok: true, rows };
    }
    function submoduleParseConfig(text2) {
      const s3 = typeof text2 === "string" ? text2 : "";
      const modules = [];
      const byName = {};
      for (const raw of s3.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const line = String(raw).trim();
        if (line.length === 0) continue;
        const spaceAt = line.indexOf(" ");
        if (spaceAt <= 0) continue;
        const key = line.slice(0, spaceAt);
        const value = line.slice(spaceAt + 1);
        if (key.indexOf("submodule.") !== 0) continue;
        const rest = key.slice("submodule.".length);
        const dotAt = rest.lastIndexOf(".");
        if (dotAt <= 0) continue;
        const name = rest.slice(0, dotAt);
        const field = rest.slice(dotAt + 1);
        if (!byName[name]) {
          byName[name] = { name, path: "", url: "", branch: "" };
          modules.push(byName[name]);
        }
        if (field === "path") byName[name].path = value;
        else if (field === "url") byName[name].url = value;
        else if (field === "branch") byName[name].branch = value;
      }
      return { ok: true, modules };
    }

    function submoduleJudge(op, ctx2) {
      const action = submoduleActionOf(op);
      const c3 = ctx2 && typeof ctx2 === "object" ? ctx2 : {};
      const rows = Array.isArray(c3.rows) ? c3.rows : [];
      function rowOf(path) {
        if (typeof path !== "string") return null;
        for (const r3 of rows) if (r3 && r3.path === path) return r3;
        return null;
      }
      function allow() {
        return { decision: "allow", reasons: [] };
      }
      function warn(reason) {
        return { decision: "warn", reasons: [reason] };
      }
      function block(reason) {
        return { decision: "block", reasons: [reason] };
      }
      if (!action) return block("unknown-action");
      if (action.id === "status") return allow();
      if (action.place === "batch") return allow();
      const pathProblem = submodulePathProblem(c3.path);
      if (pathProblem) return block(pathProblem);
      const row = rowOf(c3.path);
      if (action.id === "add") {
        const urlProblem = submoduleUrlProblem(c3.url);
        if (urlProblem) return block(urlProblem);
        if (row) return block("module-exists");
        if (c3.targetExists === true && c3.targetEmpty !== true) return block("target-exists");
        if (submoduleUrlHasCredentials(c3.url)) return warn("url-credentials");
        return allow();
      }
      if (!row) return block("module-missing");
      if (action.id === "set-url") {
        const urlProblem = submoduleUrlProblem(c3.url);
        if (urlProblem) return block(urlProblem);
        if (submoduleUrlHasCredentials(c3.url)) return warn("url-credentials");
        return allow();
      }
      if (action.id === "set-branch") {
        const branchProblem = submoduleBranchProblem(c3.branch);
        if (branchProblem) return block(branchProblem);
        return allow();
      }
      if (action.id === "deinit") {
        if (row.initialized !== true) return block("module-not-initialized");
        if (row.localCommits > 0 && row.detached === true) return warn("local-commits");
        return allow();
      }
      if (action.id === "absorb") {
        if (row.initialized !== true) return block("module-not-initialized");
        if (row.absorbable !== true) return block("nothing-to-absorb");
        return allow();
      }
      if (action.id !== "init" && row.initialized !== true) return block("module-not-initialized");
      return allow();
    }

    const SUBMODULE_SOURCE = "src/shared/version-control/src/submodule-ops.ts";
    const CONFLICT_MARKERS = ["<<<<<<<", "|||||||", "=======", ">>>>>>>"];
    function conflictLinesOf(text2) {
      const s3 = String(text2 === void 0 || text2 === null ? "" : text2);
      const out = [];
      let i3 = 0;
      while (i3 < s3.length) {
        const nl = s3.indexOf("\n", i3);
        if (nl < 0) {
          out.push(s3.slice(i3));
          break;
        }
        out.push(s3.slice(i3, nl + 1));
        i3 = nl + 1;
      }
      return out;
    }
    function conflictLineContentOf(line) {
      let t3 = line;
      if (t3.length > 0 && t3.charAt(t3.length - 1) === "\n") t3 = t3.slice(0, -1);
      if (t3.length > 0 && t3.charAt(t3.length - 1) === "\r") t3 = t3.slice(0, -1);
      return t3;
    }
    function conflictMarkerOf(line) {
      const c3 = conflictLineContentOf(line);
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < CONFLICT_MARKERS.length; i3 += 1) {
        if (c3.indexOf(CONFLICT_MARKERS[i3]) === 0) return CONFLICT_MARKERS[i3];
      }
      return null;
    }
    function conflictMarkerLineOf(text2) {
      const lines = conflictLinesOf(text2);
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < lines.length; i3 += 1) {
        const m3 = conflictMarkerOf(lines[i3]);
        if (m3 !== null) return { line: i3 + 1, marker: m3 };
      }
      return null;
    }
    function conflictMarkerLinesOf(text2) {
      const lines = conflictLinesOf(text2);
      const out = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < lines.length; i3 += 1) {
        const m3 = conflictMarkerOf(lines[i3]);
        if (m3 !== null) out.push({ line: i3 + 1, marker: m3 });
      }
      return out;
    }
    function conflictTextKindOf(text2) {
      return String(text2 === void 0 || text2 === null ? "" : text2).indexOf("\0") >= 0 ? "binary" : "text";
    }
    function conflictSegmentsOf(text2) {
      const lines = conflictLinesOf(text2);
      const segments = [];
      let pending = [];
      let hunkCount = 0;
      const flushText = function() {
        if (pending.length > 0) {
          segments.push({ kind: "text", lines: pending });
          pending = [];
        }
      };
      let i3 = 0;
      while (i3 < lines.length) {
        const marker = conflictMarkerOf(lines[i3]);
        if (marker === "<<<<<<<") {
          flushText();
          const startLine = i3 + 1;
          const ours = [];
          const base = [];
          const theirs = [];
          let phase = "ours";
          let ended = false;
          i3 += 1;
          while (i3 < lines.length) {
            const m3 = conflictMarkerOf(lines[i3]);
            if (m3 === "|||||||" && phase === "ours") {
              phase = "base";
              i3 += 1;
              continue;
            }
            if (m3 === "=======" && (phase === "ours" || phase === "base")) {
              phase = "theirs";
              i3 += 1;
              continue;
            }
            if (m3 === ">>>>>>>" && phase === "theirs") {
              ended = true;
              i3 += 1;
              break;
            }
            if (m3 !== null) return { ok: false, reason: "bad-markers" };
            if (phase === "ours") ours.push(lines[i3]);
            else if (phase === "base") base.push(lines[i3]);
            else theirs.push(lines[i3]);
            i3 += 1;
          }
          if (!ended) return { ok: false, reason: "unterminated-hunk" };
          segments.push({ kind: "hunk", hunk: { index: hunkCount, startLine, oursLines: ours, baseLines: base.length > 0 ? base : null, theirsLines: theirs } });
          hunkCount += 1;
        } else if (marker !== null) {
          return { ok: false, reason: "bad-markers" };
        } else {
          pending.push(lines[i3]);
          i3 += 1;
        }
      }
      flushText();
      return { ok: true, segments, hunkCount };
    }
    function splitConflictHunks(text2) {
      const parsed = conflictSegmentsOf(text2);
      if (parsed.ok !== true) return parsed;
      const hunks = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < parsed.segments.length; i3 += 1) {
        const seg = parsed.segments[i3];
        if (seg.kind === "hunk") hunks.push(seg.hunk);
      }
      if (hunks.length === 0) return { ok: false, reason: "no-markers" };
      return { ok: true, hunks };
    }
    function applyConflictChoices(text2, choices) {
      const parsed = conflictSegmentsOf(text2);
      if (parsed.ok !== true) return parsed;
      const list = Array.isArray(choices) ? choices : [];
      if (list.length !== parsed.hunkCount) return { ok: false, reason: "missing-choice" };
      const parts = [];
      let hunkIndex = 0;
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < parsed.segments.length; i3 += 1) {
        const seg = parsed.segments[i3];
        if (seg.kind === "text") {
          parts.push(seg.lines.join(""));
          continue;
        }
        const choice = String(list[hunkIndex] === void 0 || list[hunkIndex] === null ? "" : list[hunkIndex]);
        hunkIndex += 1;
        if (choice === "ours") parts.push(seg.hunk.oursLines.join(""));
        else if (choice === "theirs") parts.push(seg.hunk.theirsLines.join(""));
        else if (choice === "both") parts.push(seg.hunk.oursLines.join("") + seg.hunk.theirsLines.join(""));
        else if (choice === "base") parts.push(seg.hunk.baseLines === null ? "" : seg.hunk.baseLines.join(""));
        else return { ok: false, reason: "bad-choice" };
      }
      return { ok: true, text: parts.join("") };
    }
    function conflictTextProblem(text2, maxLen) {

      if (text2.length > limit) return { reason: "text-too-large", length: text2.length, limit };
      const marker = conflictMarkerLineOf(text2);
      if (marker !== null) return { reason: "conflict-markers", line: marker.line, marker: marker.marker };
      return null;
    }

    function canonicalJson(value) {
      if (value === null || value === void 0) return "null";
      const t3 = typeof value;
      if (t3 === "number") return isFinite(value) ? String(value) : "null";
      if (t3 === "boolean") return value ? "true" : "false";
      if (t3 === "string") return JSON.stringify(value);
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return "[" + value.map(canonicalJson).join(",") + "]";
      if (t3 === "object") {
        const keys = Object.keys(value).filter(function(k4) {
          return value[k4] !== void 0;
        }).sort();
        return "{" + keys.map(function(k4) {
          return JSON.stringify(k4) + ":" + canonicalJson(value[k4]);
        }).join(",") + "}";
      }
      return "null";
    }
    function rewritePathProblem(value) {
      if (typeof value !== "string") return "bad-path";
      if (value === "" || value.length > 1024) return "bad-path";
      if (value.charAt(0) === "-" || value.charAt(0) === "/") return "bad-path";
      if (value.indexOf("\\") >= 0 || value.indexOf("\0") >= 0) return "bad-path";
      if (/[\u0001-\u001f\u007f]/.test(value)) return "bad-path";
      if (/^[A-Za-z]:/.test(value)) return "bad-path";
      if (value.charAt(value.length - 1) === "/") return "bad-path";
      const segs = value.split("/");
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < segs.length; i3 += 1) if (segs[i3] === "" || segs[i3] === "." || segs[i3] === "..") return "bad-path";
      return null;
    }
    function rewritePathsProblem(list) {
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) return "bad-form";
      if (list.length === 0) return "nothing-to-do";
      if (list.length > REWRITE_LIMIT) return "too-many-items";
      const seen = {};
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < list.length; i3 += 1) {
        const problem = rewritePathProblem(list[i3]);
        if (problem) return problem;
        if (seen[list[i3]]) return "bad-path";
        seen[list[i3]] = true;
      }
      return null;
    }
    function rewriteRenamesProblem(list) {
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) return "bad-form";
      if (list.length === 0) return "nothing-to-do";
      if (list.length > REWRITE_LIMIT) return "too-many-items";
      const seen = {};
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < list.length; i3 += 1) {
        const item = list[i3];
        if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return "bad-rename";
        if (typeof item.from !== "string" || typeof item.to !== "string") return "bad-rename";
        const fromProblem = rewritePathProblem(item.from);
        if (fromProblem) return fromProblem;
        const toProblem = rewritePathProblem(item.to);
        if (toProblem) return toProblem;
        if (item.from === item.to) return "bad-rename";
        if (seen[item.from]) return "bad-rename";
        seen[item.from] = true;
      }
      return null;
    }
    function identityProblem(name, email) {
      if (typeof name !== "string" || name.trim() === "" || name.length > 120) return "bad-identity";
      if (/[<>\r\n\u0000]/.test(name)) return "bad-identity";
      if (typeof email !== "string" || email === "" || email.length > 200) return "bad-identity";
      if (/[<>\s\u0000]/.test(email)) return "bad-identity";
      if (!/^[^@]+@[^@.]+(\.[^@.]+)+$/.test(email)) return "bad-identity";
      return null;
    }
    function rewriteIdentityTextOf(name, email) {
      if (identityProblem(name, email)) return null;
      return String(name).trim() + " <" + String(email).trim() + ">";
    }
    function rewriteAuthorsProblem(list) {
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) return "bad-form";
      if (list.length === 0) return "nothing-to-do";
      if (list.length > REWRITE_LIMIT) return "too-many-items";
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < list.length; i3 += 1) {
        const item = list[i3];
        if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return "bad-identity";
        const newProblem = identityProblem(item.name, item.email);
        if (newProblem) return newProblem;
        const hasOldName = item.oldName !== void 0 && item.oldName !== null && item.oldName !== "";
        const hasOldEmail = item.oldEmail !== void 0 && item.oldEmail !== null && item.oldEmail !== "";
        if (hasOldName || hasOldEmail) {
          if (!hasOldName || !hasOldEmail) return "bad-identity";
          const oldProblem = identityProblem(item.oldName, item.oldEmail);
          if (oldProblem) return oldProblem;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    function rewriteMailmapTextOf(list) {

    function rewriteThresholdBytesOf(value) {

      const power = unit === "g" ? 3 : unit === "m" ? 2 : unit === "k" ? 1 : 0;
      const number = Number(power === 0 ? text2 : text2.slice(0, -1));

    function meta(id, capId, kind, command, extra) {
      const base = {
        id,
        capId,
        kind,
        dangerous: false,
        confirm: kind === "write",
        reversible: true,
        needs: "none",
        primary: false,
        labelKey: "vc.maintenance.op." + camelOf(id),
        command
      };
      const add = extra || {};
      Object.keys(add).forEach(function(key) {
        base[key] = add[key];
      });
      return base;
    }

    function maintenanceVersionAtLeast(versionText, needText) {
      const got = String(versionText || "").match(/(\d+)\.(\d+)/);
      const need = String(needText || "").match(/(\d+)\.(\d+)/);
      if (!got || !need) return false;
      const gotMajor = parseInt(got[1], 10);
      const gotMinor = parseInt(got[2], 10);
      const needMajor = parseInt(need[1], 10);
      const needMinor = parseInt(need[2], 10);
      if (gotMajor !== needMajor) return gotMajor > needMajor;
      return gotMinor >= needMinor;
    }

    }

            cur = [last];
            w4 = unitWidth(last);
          } else {
            lines.push(cur.join(""));
            cur = [];
            w4 = 0;
          }
        }
        if (u3 && NO_LINE_END.indexOf(u3) >= 0 && cur.length > 0) {
          cur.push(u3);
          lines.push(cur.join(""));
          cur = [];
          w4 = 0;
          continue;
        }
        cur.push(u3);
        w4 += uw;
      }
      if (cur.length) lines.push(cur.join(""));
      return lines;
    }

    const ENTRY_CHOOSER_WIDTH = 392;

    const ENTRY_CARDS = ["map", "spec"];
    let entryTriggerEl = null;
    function viewportSize() {
      try {
        const w4 = typeof window !== "undefined" && window && window.innerWidth ? window.innerWidth : 0;
        const hgt = typeof window !== "undefined" && window && window.innerHeight ? window.innerHeight : 0;
        return { w: Math.max(320, w4 || 0), h: Math.max(320, hgt || 0) };
      } catch (e3) {
        return { w: 1200, h: 800 };
      }
    }
    function chooserWidth(horizontal) {
      return horizontal ? ENTRY_CHOOSER_WIDE : ENTRY_CHOOSER_WIDTH;
    }
    function chooserLeft(rect, width, vp) {
      const anchor = rect ? rect.left : 16;
      let left = Math.round(anchor);
      const maxLeft = Math.round(vp.w - width - 8);
      if (left > maxLeft) left = maxLeft;
      if (left < 8) left = 8;
      return left;
    }
    function placeChooser(from, el) {
      const vp = viewportSize();
      const horizontal = from === "statusbar" && vp.w >= ENTRY_CHOOSER_WIDE + 16;
      const width = chooserWidth(horizontal);
      const rect = el && typeof el.getBoundingClientRect === "function" ? el.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
      const left = chooserLeft(rect, width, vp);
      const top = rect ? rect.top : 64;
      const bottom = rect ? rect.bottom : 88;
      if (horizontal) {
        return { width, left, bottom: Math.max(8, Math.round(vp.h - top + 6)), horizontal: true };
      }
      return { width, left, top: Math.round(bottom + 6), horizontal: false };
    }
    const entryChooserOpen = function(st, from, el) {
      if (!st || typeof st !== "object") return;
      const src = from === "statusbar" ? "statusbar" : "panel";
      if (st.entryOpen && st.entryFrom === src) {
        entryChooserClose(st);
        return;
      }
      try {
        entryTriggerEl = el || null;
        st.entryOpen = true;
        st.entryFrom = src;
        st.entryPos = placeChooser(src, el);
        try {
          log("info", "entry.open", { from: src, cards: ENTRY_CARDS.length });
        } catch (eLog) {
        }
        if (typeof emit === "function") emit(st);
      } catch (e3) {
        try {
          st.entryOpen = false;
          st.entryFrom = "";
          st.entryPos = null;
          entryTriggerEl = null;
          log("warn", "entry.open", { from: src, cards: 0 });
        } catch (eLog) {
        }
      }
    };
    const entryChooserClose = function(st) {
      if (!st || typeof st !== "object") return;
      try {
        st.entryOpen = false;
        st.entryFrom = "";
        st.entryPos = null;
        entryTriggerEl = null;
        if (typeof emit === "function") emit(st);
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    function pickEntry(st, kind) {
      const card = kind === "spec" ? "spec" : "map";
      const from = String(st && st.entryFrom || "");
      let text2 = "";
      let title = "";
      try {
        text2 = card === "map" ? newWayfinderText(st) : newSpecText(st);
        title = newSessionTitleNew(card === "map" ? "requirement" : "spec");
      } catch (eAssemble) {
        try {
          log("warn", "entry.pick", { from, card, ok: false, textLen: 0 });
        } catch (eLog) {
        }
        return;
      }
      const textLen = String(text2 == null ? "" : text2).length;
      entryChooserClose(st);
      try {
        openTextInNewSession(st, text2, title);
      } catch (eOpen) {
        try {
          log("warn", "entry.pick", { from, card, ok: false, textLen });
        } catch (eLog) {
        }
        return;
      }
      try {
        log("info", "entry.pick", { from, card, ok: true, textLen });
      } catch (eLog) {
      }
    }
    function cardAccent(kind) {
      try {

    }
    const EntryChooser = function(props) {
      const st = props && props.st;
      const hostFrom = props && props.from ? String(props.from) : "";
      const open = !!(st && st.entryOpen && (!hostFrom || String(st.entryFrom) === hostFrom));
      const [focusIdx, setFocusIdx] = React.useState(0);
      const rootRef = React.useRef(null);
      React.useEffect(function() {
        if (!open) return void 0;
        const onDown = function(e3) {
          const root = rootRef.current;
          const target = e3 && e3.target;
          if (root && root.contains && root.contains(target)) return;
          if (entryTriggerEl && entryTriggerEl.contains && entryTriggerEl.contains(target)) return;
          entryChooserClose(st);
        };
        const onKey = function(e3) {
          const key = e3 && e3.key;
          if (key === "Escape") {
            e3.preventDefault();
            entryChooserClose(st);
            return;
          }
          if (key === "ArrowDown" || key === "ArrowUp" || key === "ArrowLeft" || key === "ArrowRight" || key === "Tab") {
            e3.preventDefault();
            setFocusIdx(function(i3) {
              return (Number(i3) + 1) % ENTRY_CARDS.length;
            });
            return;
          }
          if (key === "Enter" || key === " ") {
            e3.preventDefault();
            const idx = Number(focusIdx) || 0;
            pickEntry(st, ENTRY_CARDS[idx] || "map");
          }
        };
        try {
          if (rootRef.current && rootRef.current.focus) rootRef.current.focus();
        } catch (eF) {
        }
        if (typeof document !== "undefined" && document && document.addEventListener) {
          document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown, true);
          document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
          return function() {
            document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown, true);
            document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
          };

    const ACTION_TYPE = Object.freeze({ INJECT_PROMPT: "inject-prompt", OPEN_URL: "open-url", RPC: "rpc", FORM: "form", REFRESH: "refresh", WIZARD: "wizard", CONTRACT_OP: "contract-op" });
    function createActionDispatcher(ctx2) {
      if (!ctx2 || typeof ctx2 !== "object") throw new Error("ActionContext required");
      async function dispatch(action) {
        if (!action || typeof action.type !== "string") {
          return { ok: false, error: { kind: "parse", message: "action.type missing" }, action };
        }
        const t3 = action.type;
        try {
          if (t3 === ACTION_TYPE.INJECT_PROMPT) {
            if (typeof action.prompt !== "string" || !action.prompt) {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "parse", message: "inject-prompt needs prompt:string" }, action };
            }
            if (typeof ctx2.inject !== "function") {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "unsupported", message: "inject not available in this context" }, action };
            }
            let promptText2 = action.prompt;
            let promptArgs = action.args || {};
            if (typeof ctx2.resolvePrompt === "function") {
              try {
                const resolved = await ctx2.resolvePrompt(action.prompt, promptArgs);
                if (resolved === null) return { ok: true, action, data: { injected: false } };
                if (typeof resolved === "string" && resolved) promptText2 = resolved;
                else if (resolved && typeof resolved.text === "string") {
                  promptText2 = resolved.text;
                  if (resolved.args) promptArgs = resolved.args;
                }
              } catch {
              }
            } else if (typeof ctx2.tr === "function" && action.prompt.startsWith("prompt:")) {
              try {
                promptText2 = ctx2.tr(action.prompt, promptArgs);
              } catch {
              }
            }
            await ctx2.inject(promptText2, promptArgs);
            return { ok: true, action };
          }
          if (t3 === ACTION_TYPE.OPEN_URL) {
            if (typeof action.url !== "string" || !action.url) {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "parse", message: "open-url needs url:string" }, action };
            }
            if (typeof ctx2.openUrl === "function") ctx2.openUrl(action.url, "_blank");
            else if (typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.open === "function") window.open(action.url, "_blank");
            else return { ok: false, error: { kind: "unsupported", message: "openUrl not available" }, action };
            return { ok: true, action };
          }
          if (t3 === ACTION_TYPE.RPC) {
            const method = action.method || action.endpoint;
            if (typeof method !== "string" || !method) {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "parse", message: "rpc needs method:string" }, action };
            }
            if (typeof ctx2.hostCall !== "function") {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "unsupported", message: "hostCall not available" }, action };
            }
            const params = action.params !== void 0 ? action.params : action.args;
            const res = await ctx2.hostCall(method, params);
            if (res && typeof res === "object" && res.ok === false) {
              const kind = res.errorKind || res.error && res.error.kind || res.kind || "internal";
              const msg = res.error ? typeof res.error === "string" ? res.error : res.error.message || String(res.error) : res.message || "RPC 业务失败：" + method;
              const err = new Error(String(msg).slice(0, 600));
              err.code = kind;
              err.kind = kind;
              err.errorKind = kind;
              if (res.repoUrl) err.repoUrl = res.repoUrl;
              if (res.repo) err.repo = res.repo;
              if (res.halfCreated) err.halfCreated = true;
              if (res.error && res.error.repoUrl) err.repoUrl = res.error.repoUrl;
              const failure = { kind, message: String(msg).slice(0, 600) };
              if (res.repoUrl) failure.repoUrl = res.repoUrl;
              if (res.repo) failure.repo = res.repo;
              if (res.halfCreated) failure.halfCreated = true;
              return { ok: false, error: failure, action };
            }
            return { ok: true, action, data: res && typeof res === "object" && res.ok === true ? res : void 0 };
          }
          if (t3 === ACTION_TYPE.CONTRACT_OP) {
            const op = action.op;
            if (typeof op !== "string" || !op.trim()) {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "parse", message: "contract-op needs op:string" }, action };
            }
            if (typeof ctx2.hostCall !== "function") {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "unsupported", message: "hostCall not available" }, action };
            }
            const base = action.params !== void 0 ? action.params : action.args;
            const payload = Object.assign({}, base && typeof base === "object" ? base : {}, { op: String(op).trim() });
            const res = await ctx2.hostCall("wf.contractOp", payload);
            if (res && typeof res === "object" && res.ok === false) {
              const kind = res.errorKind || res.error && res.error.kind || res.kind || "internal";
              const msg = res.error ? typeof res.error === "string" ? res.error : res.error.message || String(res.error) : res.message || "契约操作失败：" + String(op);

              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "parse", message: "form needs schema:FieldSchema[]" }, action };
            }
            if (!action.submitAction || typeof action.submitAction.type !== "string") {

            }

              const merged = Object.assign({}, action.submitAction);

              }
              return res;
            });
            return { ok: true, action };
          }
          if (t3 === ACTION_TYPE.WIZARD) {
            const steps = action.steps;
            if (!Array.isArray(steps) || steps.length === 0) {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "parse", message: "wizard needs steps: {title, schema}[]" }, action };
            }
            if (!action.submitAction || typeof action.submitAction.type !== "string") {
              const alt = action.submit || action.form && action.form.submit;
              if (!alt || typeof alt.type !== "string") {
                return { ok: false, error: { kind: "parse", message: "wizard needs submitAction:Action" }, action };
              }
              action.submitAction = alt;
            }
            if (typeof ctx2.renderForm !== "function") {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "unsupported", message: "renderForm not available" }, action };
            }

            await ctx2.renderForm(wizardPayload, async (values) => {
              const merged = Object.assign({}, action.submitAction);
              if (values && typeof values === "object") {
                if (merged.type === ACTION_TYPE.INJECT_PROMPT) {
                  merged.args = Object.assign({}, merged.args || merged.params || {}, values);
                  if (merged.params && !merged.args) merged.args = merged.params;
                } else {
                  const base = merged.params !== void 0 ? merged.params : merged.args;
                  if (merged.type === ACTION_TYPE.RPC || merged.type === ACTION_TYPE.CONTRACT_OP) {
                    merged.params = Object.assign({}, base || {}, values);
                    if (action.submitAction.args) merged.args = merged.params;
                  } else {
                    merged.params = Object.assign({}, base || {}, values);
                  }
                }
              }
              const res = await dispatch(merged);
              if (!res.ok) {
                const err = new Error(res.error.message);
                err.code = res.error.kind;
                err.kind = res.error.kind;
                err.errorKind = res.error.kind;
                if (res.error.repoUrl) err.repoUrl = res.error.repoUrl;
                if (res.error.repo) err.repo = res.error.repo;
                if (res.error.halfCreated) err.halfCreated = true;
                throw err;
              }
              return res;
            });
            return { ok: true, action };
          }
          if (t3 === ACTION_TYPE.REFRESH) {
            if (typeof ctx2.refresh !== "function") {
              return { ok: false, error: { kind: "unsupported", message: "refresh not available" }, action };
            }
            await ctx2.refresh(action.target || "chain");
            return { ok: true, action };
          }
          return { ok: false, error: { kind: "unsupported", message: "unknown action type: " + t3 }, action };
        } catch (e3) {
          return { ok: false, error: { kind: "network", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3).slice(0, 600) }, action };
        }
      }
      async function dispatchAll(actions) {
        if (!Array.isArray(actions)) return [];
        const out = [];
        for (const a3 of actions) out.push(await dispatch(a3));
        return out;
      }
      return { dispatch, dispatchAll };
    }

    function splitBodyLines(body) {
      const out = [];
      let start = 0;
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < body.length; i3++) {
        const ch = body.charAt(i3);
        if (ch !== "\n" && ch !== "\r") continue;
        let eol = "\r\n";
        let skip = 1;
        if (ch === "\r" && body.charAt(i3 + 1) === "\n") {
          eol = "\r\n";
          skip = 2;
        } else if (ch === "\r") {
          eol = "\r";
        } else {
          eol = "\n";
        }
        out.push({ text: body.slice(start, i3), eol });
        start = i3 + skip;
        i3 = start - 1;
      }
      if (start < body.length) out.push({ text: body.slice(start), eol: "" });
      return out;
    }

    function analyzeLines(lines) {
      const marks = [];
      let fenceChar = "";
      let fenceLen = 0;
      let inComment = false;
      for (const line of lines) {
        const fenced = fenceLen > 0;
        const heading = !fenced && !inComment ? parseHeading(line.text) : null;
        marks.push({ fenced, inComment, heading });
        if (fenced) {
          const close = /^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})\s*$/.exec(line.text);
          if (close && close[1].charAt(0) === fenceChar && close[1].length >= fenceLen) {
            fenceChar = "";
            fenceLen = 0;
          }
          continue;
        }
        if (inComment) {
          if (line.text.indexOf("-->") >= 0) inComment = false;
          continue;
        }
        const openComment = line.text.indexOf("<!--");
        if (openComment >= 0) {
          if (line.text.indexOf("-->", openComment + 4) < 0) inComment = true;
          continue;
        }
        const openFence = /^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})/.exec(line.text);
        if (openFence) {
          fenceChar = openFence[1].charAt(0);
          fenceLen = openFence[1].length;
        }
      }
      return marks;
    }

    function parseEntryTail(rawPercent, restText) {

    function scanProgressSection(lines, marks, section) {

    const PixelIssueCard = function(props) {
      const p3 = props || {};
      const cx2 = React.useContext(DswsCtx);
      const h4 = cx2 ? cx2.h : React.createElement;
      const st = CARD_ACTION_STYLE[p3.action || "execute"] || CARD_ACTION_STYLE.execute;
      const mainColor = cardColorOf(st.colorKey, p3.colorOf || null);
      const blocked = !!(p3.blockedBy && p3.blockedBy.no);
      const onCard = typeof p3.onCard === "function" ? p3.onCard : null;
      const canOpen = onCard !== null;
      const ini = p3.lit === void 0 ? false : !!p3.lit;
      const pair = React.useState(ini);
      const lit = p3.lit !== void 0 ? !!p3.lit : pair[0];
      const setLit = pair[1];
      const flip = function(v3) {
        if (p3.lit === void 0) setLit(v3);
        if (p3.onLitChange) p3.onLitChange(v3);
        try {
          const doc = typeof document !== "undefined" ? document : null;
          const o3 = doc && p3.blockedBy && p3.blockedBy.cardId ? doc.getElementById(String(p3.blockedBy.cardId)) : null;
          if (o3 && o3.classList) {
            if (v3) o3.classList.add("lit");
            else o3.classList.remove("lit");
          }
        } catch (err) {
        }
      };
      const logKey = "issue." + (String(p3.noText || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "").slice(0, 24) || "x");
      const cls = "cd-card" + (p3.closed ? " old closed" : "") + (blocked && !lit ? " dim" : "") + (lit ? " lit" : "");
      const corner = p3.bugCorner ? "bug" : p3.closed ? null : p3.pickCorner === "ready" ? "ready" : p3.pickCorner === "doing" ? "doing" : null;
      const setLitNow = function(e3, v3) {
        try {
          const el = e3 && e3.currentTarget ? e3.currentTarget : null;
          if (el && el.classList) {
            if (v3) el.classList.add("lit");
            else el.classList.remove("lit");
          }
        } catch (err) {
        }
      };
      const kids = [];
      kids.push(h4(PixelCardPin, { key: "pin", kind: p3.closed ? "tape" : void 0 }));
      if (corner) kids.push(h4(PixelCornerMark, { key: "cor", kind: corner }));
      const headNo = h4(PixelCardNo, { key: "no", text: p3.noText, action: p3.action, colorOf: p3.colorOf || null });
      kids.push(h4("div", { key: "hd", className: "cd-hd" }, [headNo, p3.closed ? h4(PixelClosedSeal, { key: "c" }) : null]));
      if (blocked && p3.blockedBy) kids.push(h4(PixelBlockedSeal, { key: "bs", no: p3.blockedBy.no, title: p3.blockedBy.title || "", onActivate: canOpen ? function() {
        flip(!lit);
      } : null }));
      const suffix = p3.claimedBy ? h4("span", { className: "cd-take" }, tr("card.claimedBy", { n: p3.claimedBy })) : null;
      kids.push(h4(PixelCardTitle, { key: "tt", text: p3.title, suffix }));
      kids.push(h4(PixelCardTags, { key: "tg", tags: p3.tags || [] }));
      if (p3.note) kids.push(h4(PixelCardNote, { key: "nt", text: p3.note }));
      kids.push(h4(PixelCardBtns, { key: "ab", logKey, mainLabel: tr("card.act." + (p3.action || "execute")), icon: st.icon, mainColor, onMain: p3.onMain || null, onNew: p3.onNew || null, onCopy: p3.onCopy || null, onOpen: p3.onOpen || null }));
      if (p3.blocksChip) kids.push(h4(PixelBlockerChip, { key: "chip", no: p3.blocksChip.no, title: p3.blocksChip.title }));
      kids.push(h4(PixelCardFoot, { key: "ft", left: tr("card.updated", { n: p3.updatedText || "" }), right: p3.footActionText || "" }));
      if (blocked) kids.push(h4(PixelDimVeil, { key: "veil", quiet: !!(p3.blockedBy && p3.blockedBy.title) }));
      const attrs = { className: cls, style: { "--cd-act": "#" + mainColor } };
      if (blocked || canOpen) attrs.style.cursor = "pointer";
      if (p3.cardId) attrs.id = p3.cardId;
      if (blocked) {
        Object.assign(attrs, {
          tabIndex: 0,
          onFocus: function(e3) {
            if (e3 && e3.target === e3.currentTarget) {
              setLitNow(e3, true);
              flip(true);
            }
          },
          onBlur: function(e3) {
            setLitNow(e3, false);
            try {
              if (e3 && e3.currentTarget && e3.relatedTarget && e3.currentTarget.contains(e3.relatedTarget)) return;
            } catch (err) {
            }
            flip(false);
          }
        });
        if (!canOpen) {
          attrs["data-press"] = "row";
          attrs["data-log"] = "card.issue." + logKey + ".row";
          attrs.onClick = function(e3) {
            setLitNow(e3, true);
            flip(true);
          };
        }
      }
      if (canOpen) {
        attrs.tabIndex = 0;
        attrs.role = "button";
        attrs["data-press"] = "row";
        attrs["data-log"] = "card.issue." + logKey + ".card";
        attrs.onClick = function(e3) {
          try {
            if (e3 && e3.stopPropagation) e3.stopPropagation();
          } catch (err) {
          }
          if (onCard) onCard();
        };
        attrs.onKeyDown = function(e3) {
          if (!e3 || e3.target !== e3.currentTarget) return;
          const k4 = e3.key;
          if (k4 === "Enter" || k4 === " ") {
            try {
              if (e3.preventDefault) e3.preventDefault();
            } catch (err) {
            }
            if (onCard) onCard();
          }
        };
      }
      return h4("div", attrs, kids);
    };

      // 第二行三张宽卡」这种同一页里卡片宽窄不一的情况；栅格一次算出列数，所有行共用同一套列宽。

      // 480px → 2 列、208px（按钮只剩图标，这就是最小宽度）；1200px → 5 列、约 220px。
      ".m2v2-flow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(var(--m2v2-card-min,208px),100%),1fr));gap:18px 16px;margin-top:6px;min-width:0}",
      // 面板本身比最小宽度还窄时（极窄侧栏），min(…,100%) 让卡片跟着面板继续缩，不要横向溢出。
      ".m2v2-flow .cd-card{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:300px}",
