    const CHAIN_RENDERER_VERSION = 1;
    const checkShowTitle = function(show, fallbackId) {
      try {
        const key = show && show.i18nKey;
        if (key && typeof tr === "function") {
          const v3 = tr(key);
          if (typeof v3 === "string" && v3 && v3 !== key) return v3;
        }
      } catch (e3) {
      }
      try {
        if (show && typeof show.fallback === "string" && show.fallback) return show.fallback;
        if (show && typeof show.title === "string" && show.title) return show.title;
      } catch (e22) {
      }
      return fallbackId || "";
    };
    function levelToClass(level) {
      const s3 = String(level || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      if (s3 === "bad" || s3 === "error") return "bad";
      if (s3 === "warn" || s3 === "warning") return "warn";
      return "info";
    }
    function levelToStyle(level) {
      const k4 = levelToClass(level);
      if (k4 === "warn") return { background: "rgba(245,158,11,.12)", borderColor: "rgba(245,158,11,.45)", color: "#f59e0b" };
      if (k4 === "bad") return { background: "rgba(248,113,113,.12)", border: "1px solid rgba(248,113,113,.45)", color: "#f87171" };
      return { background: "rgba(56,139,253,.10)", border: "1px solid rgba(56,139,253,.35)", color: "#58a6ff" };
    }
    function ActionButton({ action, dispatcher, st, logId }) {
      const cx2 = React.useContext(DswsCtx);
      const h4 = cx2 ? cx2.h : React.createElement;
      const t3 = action && action.type;
      const labelMap = {
        "inject-prompt": action.label || tr("env.actInjectGuide"),
        "open-url": tr("env.actOpenUrl"),
        "rpc": action.method || action.endpoint || tr("env.actRun"),
        "form": action.label || tr("env.actFillForm"),
        "refresh": tr("env.actRefresh")
      };
      const label = labelMap[t3] || "unsupported: " + String(t3 || "unknown");
      const isUnsupported = !labelMap[t3];
      const onClick = async function() {
        if (isUnsupported) {
          try {
            flash(st, tr("env.actUnknown", { t: String(t3) }), "warn");
          } catch (e3) {
          }
          return;
        }
        try {
          const res = await dispatcher.dispatch(action);
          if (!res.ok) {
            const kind = res.error && res.error.kind;
            if (kind === "unsupported") {
              try {
                flash(st, tr("env.actUnsupported", { t: String(t3) }), "warn");
              } catch (e3) {
              }
            } else {
              try {
                flash(st, String(res.error && res.error.message || tr("env.actFailed")), "warn");
              } catch (e3) {
              }
            }
          } else {
          }
        } catch (e3) {
          try {
            flash(st, String(e3 && e3.message || e3).slice(0, 200), "warn");
          } catch (_3) {
          }
        }
      };
      if (isUnsupported) {
        return h4(Tip, { content: tr("tip.unsupportedAction") }, h4("span", { className: "dsws-chain-unsupported", style: { fontSize: 10, color: "#8b8b95", border: "1px dashed rgba(139,139,149,.45)", borderRadius: 4, padding: "1px 6px", display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center" } }, label));
      }
      return h4("button", { className: "dsws-btn dsws-hov", tabIndex: 0, "data-press": "button", "data-log": "chain.action." + String(logId || "x"), onClick, onKeyDown: function(e3) {
        if (e3.key === "Enter" || e3.key === " ") {
          e3.preventDefault();
          onClick();
        }
      }, style: { fontSize: 11, padding: "2px 8px", display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, flex: "none" } }, label);
    }
    function ChainForm({ action, dispatcher, st }) {
      const cx2 = React.useContext(DswsCtx);
      const h4 = cx2 ? cx2.h : React.createElement;
      const schema = action.schema || action.fields || action.form && action.form.fields || [];
      const [vals, setVals] = React.useState(function() {
        const init = {};
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < schema.length; i3++) {
          const f3 = schema[i3];
          if (f3.defaultValue != null) init[f3.name] = String(f3.defaultValue);
        }
        return init;
      });
      const submitAction = action.submitAction || action.submit || action.form && action.form.submit;
      const onSubmit = async function() {
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < schema.length; i3++) {
          const f3 = schema[i3];
          if (f3.required && !String(vals[f3.name] || "").trim()) {
            try {
              flash(st, tr("env.formRequired", { label: String(f3.label || f3.name) }), "warn");
            } catch (e3) {
            }
            ;
            return;
          }
          if (f3.pattern) {
            try {
              const re = new RegExp(f3.pattern);
              if (!re.test(String(vals[f3.name] || ""))) {
                try {
                  flash(st, tr("env.formPattern", { label: String(f3.label || f3.name) }), "warn");
                } catch (e3) {
                }
                ;
                return;
              }
            } catch (e3) {
            }
          }
        }
        if (!submitAction) {
          try {
            flash(st, tr("env.formNoSubmit"), "warn");
          } catch (e3) {
          }
          ;
          return;
        }
        const merged = Object.assign({}, submitAction);
        const base = merged.params !== void 0 ? merged.params : merged.args;
        if (merged.type === "inject-prompt") {
          merged.args = Object.assign({}, merged.args || merged.params || {}, vals);
        } else {
          merged.params = Object.assign({}, base || {}, vals);
          if (submitAction.args) merged.args = merged.params;
        }
        try {
          const res = await dispatcher.dispatch(merged);
          if (!res.ok) {
            try {
              flash(st, String(res.error && res.error.message || tr("env.formSubmitFail")), "warn");
            } catch (e3) {
            }
          } else {
            try {
              flash(st, tr("env.formSubmitted"), "ok");
            } catch (e3) {
            }
            try {
              if (dispatcher && dispatcher._refresh) await dispatcher._refresh();
              else if (typeof host !== "undefined" && host.call) {
                await host.call("wf.detect", { cwd: st.cwd || "", force: true, backendId: (typeof userHintOf === "function" ? userHintOf(st.selection) : void 0) || void 0 });
                if (st.cwd) {
                  try {
                    loadSnapshot(st, true, true);
                  } catch (e3) {
                  }
                  ;
                  try {
                    loadChain(st, true);
                  } catch (e3) {
                  }
                }
              }
            } catch (e3) {
            }
          }
        } catch (e3) {
          try {
            flash(st, String(e3 && e3.message || e3).slice(0, 200), "warn");
          } catch (_3) {
          }
        }
      };
      const fields = schema.map(function(f3, idx) {
        const id = "chain-form-" + String(action.type || "form") + "-" + String(f3.name || idx);
        const label = f3.label || f3.labelKey || f3.name;
        const placeholder = f3.placeholder || f3.placeholderKey || "";
        const isSingle = f3.type === "single";
        const isMulti = f3.type === "multi";
        return h4("div", { key: f3.name || idx, style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 4, marginBottom: 6 } }, [
          h4("label", { htmlFor: id, style: { fontSize: 11, color: "#a1a1aa", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 } }, [h4("span", null, label), f3.required ? h4("span", { style: { color: "#f87171" } }, "*") : null]),
          isSingle ? h4("select", { id, value: String(vals[f3.name] || ""), onChange: function(e3) {
            const nxt = Object.assign({}, vals);
            nxt[f3.name] = e3.target.value;
            setVals(nxt);
          }, style: { fontSize: 12, padding: "4px 8px", borderRadius: 6, border: "1px solid #2a2d35", background: "#10131a", color: "#e6edf3" } }, [
            h4("option", { value: "" }, placeholder || tr("env.formPick")),
            ...(f3.options || []).map(function(opt) {
              return h4("option", { key: opt, value: opt }, opt);
            })
          ]) : isMulti ? h4("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 4 } }, (f3.options || []).map(function(opt) {
            const checked = Array.isArray(vals[f3.name]) ? vals[f3.name].indexOf(opt) >= 0 : false;
            return h4("label", { key: opt, style: { display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 4, fontSize: 11, border: "1px solid #2a2d35", borderRadius: 6, padding: "2px 6px", cursor: "pointer", background: checked ? "rgba(88,166,255,.12)" : "transparent" } }, [
              h4("input", { type: "checkbox", checked, onChange: function(e3) {
                const arr = Array.isArray(vals[f3.name]) ? vals[f3.name].slice() : [];
                if (e3.target.checked) {
                  if (arr.indexOf(opt) < 0) arr.push(opt);
                } else {
                  const p3 = arr.indexOf(opt);
                  if (p3 >= 0) arr.splice(p3, 1);
                }
                const nxt = Object.assign({}, vals);
                nxt[f3.name] = arr;
                setVals(nxt);
              } }),
              h4("span", null, opt)
            ]);
          })) : h4("input", { id, type: f3.type === "number" ? "number" : f3.type === "date" ? "date" : "text", value: String(vals[f3.name] || ""), placeholder, onChange: function(e3) {
            const nxt = Object.assign({}, vals);
            nxt[f3.name] = e3.target.value;
            setVals(nxt);
          }, style: { fontSize: 12, padding: "4px 8px", borderRadius: 6, border: "1px solid #2a2d35", background: "#10131a", color: "#e6edf3" } })
        ]);
      });
      return h4("div", { className: "dsws-chain-form", style: { border: "1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)", borderRadius: 8, padding: "10px 12px", background: "rgba(255,255,255,.02)", marginTop: 8 } }, [
        ...fields,
        h4("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: 6, justifyContent: "flex-end", marginTop: 6 } }, [
          // 接线（#1335 界面反馈）：表单底下两颗（重置、提交）是两种动作，各接一组定位名。
          h4("button", { className: "dsws-btn dsws-hov", "data-press": "button", "data-log": "chain.form.reset", onClick: function() {
            const init = {};
            for (let i3 = 0; i3 < schema.length; i3++) {
              const f3 = schema[i3];
              if (f3.defaultValue != null) init[f3.name] = String(f3.defaultValue);
              else init[f3.name] = "";
            }
            setVals(init);
          }, style: { fontSize: 11, padding: "2px 8px" } }, tr("env.formReset")),
          h4("button", { className: "dsws-btn primary dsws-hov", "data-press": "button", "data-log": "chain.form.submit", onClick: onSubmit, style: { fontSize: 11, padding: "2px 10px", background: "#58a6ff", borderColor: "#58a6ff", color: "#0b1220", fontWeight: 600 } }, tr("env.formSubmit"))
        ])
      ]);
    }
    function ChainSteps({ snapshot }) {
      const cx2 = React.useContext(DswsCtx);
      const h4 = cx2 ? cx2.h : React.createElement;
      if (!snapshot || !Array.isArray(snapshot.steps) || !snapshot.steps.length) return null;

        const status = s3.status;
        const isDone = status === "done";
        const isCurrent = s3.isCurrent || status === "current";
        const isFail = status === "fail";
        const isPending = status === "pending";
        const bg = isDone ? "#16a34a" : isCurrent ? "#f59e0b" : isFail ? "#ef4444" : "#6b7280";
        const border = isCurrent ? "2px solid #f59e0b" : "1px solid transparent";
        const title = checkShowTitle(s3.show, s3.id);
        const detail = s3.show && (s3.show.desc || "") || "";
        return h4(Tip, { content: h4("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 2 } }, [h4("div", { style: { fontSize: 10, color: "#8b8b95", lineHeight: "14px" } }, tr("tip.header.milestone", { idx: idx + 1 })), h4("div", { style: { fontSize: 11, color: "#e6edf3", lineHeight: "16px", wordBreak: "break-word", whiteSpace: "normal" } }, title + (detail ? " — " + detail : "")), h4("div", { style: { fontSize: 10, color: "#8b8b95", lineHeight: "14px", marginTop: 2 } }, tr("tip.milestoneLocate"))]) }, h4("div", { key: s3.id || idx, tabIndex: 0, style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6, flex: "none", border, borderRadius: 20, padding: "2px 8px 2px 4px", background: isCurrent ? "rgba(245,158,11,.12)" : "rgba(255,255,255,.04)", minHeight: 24 } }, [
          h4("span", { style: { width: 18, height: 18, borderRadius: "50%", background: bg, color: "#fff", display: "inline-flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, flex: "none" } }, isDone ? "✓" : String(idx + 1)),
          h4("span", { style: { fontSize: 11, color: isDone ? "#4ade80" : isFail ? "#f87171" : isCurrent ? "#f59e0b" : "#a1a1aa", whiteSpace: "nowrap", maxWidth: 120, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" } }, title)
        ]));
      }));
    }
    const ChainBanner = function({ snapshot, dispatcher, st }) {
      const cx2 = React.useContext(DswsCtx);
      const h4 = cx2 ? cx2.h : React.createElement;
      if (!snapshot || !Array.isArray(snapshot.steps)) return null;
      const curIdx = snapshot.currentIndex;
      const curStep = curIdx != null && snapshot.steps[curIdx] ? snapshot.steps[curIdx] : null;
      let step = curStep;
      if (!step) {
        if (!snapshot.steps.length || snapshot.chainState === "allDone") return null;
        step = snapshot.steps.find(function(s3) {
          return s3.status === "fail";
        }) || null;
        if (!step) return null;
      }
      const show = step.show || {};
      const title = checkShowTitle(show, step.id || "");
      const desc = show.desc || "";
      const level = show.level || (step.status === "fail" ? "bad" : step.status === "pending" ? "warn" : "info");
      const styleBase = levelToStyle(level);
      const actions = Array.isArray(step.actions) ? step.actions : [];
      const formActions = actions.filter(function(a3) {
        return a3 && a3.type === "form";
      });
      const otherActions = actions.filter(function(a3) {
        return !a3 || a3.type !== "form";
      });
      const unsupported = actions.filter(function(a3) {
        return a3 && ["inject-prompt", "open-url", "rpc", "form", "refresh"].indexOf(String(a3.type)) < 0;
      });
      return h4("div", { className: "dsws-banner dsws-chain-banner dsws-chain-banner--" + levelToClass(level), tabIndex: 0, role: "status", "aria-live": "polite", "aria-label": title, style: Object.assign({}, styleBase, { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, borderRadius: 8, padding: "6px 10px", minHeight: 42, maxHeight: 42, height: 42, margin: "6px 0", cursor: "default", flex: "none", overflow: "hidden" }) }, [
        h4("span", { style: { width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: "50%", background: levelToClass(level) === "bad" ? "#ef4444" : levelToClass(level) === "warn" ? "#f59e0b" : "#58a6ff", display: "inline-block", flex: "none" } }),
        h4("span", { style: { flex: 1, minWidth: 0, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 } }, title + (desc ? " — " + String(desc).slice(0, 120) : "")),
        ...otherActions.map(function(a3, i3) {
          return h4(ActionButton, { key: "act-" + i3, action: a3, dispatcher, st, logId: String(i3) });
        }),
        ...unsupported.length ? unsupported.map(function(a3, i3) {
          return h4(ActionButton, { key: "unsup-" + i3, action: a3, dispatcher, st, logId: "unsup." + i3 });
        }) : [],
        // 表单动作内嵌（fail+form 场景）
        ...formActions.length ? [h4("span", { key: "chain-form-hint", style: { fontSize: 10, color: "#8b8b95" } }, "↘")] : []
      ].concat(formActions.length ? [h4("div", { key: "chain-form-slot", style: { position: "absolute" } }, [])] : []));
    };
    const ChainRenderer = function({ snapshot, dispatcher, st, showSteps = true }) {
      const cx2 = React.useContext(DswsCtx);
      const h4 = cx2 ? cx2.h : React.createElement;
      if (!snapshot) return null;
      const hasSteps = Array.isArray(snapshot.steps) && snapshot.steps.length > 0;
      if (!hasSteps) return null;
      return h4("div", { className: "dsws-chain-renderer", style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" } }, [
        // #296 实机反馈：水平步进条与下方垂直明细信息重复，检查页隐藏（组件保留，其他宿主按需开启）
        showSteps ? h4(ChainSteps, { snapshot }) : null,
        h4(ChainBanner, { snapshot, dispatcher, st }),
        // chainState 调试用（仅开发时可见，生产可隐藏；暂展示 small）
        snapshot.chainState === "allDone" ? h4("div", { style: { fontSize: 10, color: "#4ade80", padding: "2px 6px" } }, tr("env.chainDone")) : null
      ]);
    };
    function isSupportedActionType(type) {
      return ["inject-prompt", "open-url", "rpc", "form", "refresh"].indexOf(String(type)) >= 0;
    }
    const VC_CHANGE_KEY = {
      // 注明 Record<string, string> 只为过类型检查（vcChangeKeyOf 拿变量取值）；
      //   转译后与原来一字不差，键的书写顺序也没动。
      added: "vc.change.added",
      modified: "vc.change.modified",
      deleted: "vc.change.deleted",
      renamed: "vc.change.renamed",
      typechange: "vc.change.typechange",
      untracked: "vc.change.untracked"
    };
    const VC_CHANGE_TONE = {
      added: "success",
      modified: "warning",
      deleted: "error",
      renamed: "accent",
      typechange: "accent",
      untracked: "caption"
    };
    const vcChangeKeyOf = function(change) {
      return VC_CHANGE_KEY[String(change)] || "vc.change.modified";
    };
    const vcChangeToneOf = function(change) {
      return VC_CHANGE_TONE[String(change)] || "warning";
    };
    const vcTail = function(text2, maxChars) {
      const s3 = String(text2 === null || text2 === void 0 ? "" : text2);
      const cp = Array.from(s3);
      const n2 = Math.floor(Number(maxChars));
      if (!isFinite(n2) || n2 <= 0) return s3;
      if (cp.length <= n2) return s3;
      if (n2 === 1) return "…";
      return cp.slice(0, n2 - 1).join("") + "…";
    };
    const VC_MIDDLE_MIN = 10;
    const vcMiddle = function(path, maxLen) {
      const p3 = String(path === null || path === void 0 ? "" : path);
      const cp = Array.from(p3);
      const n2 = Math.floor(Number(maxLen));
      if (!isFinite(n2) || cp.length <= n2 || n2 < VC_MIDDLE_MIN) return p3;
      const keep = n2 - 1;
      const headLen = Math.ceil(keep * 0.4);
      return cp.slice(0, headLen).join("") + "…" + cp.slice(cp.length - (keep - headLen)).join("");
    };
    const vcOneLine = function(text2, maxChars) {
      const s3 = String(text2 === null || text2 === void 0 ? "" : text2).replace(/\r/g, "").split("\n")[0].trim();
      const n2 = Math.floor(Number(maxChars));
      if (!isFinite(n2) || n2 <= 0) return s3;
      const cp = Array.from(s3);
      return cp.length <= n2 ? s3 : cp.slice(0, n2 - 1).join("") + "…";
    };
    const vcShortOid = function(oid) {
      const s3 = String(oid === null || oid === void 0 ? "" : oid).trim();
      return s3.length <= 12 ? s3 : s3.slice(0, 12);
    };
    const vcPlusMinus = function(added, deleted) {
      const a3 = added === null || added === void 0 ? null : Number(added);
      const d3 = deleted === null || deleted === void 0 ? null : Number(deleted);
      if (a3 === null || d3 === null || !isFinite(a3) || !isFinite(d3)) return "";
      return "+" + String(a3) + " −" + String(d3);
    };
    const vcTimeKind = function(nowMs, ms) {
      const now = Number(nowMs);
      const t0 = Number(ms);
      if (!isFinite(now) || !isFinite(t0)) return "absolute";
      const diff = now - t0;
      if (diff >= 0 && diff < VC_RELATIVE_WINDOW_MS) return "relative";
      return "absolute";
    };
    const vcPad2 = function(n2) {
      return (n2 < 10 ? "0" : "") + String(n2);
    };
    const vcClockText = function(t3, ms) {
      const d3 = new Date(Number(ms));
      return t3("vc.time.absolute", {
        y: String(d3.getFullYear()),
        m: vcPad2(d3.getMonth() + 1),
        d: vcPad2(d3.getDate()),
        hh: vcPad2(d3.getHours()),
        mm: vcPad2(d3.getMinutes())
      });
    };
    const vcWhenText = function(t3, nowMs, ms) {
      if (ms === null || ms === void 0 || ms === "") return "";
      const t0 = Number(ms);
      if (!isFinite(t0) || t0 <= 0) return "";
      if (vcTimeKind(nowMs, t0) === "absolute") return vcClockText(t3, t0);
      const minutes = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Number(nowMs) - t0) / 6e4));
      if (minutes < 1) return t3("vc.ago.justNow");
      if (minutes < 60) return t3("vc.ago.minutes", { n: String(minutes) });
      const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
      if (hours < 24) return t3("vc.ago.hours", { n: String(hours) });
      return t3("vc.ago.days", { n: String(Math.floor(hours / 24)) });
    };
    const vcBasisText = function(t3, nowMs, basisMs) {
      const b3 = Number(basisMs);
      if (basisMs === null || basisMs === void 0 || !isFinite(b3) || b3 <= 0) return t3("vc.basis.unknown");
      return t3("vc.basis.at", { when: vcWhenText(t3, nowMs, b3) });
    };
    const VC_FOLD_BANDS = [420, 360, 300];
    const VC_FOLD_STEP_CAP = 120;
    const vcFoldBandAt = function(availWidthPx) {
      const w4 = Number(availWidthPx);
      if (!isFinite(w4) || w4 <= 0) return 0;
      if (w4 >= VC_FOLD_BANDS[0]) return 0;
      if (w4 >= VC_FOLD_BANDS[1]) return 1;
      if (w4 >= VC_FOLD_BANDS[2]) return 2;
      return 3;
    };
    const vcFoldDataOf = function(screen, reads, labels) {
      const s3 = screen || {};
      const identity = s3.identity || {};
      const others = Array.isArray(s3.otherWorktrees) ? s3.otherWorktrees : [];
      const commits = vcCommitListOf(s3, reads);
      return {
        path: String(identity.worktreePath || ""),
        others: others.map(function(w4) {
          return String(w4 && w4.display || "");
        }),
        commits: commits.map(function(c3) {
          return String(c3 && c3.subject || "");
        }),
        // #842 写操作那四颗按钮的文字也进阶梯（顺序见 vcFoldLadderOf）：窄面板下它们逐字让位，
        //   完整文字留在悬停提示里一个字不丢。没传 labels 的老调用方拿到的还是老形状（actions: null）。
        actions: labels ? { push: String(labels.push || ""), pull: String(labels.pull || ""), stageAll: String(labels.stageAll || ""), commit: String(labels.commit || "") } : null
      };
    };
    const vcCommitListOf = function(screen, reads) {
      const first = screen && Array.isArray(screen.commits) ? screen.commits : [];
      const log2 = reads && reads.log && Array.isArray(reads.log.commits) ? reads.log.commits : [];
      const out = [];
      const seen = {};
      const push = function(c3) {
        if (!c3) return;
        const k4 = String(c3.oid || "") || String(c3.short || "") + "|" + String(c3.subject || "");
        if (seen[k4]) return;
        seen[k4] = true;
        out.push(c3);
      };
      first.forEach(push);
      log2.forEach(push);
      return out;
    };
    const vcFoldLadderOf = function(data) {
      const d3 = data || {};
      const acts = d3.actions || null;
      const ladder = {
        path: String(d3.path || ""),
        others: (Array.isArray(d3.others) ? d3.others : []).map(function(x4) {
          return String(x4 || "");
        }),
        commits: (Array.isArray(d3.commits) ? d3.commits : []).map(function(x4) {
          return String(x4 || "");
        }),
        actions: acts ? { push: String(acts.push || ""), pull: String(acts.pull || ""), stageAll: String(acts.stageAll || ""), commit: String(acts.commit || "") } : null,
        steps: []
      };
      const push = function(el, i3, n2) {
        for (let k4 = 1; k4 <= n2; k4++) ladder.steps.push({ el, i: i3, n: k4 });
      };
      const len = function(s3) {
        return Array.from(String(s3 || "")).length;
      };
      push("path", -1, Math.max(0, len(ladder.path) - VC_MIDDLE_MIN));
      if (ladder.actions) {
        const first = ["push", "pull", "stageAll"];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < first.length; i3++) push("action", first[i3], len(ladder.actions[first[i3]]));
      }
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < ladder.others.length; i3++) push("other", i3, len(ladder.others[i3]));
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < ladder.commits.length; i3++) push("commit", i3, len(ladder.commits[i3]));
      if (ladder.actions) push("action", "commit", len(ladder.actions.commit));
      if (ladder.steps.length > VC_FOLD_STEP_CAP) ladder.steps = ladder.steps.slice(0, VC_FOLD_STEP_CAP);
      return ladder;
    };
    const vcFoldStateAt = function(ladder, tier) {
      const l3 = ladder || { path: "", others: [], commits: [], steps: [] };
      const steps = Array.isArray(l3.steps) ? l3.steps : [];
      const n2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.floor(Number(tier) || 0), steps.length));
      let pathDrop = 0;
      const otherDrop = {};
      const commitDrop = {};
      const actionDrop = {};
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < n2; i3++) {
        const s3 = steps[i3];
        if (s3.el === "path") pathDrop = s3.n;
        else if (s3.el === "other") otherDrop[s3.i] = s3.n;
        else if (s3.el === "commit") commitDrop[s3.i] = s3.n;
        else if (s3.el === "action") actionDrop[s3.i] = s3.n;
      }
      const cpLen = function(s3) {
        return Array.from(String(s3 || "")).length;
      };
      const tailAt = function(text2, drop) {
        const keep = cpLen(text2) - drop;
        return keep <= 0 ? "" : vcTail(text2, keep);
      };
      const path = l3.path ? pathDrop >= cpLen(l3.path) ? "" : vcMiddle(l3.path, cpLen(l3.path) - pathDrop) : "";
      const acts = l3.actions || null;
      return {
        tier: n2,
        path,
        others: l3.others.map(function(text2, i3) {
          return tailAt(text2, otherDrop[i3] || 0);
        }),
        commits: l3.commits.map(function(text2, i3) {
          return tailAt(text2, commitDrop[i3] || 0);
        }),
        // #842：四颗写操作按钮在这一档各自该画几个字（完整文字在调用方的悬停提示里）。
        actions: acts ? {
          push: tailAt(acts.push, actionDrop.push || 0),
          pull: tailAt(acts.pull, actionDrop.pull || 0),
          stageAll: tailAt(acts.stageAll, actionDrop.stageAll || 0),
          commit: tailAt(acts.commit, actionDrop.commit || 0)
        } : null
      };
    };
    const vcFoldOf = function(availWidthPx, data) {
      const band = vcFoldBandAt(availWidthPx);
      const ladder = vcFoldLadderOf(data);
      return {
        band,
        otherMode: band >= 1 ? "summary" : "list",
        commitsCollapsed: band >= 3,
        ladder,
        state: vcFoldStateAt(ladder, 0)
      };
    };
    const VC_DIFF_LINES_SHOWN = 200;
    const VC_DIFF_REASON_KEY = {
      // 标注 Record<string, string> 只为过类型检查（下面拿宿主回的变量 reason 取值）；
      //   转译后与原来一字不差，键的书写顺序也没动。
      "untracked-no-diff": "vc.diff.untracked",
      "no-commit-baseline": "vc.diff.noBaseline",
      "no-diff": "vc.diff.empty",
      "binary-diff": "vc.diff.binary",
      "truncated": "vc.diff.tooBig",
      // 合并提交：git show -p 默认不展开组合差异，所以这一处本来就没有内容 —— 这不是「读不到」，
      //   是 git 不展开合并提交（宿主用 reason:'merge-commit' 与「空提交」的 'no-diff' 分开说）。
      "merge-commit": "vc.diff.mergeCommit"
    };
    const vcDiffViewOf = function(entry, t3, scopeKey) {
      const scopeText = scopeKey ? t3(scopeKey) : "";
      const e3 = entry || { state: "idle" };
      if (e3.state === "idle" || e3.state === "loading" && !e3.lines) return { state: "loading", text: t3("vc.diff.loading") };
      if (e3.state === "err" && !e3.lines) return { state: "err", text: t3("vc.diff.fail"), retry: t3("vc.retry") };
      const raw = Array.isArray(e3.lines) ? e3.lines : [];
      const reason = String(e3.reason || "ok");
      if (reason !== "ok") {
        const key = VC_DIFF_REASON_KEY[reason];
        return { state: "note", text: key ? t3(key) : t3("vc.diff.empty"), stale: e3.state === "err", retry: e3.state === "err" ? t3("vc.retry") : "" };
      }
      const hunkLines = [];
      raw.forEach(function(l3) {
        if (l3 && l3.kind === "hunk") hunkLines.push(String(l3.text || ""));
      });
      const long = raw.length > VC_DIFF_LINES_SHOWN;
      return {
        state: "ok",
        lines: raw.slice(0, VC_DIFF_LINES_SHOWN),
        total: raw.length,
        scopeText,
        hunks: long ? hunkLines : [],
        hunksTitle: t3("vc.diff.hunksTitle"),
        shownNote: long ? t3("vc.diff.shownHead", { n: String(VC_DIFF_LINES_SHOWN) }) : "",
        stale: e3.state === "err",
        retry: e3.state === "err" ? t3("vc.retry") : ""
      };
    };
    const vcCommitModeOf = function(ui) {
      return ui && ui.openCommit ? String(ui.openCommit) : "";
    };
    const vcCommitBlockOf = function(screen, reads, ui, t3, nowMs, shownOf, rowViewOf) {
      const rev = vcCommitModeOf(ui);
      if (!rev) return null;
      const entry = reads && reads.commit || {};
      const mine = entry.rev === rev ? entry : { state: "loading", files: [], truncated: false, reason: "", error: null };
      const commits = screen && Array.isArray(screen.commits) ? screen.commits : [];
      const hit = commits.filter(function(c3) {
        return String(c3.oid || "") === rev || String(c3.short || "") === rev;
      })[0] || null;
      const parents = hit && Array.isArray(hit.parents) ? hit.parents.length : 0;
      const short = hit ? String(hit.short || vcShortOid(hit.oid)) : rev;
      const subject = hit ? String(hit.subject || "") : "";
      const files = mine.state === "ok" && mine.truncated !== true && Array.isArray(mine.files) ? mine.files : [];
      const rows = files.map(function(f3) {
        return rowViewOf({
          path: String(f3 && f3.path || ""),
          origPath: f3 && f3.origPath ? String(f3.origPath) : null,
          staged: false,
          unstaged: false,
          conflict: false,
          change: f3 && f3.origPath ? "renamed" : "modified",
          changeProven: !!(f3 && f3.origPath),
          // 判不出类型的那一行，悬停里如实说清来由（词条 vc.row.typeUnknown）。
          typeTip: f3 && f3.origPath ? "" : t3("vc.row.typeUnknown"),
          addedLines: f3 && f3.added !== void 0 ? f3.added : null,
          deletedLines: f3 && f3.deleted !== void 0 ? f3.deleted : null
        });
      });
      let note = "";
      let retry = "";
      if (mine.state === "loading" && rows.length === 0) note = t3("vc.commit.loading");
      else if (mine.state === "err" && rows.length === 0) {
        note = t3("vc.commit.fail");
        retry = t3("vc.retry");
      } else if (mine.truncated === true) note = t3("vc.commit.truncated");
      else if (mine.state === "ok" && rows.length === 0) note = parents > 1 ? t3("vc.commit.merge") : t3("vc.commit.empty");
      const n2 = shownOf("commit");
      const shown = rows.slice(0, n2);
      const moreCount = Math.max(0, rows.length - n2);
      return {
        kind: "changes",
        key: "commit",
        commitMode: true,
        title: t3("vc.commit.title"),
        back: t3("vc.commit.back"),
        backTip: t3("vc.commit.tip"),
        summary: short + (subject ? " · " + subject : ""),
        when: hit ? vcWhenText(t3, nowMs, hit.commitDateMs !== void 0 && hit.commitDateMs !== null ? hit.commitDateMs : hit.authorDateMs) : "",
        note,
        retry,
        loading: mine.state === "loading" && rows.length === 0,
        empty: false,
        emptyText: "",
        groups: rows.length === 0 ? [] : [{
          key: "commit",
          title: t3("vc.commit.files", { n: String(rows.length) }),
          count: rows.length,
          rows: shown,
          moreCount,
          moreLabel: t3("vc.more", { n: String(moreCount) })
        }]
      };
    };
    const vcGroupOfRow = function(row) {
      if (row.conflict) return "conflict";
      return row.group === "unstaged" ? "unstaged" : "staged";
    };
    const vcFileRowsOf = function(screen) {
      const staged = screen && Array.isArray(screen.staged) ? screen.staged : [];
      const unstaged = screen && Array.isArray(screen.unstaged) ? screen.unstaged : [];
      const all = [];
      staged.forEach(function(f3) {
        if (f3) all.push({ f: f3, group: "staged" });
      });
      unstaged.forEach(function(f3) {
        if (f3) all.push({ f: f3, group: "unstaged" });
      });
      const pathCount = {};
      all.forEach(function(x4) {
        const p3 = String(x4.f.path || "");
        if (p3) pathCount[p3] = (pathCount[p3] || 0) + 1;
      });
      const rows = [];
      const conflictSeen = {};
      all.forEach(function(x4) {
        const f3 = x4.f;
        const path = String(f3.path || "");
        if (!path) return;
        if (f3.conflict === true) {
          if (conflictSeen[path]) return;
          conflictSeen[path] = true;
          rows.push({ path, origPath: f3.origPath || null, group: "conflict", conflict: true, change: "modified", addedLines: f3.addedLines, deletedLines: f3.deletedLines, dual: true });
          return;
        }
        rows.push({
          path,
          origPath: f3.origPath || null,
          group: x4.group,
          conflict: false,
          change: f3.change,
          addedLines: f3.addedLines,
          deletedLines: f3.deletedLines,
          // 同一个文件在两条清单里都出现（x=M、y=M）：两条行各画一次，并在悬停里说清各自是哪一部分。
          dual: pathCount[path] > 1
        });
      });
      const rank = function(r3) {
        return r3.conflict ? 1 : r3.group === "staged" ? 0 : 2;
      };
      rows.sort(function(a3, b3) {
        return rank(a3) - rank(b3) || (a3.path < b3.path ? -1 : a3.path > b3.path ? 1 : 0);
      });
      return rows;
    };
    const VC_BADGE_LETTER = { added: "A", modified: "M", deleted: "D", renamed: "R", typechange: "T", untracked: "?" };
    const vcBadgeLetterOf = function(change) {
      return VC_BADGE_LETTER[String(change)] || "M";
    };
    const vcRowViewOf = function(row, t3, diffBlock) {
      return {
        key: row.path,
        path: row.path,
        pathText: vcMiddle(row.path, 46),
        pathTip: row.path,
        origPath: row.origPath || "",
        changeKey: vcChangeKeyOf(row.change),
        // changeProven === false 的那一行（提交那一层判不出类型）就不画变化类型的字：宁可少说一句，不说错一句。
        changeText: row.changeProven === false ? "" : t3(vcChangeKeyOf(row.change)),
        changeTone: row.conflict ? "warning" : vcChangeToneOf(row.change),
        countsText: vcPlusMinus(row.addedLines, row.deletedLines),
        // #851：加减行数分开给，好让它们各自按正负着色（合计那一串 countsText 一个字不动，门禁与旧画法都还读它）。
        addText: row.addedLines === null || row.addedLines === void 0 || !isFinite(Number(row.addedLines)) ? "" : "+" + String(Number(row.addedLines)),
        delText: row.deletedLines === null || row.deletedLines === void 0 || !isFinite(Number(row.deletedLines)) ? "" : "−" + String(Number(row.deletedLines)),
        // 徽章：字母 + 变化类型对应的类名（颜色由 vcStyles.js 那一族规则给）。
        badge: vcBadgeLetterOf(row.change),
        badgeClass: "is-" + String(row.change || "modified"),
        countsTip: row.addedLines === null || row.addedLines === void 0 ? t3("vc.row.binaryTip") : row.dual === true ? t3("vc.row.countsDual") : t3("vc.row.diffTip"),
        conflict: row.conflict === true,
        conflictText: row.conflict ? t3("vc.row.conflict") : "",
        // 这一行属于哪一组（staged / conflict / unstaged）：展开键要用它，门禁也按它判分组。
        group: row.group || "",
        untracked: row.change === "untracked",
        // 悬停里第一行按最该先说的来：提交那一层判不出类型 → 说清来由；同一文件两段改动 → 说清这一行是哪一段；
        //   其余按冲突 / 未跟踪 / 点开看差异。拿不到的不装作没有，也不让用户以为 git 没给。
        rowTip: (row.typeTip ? String(row.typeTip) + "\n" : "") + (row.dual === true && row.conflict !== true ? (row.group === "staged" ? t3("vc.row.partStaged") : t3("vc.row.partUnstaged")) + "\n" : "") + (row.conflict ? t3("vc.row.conflictTip") : row.change === "untracked" ? t3("vc.row.untrackedTip") : t3("vc.row.diffTip")),
        diff: diffBlock || null
      };
    };
    const vcOtherRowOf = function(w4, t3) {
      const reason = w4 && w4.lockReason ? vcOneLine(w4.lockReason, 80) : "";
      let stateText = "";
      let stateTone = "";
      let stateTip = "";
      if (w4 && w4.prunable === true) {
        stateText = t3("vc.other.prunable");
        stateTone = "warning";
        stateTip = t3("vc.other.prunableTip");
      } else if (w4 && w4.prunableUnknown === true) {
        stateText = t3("vc.other.lockUnknown");
        stateTone = "caption";
        stateTip = t3("vc.other.prunableUnknownTip");
      } else if (w4 && w4.locked === true) {
        stateText = t3("vc.other.locked");
        stateTone = "warning";
        stateTip = t3("vc.other.lockedTip") + (reason ? " " + reason : "");
      } else if (w4 && w4.lockUnknown === true) {
        stateText = t3("vc.other.lockUnknown");
        stateTone = "caption";
        stateTip = t3("vc.other.lockUnknownTip");
      }
      return {
        key: String(w4 && w4.path || ""),
        path: String(w4 && w4.path || ""),
        displayText: String(w4 && w4.display || ""),
        displayTip: String(w4 && w4.path || ""),
        branchText: w4 && w4.bare === true ? t3("vc.other.bare") : w4 && w4.branch ? String(w4.branch) : t3("vc.other.noBranch"),
        stateText,
        stateTone,
        stateTip
      };
    };
    const vcDiffOpenKeyOf = function(row, commitMode) {
      const r3 = row || {};
      const rev = String(commitMode || "");
      if (rev) return vcCommitKeyOf(rev, r3.path);
      return String(r3.group || "") + "\0" + String(r3.path || "");
    };
    const vcReadsOf = function(reads, path) {
      const r3 = reads || {};
      const diffs = r3.diffs || {};

    const vcRemoteChoiceOf = function(reply) {

    const vcPlanMismatchOf = function(op, screen, plan) {
      const p3 = plan || {};
      const s3 = screen || {};
      const identity = s3.identity || {};
      const branch = String(identity.branch || "");
      const cur = (Array.isArray(s3.branches) ? s3.branches : []).filter(function(b3) {
        return String(b3 && b3.short) === branch;
      })[0] || null;
      const upstream = cur && cur.upstream ? String(cur.upstream) : "";
      if (op === "pull") {
        if (p3.localBranch && branch && String(p3.localBranch) !== branch) return "plan-branch-mismatch";
        if (p3.upstream && upstream && String(p3.upstream) !== upstream) return "plan-upstream-mismatch";
        return "";
      }
      if (op === "push") {
        if (p3.localBranch && branch && String(p3.localBranch) !== branch) return "plan-branch-mismatch";
        if (String(p3.mode) === "existing" && upstream && String(p3.remote || "") + "/" + String(p3.branch || "") !== upstream) return "plan-target-mismatch";
        return "";
      }
      return "";
    };
    const vcConfirmOf = function(op, plan, t3, remotes) {
      const p3 = plan || {};
      const remote = String(p3.remote || "");
      const target = String(p3.branch || "");
      const list = Array.isArray(remotes) ? remotes.map(function(x4) {
        return String(x4);
      }) : [];
      const mode = String(p3.mode || "") === "recreate" || p3.upstreamGone === true ? "recreate" : String(p3.mode || "existing");
      const base = { op: String(op || ""), mode, remote, target, localBranch: String(p3.localBranch || ""), remotes: list, pickRemote: false, okText: "" };
      if (op === "pull") {
        return Object.assign(base, { title: t3("vc.confirm.pullTitle"), body: t3("vc.confirm.pullBody"), okText: t3("vc.action.pull") });
      }
      if (base.mode === "set-upstream") {
        return Object.assign(base, {
          pickRemote: list.length > 1,
          title: t3("vc.confirm.pushSetUpstreamTitle"),
          body: t3("vc.confirm.pushSetUpstreamBody", { local: base.localBranch, remote, target }),
          okText: t3("vc.action.pushSetUpstream")
        });
      }
      if (base.mode === "recreate") {
        return Object.assign(base, {
          title: t3("vc.confirm.pushRecreateTitle"),
          body: t3("vc.confirm.pushRecreateBody", { remote, target }),
          okText: t3("vc.action.pushRecreate")
        });
      }
      return Object.assign(base, {
        title: t3("vc.confirm.pushTitle"),
        body: t3("vc.confirm.pushBody", { remote, target }),
        okText: t3("vc.action.push")
      });
    };

      if (o3 === "unstage") return call(VC_WRITE_PHONES.unstage, { cwd: String(cwd || ""), paths: Array.isArray(p3.paths) ? p3.paths.slice() : [] });
      const args = { cwd: String(cwd || ""), ticketId: String(p3.ticketId || ""), requestId: String(p3.requestId || "") };

    };
    const vcOpResultOf = function(op, reply, plan) {
      const r3 = reply || {};
      const o3 = String(op || "");
      if (r3.ok === true) {
        if (o3 === "stage") return { state: "done", key: "vc.op.doneStage", params: { n: String((r3.staged || []).length) }, verb: "vc.op.done", tipKey: "", tip: "", retryable: false, moved: false };
        if (o3 === "unstage") return { state: "done", key: "vc.op.doneUnstage", params: { n: String((r3.unstaged || []).length) }, verb: "vc.op.done", tipKey: "", tip: "", retryable: false, moved: false };
        if (o3 === "commit") return { state: "done", key: "vc.op.doneCommit", params: {}, verb: "vc.op.done", tipKey: "", tip: "", retryable: false, moved: false };
        if (o3 === "pull") {
          const mode = String(r3.mode || "");
          const tipKey = mode === "fast-forward" ? "vc.op.modeFastForward" : mode === "up-to-date" ? "vc.op.modeUpToDate" : "";
          return { state: "done", key: "vc.op.donePull", params: {}, verb: "vc.op.done", tipKey, tip: "", retryable: false, moved: false };
        }
        if (o3 === "fetch") {
          const remote2 = String(plan && plan.remote || r3.remote || "");
          return { state: "done", key: "vc.op.doneFetch", params: {}, verb: "vc.op.done", tipKey: "", tip: remote2, retryable: false, moved: false };
        }
        const pm = String(plan && plan.mode || "");
        const remote = String(plan && plan.remote || r3.remote || "");
        const target = String(plan && plan.branch || r3.branch || "");
        const local = String(plan && plan.localBranch || r3.local || "");
        if (pm === "recreate") return { state: "done", key: "vc.op.donePushRecreate", params: { local, remote, target }, verb: "vc.op.done", tipKey: "", tip: "", retryable: false, moved: false };
        if (pm === "set-upstream") return { state: "done", key: "vc.op.donePushSetUpstream", params: {}, verb: "vc.op.done", tipKey: "", tip: "", retryable: false, moved: false };
        return { state: "done", key: "vc.op.donePush", params: {}, verb: "vc.op.done", tipKey: "", tip: remote + "/" + target, retryable: false, moved: false };
      }
      const err = r3.error || {};
      const reason = String(err.reason || "");
      const moved = o3 === "commit" && (reason === "head-moved" || reason === "head-unreadable" || !!r3.headBefore && !!r3.headAfter && String(r3.headBefore) !== String(r3.headAfter));
      const pushNff = o3 === "push" && reason === "non-fast-forward";
      const key = moved ? "vc.writeErr.moved" : pushNff ? "vc.writeErr.notFastForwardPush" : vcWriteErrKeyOf(err);
      return {
        state: "failed",
        key,
        params: {},
        // 失败才有一句「面板不替你做什么」；成功那几档没有 limit 键，界面据此不画。
        limitKey: key + ".limit",
        verb: moved ? "vc.op.unknown" : "vc.op.failed",
        tipKey: "",
        tip: String(err.hint || err.message || ""),
        // 结果不确定时不给重试按钮：提交不幂等，鼓励再点一次是最坏的建议。
        retryable: !moved,
        moved
      };
    };
    const vcAfterWrite = function(reads, call, cwd, op) {

        return vcReadMoreCommits(freshLog, call, cwd, 0);
      });
    };

    const vcWriteUiOf = function(screen, ui, env) {
      const t3 = env.t;
      const w4 = ui && ui.write || {};
      const decisions = env && env.decisions || {};
      const ops = {};
      VC_WRITE_OPS.forEach(function(op) {
        const d3 = op === "push" ? vcPushDecisionOf(decisions[op]) : decisions[op];
        const state = vcOpStateOf(d3);
        const blockedTip = state === "blocked" ? vcBlockedTipOf(d3, t3) : "";
        const warnTip = d3 && d3.verdict === "warn" ? vcBlockedTipOf(d3, t3) : "";
        ops[op] = {
          state,
          disabled: state === "blocked",
          tip: blockedTip !== "" ? blockedTip : warnTip,
          hint: blockedTip !== "" ? blockedTip : warnTip,
          warn: warnTip,
          reasons: vcReasonKeysOf(d3 && d3.reasons).map(function(k4) {
            return t3(k4);
          })
        };
      });
      const running = String(w4.op || "");
      const result = w4.result || null;
      const choice = w4.remoteChoice && w4.remoteChoice.show === true ? w4.remoteChoice : null;
      const s3 = screen || {};
      const staged = Math.max(0, Number(s3.stagedCount) || 0);
      const unstaged = Math.max(0, Number(s3.unstagedCount) || 0);
      const rows = vcFileRowsOf(s3);
      const stagePaths = rows.filter(function(r3) {
        return r3.group === "unstaged" && r3.conflict !== true;
      }).map(function(r3) {
        return r3.path;
      });
      const busy = running !== "";
      return {
        ops,
        running,
        runningText: busy ? t3("vc.op.running") : "",
        result: result ? {
          // state 要带出来：渲染那一层靠它挑动作词的色（done 绿 / 其它红），也靠它落在 data-vc-op-result 上。
          state: String(result.state || ""),
          text: t3(result.key, result.params),
          // limit 只认显式给的 limitKey：成功那几档没有这个键，拿 key + '.limit' 去撞会撞出键名本身
          //   （#842 视觉预览的 J8 通用守卫抓到的就是它）。
          limit: result.limitKey ? t3(result.limitKey) : "",
          verb: t3(result.verb || (String(result.state) === "done" ? "vc.op.done" : "vc.op.failed")),
          // 悬停：宿主原话优先；没有原话时用可翻译的 tipKey（例如拉取成功那一档的快进/最新）。
          tip: String(result.tip || "") || (result.tipKey ? t3(result.tipKey) : ""),
          retryable: result.retryable === true,
          failed: String(result.state) === "failed",
          moved: result.moved === true,
          // #854：没做成的那一档配一个交出去的描述（动作名用静态分支翻，动态拼键名门禁不认）。
          ai: String(result.state) === "failed" ? { kind: "write-fail", opText: w4.op === "pull" ? t3("vc.action.pull") : w4.op === "fetch" ? t3("vc.action.fetch") : w4.op === "push" ? t3("vc.action.push") : w4.op === "stage" ? t3("vc.action.stage") : w4.op === "unstage" ? t3("vc.action.unstage") : t3("vc.action.commit", { n: String(staged) }), summary: t3(result.key, result.params), detail: result.limitKey ? t3(result.limitKey) : "", tip: String(result.tip || "") } : null
        } : null,
        // 多远端：画一排可点的远端入口（选中后由动作层带 remote 重跑预检）。
        remoteChoice: choice ? { op: choice.op === "fetch" ? "fetch" : "push", title: t3(choice.op === "fetch" ? "vc.pickRemote.fetchTitle" : "vc.pickRemote.title"), body: t3(choice.op === "fetch" ? "vc.pickRemote.fetchBody" : "vc.pickRemote.body"), remotes: choice.remotes.slice(), hint: String(choice.hint || "") } : null,
        actions: {
          pull: { op: "pull", text: t3("vc.action.pull"), disabled: busy || ops.pull.disabled, tip: ops.pull.tip, hint: ops.pull.hint, warn: ops.pull.warn },
          fetch: { op: "fetch", text: t3("vc.action.fetch"), disabled: busy || ops.fetch.disabled, tip: ops.fetch.tip, hint: ops.fetch.hint, warn: ops.fetch.warn },
          push: { op: "push", text: t3("vc.action.push"), disabled: busy || ops.push.disabled, tip: ops.push.tip, hint: ops.push.hint, warn: ops.push.warn }
        },
        stageAll: {
          show: unstaged > 0,
          text: t3("vc.action.stageAll"),
          paths: stagePaths,
          disabled: busy,
          tip: t3("vc.action.stageAll")
        },
        commitArea: {
          value: String(w4.message || ""),
          placeholder: t3("vc.commitArea.placeholder"),
          hint: t3("vc.commitArea.hint"),
          text: t3("vc.action.commit", { n: String(staged) }),
          // 无暂存内容、判定说这一步做不了、正在执行、或**提交信息还是空的**：按钮禁用。
          //   空信息这一档要给一句为什么（对抗式审查 4.4：原来点了毫无反馈，是个死点）。
          disabled: busy || staged === 0 || ops.commit.disabled || String(w4.message || "").trim() === "",
          needMessage: String(w4.message || "").trim() === "",
          tip: ops.commit.tip || (String(w4.message || "").trim() === "" ? t3("vc.commitArea.needMessage") : "")
        },
        // 确认框里带一句有效期（宿主票据 TTL 是 2 分钟）：用户停久了才知道为什么点下去说「已过期」（对抗式审查 3.1）。
        confirm: w4.confirm ? Object.assign(vcConfirmOf(w4.confirm.op, w4.confirm.plan, t3, w4.confirm.remotes), {
          ttlText: w4.confirm.ticket && w4.confirm.ticket.expiresAtMs ? t3("vc.confirm.ttl", { sec: String(Math.max(0, Math.round((Number(w4.confirm.ticket.expiresAtMs) - Number(env.nowMs || 0)) / 1e3))) }) : "",
          // #976：警告理由进确认框，不只放按钮悬停。取同一份首屏的判定，和按钮是同一快照。
          warnText: function() {
            var op = w4.confirm.op;
            var dd = op === "push" ? vcPushDecisionOf(decisions[op]) : decisions[op];
            return dd && dd.verdict === "warn" ? vcBlockedTipOf(dd, t3) : "";
          }()
        }) : null
      };
    };
    const vcWriteOpsOf = function(deps) {
      const d3 = deps || {};
      const ui = d3.ui;
      const setUi = d3.setUi;
      const callHost = d3.callHost;
      const cwd = d3.cwd;
      const readsRef = d3.readsRef;
      const setReads = d3.setReads;
      const screen = d3.screen;
      const writeState = ui && ui.write || {};
      const decisions = screen && typeof judge === "function" ? { stage: judge(screen, "stage"), commit: judge(screen, "commit"), pull: judge(screen, "pull"), push: judge(screen, "push"), fetch: judge(screen, "fetch") } : {};
      const setWrite = function(patch) {
        setUi(function(cur) {
          return Object.assign({}, cur, { write: Object.assign({ op: "", state: "idle", message: "", confirm: null, result: null }, cur.write || {}, patch || {}) });
        });
      };
      const afterWrite = function(op) {
        return vcAfterWrite(readsRef.current, callHost, cwd, op).then(function(next) {
          setReads(next);
        });
      };
      const runWrite = function(op, payload) {
        setWrite({ op, state: "running", result: null });
        return vcRunWrite(callHost, cwd, op, payload).then(function(reply) {
          const res = Object.assign({ op }, vcOpResultOf(op, reply, payload && payload.plan ? payload.plan : null));
          setWrite({ op: "", state: res.state, result: res, confirm: null });
          return res.state === "done" ? afterWrite(op) : null;
        });
      };
      const checkThen = function(op, extra, after) {
        setWrite({ op, state: "running", result: null });
        return vcRunCheck(callHost, cwd, op, extra).then(function(reply) {
          if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) {
            setWrite({ op: "", state: "failed", result: Object.assign({ op }, vcOpResultOf(op, reply)), confirm: null });
            return null;
          }
          return after(reply);
        });
      };
      const logShape = function(note) {
        try {
          log("warn", "host.call.fail", { method: VC_WRITE_PHONES.check, kind: "shape", errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(note || ""), 120, "error")) });
        } catch (e3) {
        }
      };
      const noteMismatch = function(op, plan) {
        const why = typeof vcPlanMismatchOf === "function" ? vcPlanMismatchOf(op, screen, plan) : "";
        if (why) logShape(why);
      };
      let inFlight = false;
      const guarded = function(fn2) {
        return function() {
          if (inFlight) return null;
          inFlight = true;
          const release = function() {
            inFlight = false;
          };
          try {
            const out = fn2.apply(null, arguments);
            if (out && typeof out.then === "function") return out.then(release, function(e3) {
              release();
              throw e3;
            });
            release();
            return out;
          } catch (e3) {
            release();
            throw e3;
          }
        };
      };
      const stagePaths = guarded(function(paths) {
        const list = (Array.isArray(paths) ? paths : []).filter(function(p3) {
          return String(p3 || "") !== "";
        });
        if (!list.length) return;
        return runWrite("stage", { paths: list });
      });
      const unstagePaths = guarded(function(paths) {
        const list = (Array.isArray(paths) ? paths : []).filter(function(p3) {
          return String(p3 || "") !== "";
        });
        if (!list.length) return;
        return runWrite("unstage", { paths: list });
      });
      const startPull = guarded(function() {
        if (vcOpStateOf(decisions.pull) === "blocked") return;
        return checkThen("pull", {}, function(reply) {
          noteMismatch("pull", reply.plan);
          setWrite({ op: "", state: "confirm", confirm: { op: "pull", plan: reply.plan, ticket: reply.ticket, remotes: reply.remotes || [] }, result: null, remoteChoice: null });
        });
      });
      const doFetch = function(remote) {
        if (vcOpStateOf(decisions.fetch) === "blocked") return null;
        const extra = remote ? { remote: String(remote) } : {};
        setWrite({ op: "fetch", state: "running", result: null, remoteChoice: null });
        return vcRunCheck(callHost, cwd, "fetch", extra).then(function(reply) {
          const choice = vcRemoteChoiceOf(reply);
          if (choice.show) {
            setWrite({ op: "", state: "idle", result: null, confirm: null, remoteChoice: Object.assign({}, choice, { op: "fetch" }) });
            return null;
          }
          if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) {
            setWrite({ op: "", state: "failed", result: Object.assign({ op: "fetch" }, vcOpResultOf("fetch", reply)), confirm: null, remoteChoice: null });
            return null;
          }
          noteMismatch("fetch", reply.plan);
          const ticket = reply.ticket || {};
          return runWrite("fetch", { ticketId: String(ticket.id || ""), requestId: vcRequestIdOf(Date.now(), "fetch"), plan: reply.plan });
        });
      };
      const startFetch = guarded(function(remote) {
        return doFetch(remote);
      });
      const doPush = function(remote) {
        if (vcOpStateOf(vcPushDecisionOf(decisions.push)) === "blocked") return null;
        const extra = remote ? { remote: String(remote) } : {};
        setWrite({ op: "push", state: "running", result: null, remoteChoice: null });
        return vcRunCheck(callHost, cwd, "push", extra).then(function(reply) {
          const choice = vcRemoteChoiceOf(reply);
          if (choice.show) {
            setWrite({ op: "", state: "idle", result: null, confirm: null, remoteChoice: Object.assign({}, choice, { op: "push" }) });
            return null;
          }
          if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) {
            setWrite({ op: "", state: "failed", result: Object.assign({ op: "push" }, vcOpResultOf("push", reply)), confirm: null, remoteChoice: null });
            return null;
          }
          noteMismatch("push", reply.plan);
          setWrite({ op: "", state: "confirm", confirm: { op: "push", plan: reply.plan, ticket: reply.ticket, remotes: Array.isArray(reply.remotes) ? reply.remotes : [] }, result: null, remoteChoice: null });
        });
      };
      const startPush = guarded(function(remote) {
        return doPush(remote);
      });
      const submitCommit = guarded(function() {
        const message = String(writeState.message || "");
        if (vcOpStateOf(decisions.commit) === "blocked" || message.trim() === "") return;
        return checkThen("commit", { message }, function(reply) {
          const ticket = reply.ticket || {};
          return runWrite("commit", { ticketId: String(ticket.id || ""), requestId: vcRequestIdOf(Date.now(), "commit"), message, plan: reply.plan }).then(function() {
            setWrite({ message: "" });
          });
        });
      });
      const confirmNow = guarded(function() {
        const c3 = writeState.confirm || null;
        if (!c3) return;
        const ticket = c3.ticket || {};
        return runWrite(c3.op, { ticketId: String(ticket.id || ""), requestId: vcRequestIdOf(Date.now(), c3.op), plan: c3.plan });
      });
      const cancelConfirm = function() {
        setWrite({ state: "idle", confirm: null, op: "" });
      };
      const pickRemote = guarded(function(name) {
        const op = writeState.remoteChoice && writeState.remoteChoice.op === "fetch" ? "fetch" : "push";
        setWrite({ state: "idle", confirm: null, op: "", result: null, remoteChoice: null });
        return op === "fetch" ? doFetch(name) : doPush(name);
      });
      const writeMessageOf = function(value) {
        setWrite({ message: String(value === void 0 || value === null ? "" : value) });
      };
      const retryResult = function() {
        const r3 = writeState.result || {};
        if (r3.op === "pull") return startPull();
        if (r3.op === "push") return startPush("");
        if (r3.op === "fetch") return startFetch("");
        if (r3.op === "commit") return submitCommit();
      };
      return {
        writeState,
        decisions,
        stagePaths,
        unstagePaths,
        startPull,
        startPush,
        startFetch,
        submitCommit,
        confirmNow,
        cancelConfirm,
        pickRemote,
        writeMessageOf,
        retryResult
      };
    };
    const vcBusySpinOf = function(h4) {
      return h4("span", { className: "dsws-spinner", style: { width: 11, height: 11, borderWidth: 2 } });
    };
    const vcBusyClsOf = function(runningOp, op) {
      return runningOp === op ? " dsws-fb-busy" : "";
    };
    const vcBusyKidsOf = function(h4, runningOp, op, text2) {
      if (runningOp !== op) return text2;

    };

          onClick: o3.cancelConfirm,
          // 接线（#1335 界面反馈）：点气泡外的那层透明覆盖等于取消确认，它也是能点到的，所以接一组标识；
          // 它不是按钮，用 data-press 的 other 档，表示「按下去的是个没有固定形状的东西」。
          "data-press": "other",
          "data-log": "vc.confirm.backdrop",
          style: { position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 20, background: "transparent" }
        }),
        h4("div", { key: "confirm", role: "dialog", tabIndex: -1, "data-vc-confirm": c3.op, "data-vc-popover": 1, style: { position: "absolute", zIndex: 30, top: 0, left: 0, width: 360, maxWidth: "calc(100% - 16px)", minWidth: 280, marginTop: 0, border: "1px solid var(--vc-line2)", borderRadius: "var(--vc-radius,4px)", padding: 12, background: "var(--vc-elevated,#1a2438)", boxShadow: "0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6 } }, [
          h4("div", { key: "title", className: "dsws-vc-dlg-t", style: { fontWeight: 700, color: o3.tone("primary") } }, c3.title),
          h4("div", { key: "body", className: "dsws-vc-dlg-b", "data-vc-confirm-body": 1, style: { color: o3.tone("primary"), lineHeight: 1.6 } }, c3.body),
          c3.warnText ? h4("div", { key: "warn", "data-vc-confirm-warn": 1, tabIndex: 0, style: { fontSize: 11, lineHeight: 1.6 } }, c3.warnText) : null,
          c3.ttlText ? h4("div", { key: "ttl", "data-vc-confirm-ttl": 1, style: { fontSize: 11, color: o3.tone("caption") } }, c3.ttlText) : null,
          c3.pickRemote && c3.remotes.length ? h4("select", { key: "pick", "data-vc-remote-pick": 1, value: c3.remote || "origin", onChange: function(e3) {
            o3.pickRemote(e3 && e3.target ? e3.target.value : "");
          }, style: { fontSize: 11, padding: "2px 6px", borderRadius: 6, border: "1px solid var(--vc-line2,#3a3f4a)", background: "var(--vc-inset,#0c0e12)", color: "var(--vc-ink,#e6edf3)" } }, c3.remotes.map(function(r3) {
            return h4("option", { key: r3, value: r3 }, r3);
          })) : null,
          h4("div", { key: "buttons", style: { display: "flex", gap: 6, justifyContent: "flex-end" } }, [
            // 接线（#1335 界面反馈）：确认框里两颗（取消、确认）是两种动作，各接一组定位名。
            h4("button", { key: "cancel", className: "dsws-btn ghost dsws-hov", type: "button", "data-vc-confirm-cancel": 1, "data-press": "button", "data-log": "vc.confirm.cancel", onClick: o3.cancelConfirm, style: {} }, o3.tr("vc.confirm.cancel")),
            h4("button", { key: "ok", className: "dsws-btn primary dsws-hov", type: "button", "data-vc-confirm-ok": 1, "data-press": "button", "data-log": "vc.confirm.ok", onClick: o3.confirmNow, style: { fontWeight: 700 } }, c3.okText)
          ])
        ])
      ] : null;
      const confirmNodes = confirm || [];
      const remotePopover = rc ? h4("div", { key: "remoteChoice", "data-vc-remote-choice": 1, "data-vc-popover": 1, style: { position: "absolute", zIndex: 30, top: 0, left: 0, width: 360, maxWidth: "calc(100% - 16px)", minWidth: 280, marginTop: 0, border: "1px solid var(--vc-line2)", borderRadius: "var(--vc-radius,4px)", padding: 12, background: "var(--vc-elevated,#1a2438)", boxShadow: "0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 6 } }, [
        h4("div", { key: "title", style: { fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: o3.tone("primary") } }, rc.title),
        h4("div", { key: "body", "data-vc-remote-choice-body": 1, style: { fontSize: 11, color: o3.tone("caption"), lineHeight: 1.6 } }, rc.body),
        h4("div", { key: "list", style: { display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" } }, rc.remotes.map(function(name, i3) {
          return h4("button", { key: name, className: "dsws-btn dsws-hov", type: "button", "data-vc-remote": name, "data-press": "button", "data-log": "vc.remote.pick." + i3, onClick: function() {
            o3.pickRemote(name);
          }, style: {} }, name);
        }))
      ]) : null;
      return [running, result].concat(confirmNodes).concat(remotePopover ? [remotePopover] : []);
    };
    const vcDiffOpsOf = function(o3) {
      const ui = o3.ui, setUi = o3.setUi, setReads = o3.setReads, readsRef = o3.readsRef;
      const callHost = o3.callHost, cwd = o3.cwd, stateCwdRef = o3.stateCwdRef;
      const vcDiffOpenKeyOf2 = o3.vcDiffOpenKeyOf, vcReadDiff2 = o3.vcReadDiff, vcReadCommitFiles2 = o3.vcReadCommitFiles;
      const vcReadCommitFileDiff2 = o3.vcReadCommitFileDiff, vcApplyDiffReply2 = o3.vcApplyDiffReply;
      const vcApplyCommitReply2 = o3.vcApplyCommitReply, vcReadsOf2 = o3.vcReadsOf;
      const vcMarkDiffLoading2 = o3.vcMarkDiffLoading, vcMarkCommitLoading2 = o3.vcMarkCommitLoading;
      const vcMarkCommitFileDiffLoading2 = o3.vcMarkCommitFileDiffLoading, vcApplyCommitFileDiffReply2 = o3.vcApplyCommitFileDiffReply;
      const onView = o3.onView;
      const rev = function() {
        return String(ui.openCommit || "");
      };
      const keyOf2 = function(row) {
        return vcDiffOpenKeyOf2(row, ui.openCommit);
      };
      const loadDiff = function(row) {
        const r3 = rev();
        return r3 ? vcReadCommitFileDiff2(readsRef.current, callHost, cwd, r3, row.path) : vcReadDiff2(readsRef.current, callHost, cwd, row.path, row.untracked === true);
      };
      const entryOf = function(row) {
        const r3 = rev();
        return r3 ? (readsRef.current.commitDiffs || {})[keyOf2(row)] || { state: "idle" } : vcReadsOf2(readsRef.current, row.path);
      };
      const applyFile = function(next, isCommitFile) {
        if (stateCwdRef && stateCwdRef.current !== cwd) return;
        if (isCommitFile) {
          setReads(function(cur) {
            return vcApplyCommitFileDiffReply2(cur, next);
          });
          return;
        }
        setReads(function(cur) {
          return vcApplyDiffReply2(cur, next);
        });
      };
      const applyCommit = function(next) {
        if (stateCwdRef && stateCwdRef.current !== cwd) return;
        setReads(function(cur) {
          return vcApplyCommitReply2(cur, next);
        });
      };
      const toggleDiff = function(row) {
        const key = keyOf2(row);
        if (ui.openDiff === key) {
          setUi(Object.assign({}, ui, { openDiff: "" }));
          return;
        }
        setUi(Object.assign({}, ui, { openDiff: key }));
        const st = entryOf(row).state;
        if (st === "ok" || st === "loading") return;
        const isCommitFile = rev() !== "";
        if (isCommitFile) setReads(vcMarkCommitFileDiffLoading2(readsRef.current, rev(), row.path));
        else setReads(vcMarkDiffLoading2(readsRef.current, row.path));
        loadDiff(row).then(function(next) {
          applyFile(next, isCommitFile);
        });
      };
      const retryDiff = function(row) {
        const isCommitFile = rev() !== "";
        if (isCommitFile) setReads(vcMarkCommitFileDiffLoading2(readsRef.current, rev(), row.path));
        else setReads(vcMarkDiffLoading2(readsRef.current, row.path));
        loadDiff(row).then(function(next) {
          applyFile(next, isCommitFile);
        });
      };
      const openCommit = function(c3) {
        const r3 = String(c3.key || "");
        if (typeof onView === "function") onView("commits");
        setUi(function(cur) {
          return Object.assign({}, cur, { openCommit: r3, openDiff: "" });
        });
        const entry = readsRef.current.commit || {};
        if (entry.rev === r3 && (entry.state === "ok" || entry.state === "loading")) return;
        setReads(vcMarkCommitLoading2(readsRef.current, r3));
        vcReadCommitFiles2(readsRef.current, callHost, cwd, r3).then(applyCommit);
      };
      const closeCommit = function() {
        setUi(Object.assign({}, ui, { openCommit: "", openDiff: "" }));
        if (typeof onView === "function") onView("changes");
      };
      const retryCommit = function() {
        const r3 = rev();
        if (!r3) return;
        setReads(vcMarkCommitLoading2(readsRef.current, r3));
        vcReadCommitFiles2(readsRef.current, callHost, cwd, r3).then(applyCommit);
      };
      return { diffKeyOf: keyOf2, entryOf, toggleDiff, retryDiff, openCommit, closeCommit, retryCommit };
    };
    const VC_FILE_ROWS_FIRST = 10;
    const VC_FILE_ROWS_BATCH = 10;
    const VC_OTHER_SUMMARY_NAMES = 20;
    const VC_BLOCK_ORDER = ["hint", "band", "identity", "changes", "commits", "other", "terminal"];
    const VC_FAIL_KEY = {
      // #842/宿主新档：'env-fs' 是「宿主的文件服务读不到运行状态标记」——那是环境问题，但**不是找不到 git**，
      //   所以单独一档、话术里不提 git（用户验收时看到的那句「找不到 git 程序」就是它错档造成的）。
      "env-fs": "vc.fail.envFs",
      // 'env' 留给真·找不到 git 那一档。
      "env": "vc.fail.noGit",
      "not-repo": "vc.fail.notRepo",
      "timeout": "vc.fail.timeout",
      "spawn": "vc.fail.spawn",
      "exit": "vc.fail.exit",
      "truncated": "vc.fail.truncated",
      "unsupported": "vc.fail.oldGit",
      "parse": "vc.fail.parse",
      "args": "vc.fail.args",
      "shape": "vc.fail.shape",
      "throw": "vc.fail.throw"
    };
    const vcFailKeyOf = function(kind) {
      return VC_FAIL_KEY[String(kind)] || "vc.fail.unknown";
    };
    const VC_SYNC_VALUES = ["tracked-known", "tracked-unknown", "upstream-gone", "no-upstream", "detached"];
    const vcSyncViewOf = function(identity, t3, nowMs) {
      const sync = String(identity && identity.sync || "no-upstream");
      const basis = vcBasisText(t3, nowMs, identity ? identity.basisMs : null);
      if (VC_SYNC_VALUES.indexOf(sync) < 0) {
        return { text: t3("vc.sync.unknown"), tip: t3("vc.sync.unknownTip", { kind: sync }), basis: "", basisTip: "" };
      }
      if (sync === "detached") return { text: t3("vc.sync.detached"), tip: t3("vc.detachedTip"), basis: "", basisTip: "" };
      if (sync === "no-upstream") return { text: t3("vc.sync.noUpstream"), tip: t3("vc.sync.noUpstreamTip"), basis: "", basisTip: "" };
      if (sync === "upstream-gone") return { text: t3("vc.sync.upstreamGone"), tip: t3("vc.sync.upstreamGoneTip"), basis: "", basisTip: "" };
      return {
        text: t3("vc.sync.aheadBehind", { ahead: String(identity && identity.ahead || 0), behind: String(identity && identity.behind || 0) }),
        tip: t3("vc.basis.tip"),
        basis,
        basisTip: t3("vc.basis.tip")
      };
    };
    const vcBlocksOf = function(screen, reads, ui, env) {
      const t3 = env.t;
      const nowMs = env.nowMs;
      const fold = env.fold || { band: 0, otherMode: "list", commitsCollapsed: false, state: { path: "", others: [], commits: [] } };
      if (env.cwdEmpty === true) return [{ kind: "error", key: "no-cwd", tone: "caption", text: t3("vc.noCwd"), rawTip: "", retry: "" }];
      const state = reads && reads.screen && reads.screen.state || "idle";
      const err = reads && reads.screen ? reads.screen.error : null;
      if (!screen) {
        if (state === "err" && err) {
          const kind = String(err.kind || "");
          return [{
            kind: "error",
            key: "screen",
            tone: kind === "not-repo" ? "caption" : "error",
            text: t3(vcFailKeyOf(kind)),
            // 宿主失败信封里那句 message 是宿主侧拼的中文原话，直接画出来会让英文界面看到中文；
            //   所以可见文字只用按种类映射出来的词条句，原话挪进悬停提示里当诊断线索（一个字都不丢）。
            rawTip: err.message ? t3("vc.fail.raw", { msg: String(err.message) }) : "",
            // 「这个目录不在任何 git 仓库里」不是读取失败，是这个目录本来就不是仓库：不给重试按钮。
            retry: kind === "not-repo" ? "" : t3("vc.retry"),
            // #854：这五档是「换个地方能动手」的读失败，配一个交出去的描述；配环境那几档不配。
            ai: VC_AI_READ_FAIL_KINDS.indexOf(String(err.kind || "")) >= 0 ? { kind: "read-fail", errorKind: String(err.kind || ""), summary: t3(vcFailKeyOf(kind)), detail: err.message ? t3("vc.fail.raw", { msg: String(err.message) }) : "" } : null
          }];
        }
        return [];
      }
      const t0 = ui && ui.fileShown || {};
      const shownOf = function(g4) {
        const n2 = Math.floor(Number(t0[g4]));
        return isFinite(n2) && n2 > 0 ? n2 : VC_FILE_ROWS_FIRST;
      };
      const write = typeof vcWriteUiOf === "function" ? vcWriteUiOf(screen, ui, env) : null;
      const blocks = [];
      if (state === "err" && err) blocks.push({ kind: "hint", key: "stale", tone: "warning", text: t3("vc.staleHint"), retry: t3("vc.retry") });
      const repo = screen.repo || {};
      const identity = screen.identity || {};
      const bandItems = [];
      if (repo.merging === true) bandItems.push({ key: "merge", tone: "warning", text: t3("vc.band.merge"), tip: t3("vc.band.terminalTip"), ai: { kind: "midop", summary: t3("vc.band.merge"), detail: t3("vc.band.terminalTip") } });
      if (repo.rebasing === true) bandItems.push({ key: "rebase", tone: "warning", text: t3("vc.band.rebase"), tip: t3("vc.band.terminalTip"), ai: { kind: "midop", summary: t3("vc.band.rebase"), detail: t3("vc.band.terminalTip") } });
      if (repo.cherryPicking === true) bandItems.push({ key: "cherry", tone: "warning", text: t3("vc.band.cherryPick"), tip: t3("vc.band.terminalTip"), ai: { kind: "midop", summary: t3("vc.band.cherryPick"), detail: t3("vc.band.terminalTip") } });
      if (repo.reverting === true) bandItems.push({ key: "revert", tone: "warning", text: t3("vc.band.revert"), tip: t3("vc.band.terminalTip"), ai: { kind: "midop", summary: t3("vc.band.revert"), detail: t3("vc.band.terminalTip") } });
      const conflicts = Math.max(0, Number(screen.conflictCount) || 0);
      if (conflicts > 0) bandItems.push({
        key: "conflicts",
        tone: "warning",
        text: t3("vc.conflicts.count", { n: String(conflicts) }),
        tip: (repo.merging === true ? t3("vc.conflicts.merge") : repo.rebasing === true ? t3("vc.conflicts.rebase") : t3("vc.conflicts.other")) + " " + t3("vc.band.terminalTip"),
        ai: { kind: "conflict", summary: t3("vc.conflicts.count", { n: String(conflicts) }), detail: repo.merging === true ? t3("vc.conflicts.merge") : repo.rebasing === true ? t3("vc.conflicts.rebase") : t3("vc.conflicts.other") }
      });
      if (repo.hasCommits === false && repo.bare !== true) bandItems.push({ key: "noc", tone: "caption", text: t3("vc.noCommits"), tip: t3("vc.noCommitsTip") });
      if (bandItems.length) blocks.push({ kind: "band", key: "band", items: bandItems });
      blocks.push({
        kind: "identity",
        key: "identity",
        // 裸仓库没有工作树，核心给的显示名是空串：照实写「裸仓库（没有工作树）」，别让身份行开头空着。
        name: String(identity.worktreeDisplay || "") || (repo.bare === true ? t3("vc.other.bare") : ""),
        nameTip: t3("vc.identity.worktreeTip", { path: String(identity.worktreePath || "") }),
        detached: identity.detached === true,
        branchText: identity.detached === true ? t3("vc.detached") : String(identity.branch || t3("vc.other.noBranch")),
        // 分支名用成功档的绿（原型 v3-id 的 br 就是强调绿，蓝色是之前映射错档）。
        branchTone: identity.detached === true ? "caption" : "success",
        oidText: identity.detached === true ? t3("vc.detachedAt", { oid: vcShortOid(identity.oid) }) : "",
        oidTip: String(identity.oid || ""),
        pathText: fold.state.path || "",
        pathTip: String(identity.worktreePath || ""),
        sync: vcSyncViewOf(identity, t3, nowMs),
        // 这份首屏读数是什么时候取的（#819 发现 3）：存着不画，用户就不知道手上这几个数有多旧。
        readAtText: reads && reads.screen && reads.screen.data && reads.screen.data.readAtMs ? t3("vc.readAt", { when: vcWhenText(t3, nowMs, reads.screen.data.readAtMs) }) : "",
        // #842 身份行右侧那两颗（拉取 / 推送）：领先落后就在这一行，动作也跟着放这里。
        actions: write ? write.actions : null
      });
      const rows = vcFileRowsOf(screen);
      const groups = [];
      const pushGroup = function(key, titleKey, list, tipKey) {
        if (list.length === 0) return;
        const n2 = shownOf(key);
        groups.push({ key, title: t3(titleKey, { n: String(list.length) }), tip: tipKey ? t3(tipKey) : "", count: list.length, rows: list.slice(0, n2), moreCount: Math.max(0, list.length - n2), moreLabel: t3("vc.more", { n: String(Math.max(0, list.length - n2)) }) });
      };
      const stagedRows = rows.filter(function(r3) {
        return vcGroupOfRow(r3) === "staged";
      });
      const conflictRows = rows.filter(function(r3) {
        return vcGroupOfRow(r3) === "conflict";
      });
      const unstagedRows = rows.filter(function(r3) {
        return vcGroupOfRow(r3) === "unstaged";
      });
      const commitMode = typeof vcCommitModeOf === "function" ? vcCommitModeOf(ui) : "";
      const openDiff = ui && ui.openDiff ? String(ui.openDiff) : "";
      const diffKeyOf = function(r3) {
        return vcDiffOpenKeyOf(r3, commitMode);
      };
      const rowViewOf = function(r3) {
        const key = diffKeyOf(r3);
        const entry = commitMode ? (reads && reads.commitDiffs || {})[key] : vcReadsOf(reads, r3.path);
        const diff = openDiff === key ? vcDiffViewOf(entry, t3, commitMode ? "" : "vc.diff.scopeHead") : null;
        const v3 = vcRowViewOf(r3, t3, diff);
        v3.stageAction = typeof vcRowStageOf === "function" ? vcRowStageOf(r3, t3) : null;
        v3.unstageAction = typeof vcRowUnstageOf === "function" ? vcRowUnstageOf(r3, t3) : null;
        return v3;
      };
      if (commitMode) {
        const cb = vcCommitBlockOf(screen, reads, ui, t3, nowMs, shownOf, rowViewOf);
        if (cb) blocks.push(cb);
      } else {
        pushGroup("staged", "vc.group.staged", stagedRows.map(rowViewOf));
        if (conflictRows.length) pushGroup("conflict", "vc.group.conflict", conflictRows.map(rowViewOf), "vc.group.conflictTip");
        pushGroup("unstaged", "vc.group.unstaged", unstagedRows.map(rowViewOf));
        const hostStaged = Number(screen.stagedCount) || 0;
        const hostUnstaged = Number(screen.unstagedCount) || 0;
        blocks.push({
          kind: "changes",
          key: "changes",
          title: t3("vc.changes.title"),
          summary: conflicts > 0 ? t3("vc.changes.summaryConflicts", { staged: String(hostStaged), unstaged: String(hostUnstaged), conflicts: String(conflicts) }) : t3("vc.changes.summary", { staged: String(hostStaged), unstaged: String(hostUnstaged) }),
          groups,
          empty: rows.length === 0,
          // 只有真空的时候才带上那句话：块模型里不该留一句不会被画出来的字（门禁按模型判「有没有冒这句话」）。
          emptyText: rows.length === 0 ? t3("vc.changes.none") : "",
          // #842 写操作：标题行那颗「全部暂存」与块底部的提交区（提交区不新增块，见设计 §1 的理由）。
          stageAll: write ? write.stageAll : null,
          commitArea: write ? write.commitArea : null
        });
      }
      const logRead = reads && reads.log || {};
      const commitList = vcCommitListOf(screen, reads);
      const commitRows = commitList.map(function(c3, i3) {
        const subject = fold.state.commits[i3] !== void 0 ? fold.state.commits[i3] : String(c3.subject || "");
        return {
          key: String(c3.oid || c3.short || i3),
          short: String(c3.short || vcShortOid(c3.oid)),
          subject,
          subjectTip: String(c3.subject || ""),
          author: String(c3.author || ""),
          when: vcWhenText(t3, nowMs, c3.authorDateMs !== void 0 && c3.authorDateMs !== null ? c3.authorDateMs : c3.commitDateMs),
          // 悬停里第一行永远是完整的提交说明（说明被阶梯折短之后，完整内容在这儿一个字不丢），
          //   第二行才是作者、时间与完整编号。
          tip: String(c3.subject || "") + "\n" + t3("vc.commit.tip") + "\n" + t3("vc.commits.tip", { author: String(c3.author || ""), when: vcWhenText(t3, nowMs, c3.commitDateMs !== void 0 && c3.commitDateMs !== null ? c3.commitDateMs : c3.authorDateMs), oid: String(c3.oid || "") }),
          open: commitMode !== "" && (String(c3.oid || "") === commitMode || String(c3.short || "") === commitMode),
          parents: Array.isArray(c3.parents) ? c3.parents.length : 0
        };
      });
      blocks.push({
        kind: "commits",
        key: "commits",
        title: t3("vc.commits.title"),
        collapsed: fold.commitsCollapsed === true,
        collapseText: t3("vc.commits.expand", { n: String(commitRows.length) }),
        rows: fold.commitsCollapsed === true ? [] : commitRows,
        empty: commitRows.length === 0,
        emptyText: commitRows.length === 0 ? t3("vc.noCommits") : "",
        more: {
          show: commitRows.length > 0 && fold.commitsCollapsed !== true,
          label: logRead.state === "loading" ? t3("vc.commits.loading") : t3("vc.commits.more"),
          allLoaded: logRead.hasMore === false && logRead.commits && logRead.commits.length > 0 ? t3("vc.commits.allLoaded") : "",
          failText: logRead.state === "err" ? t3("vc.commits.fail") : "",
          retry: logRead.state === "err" ? t3("vc.retry") : ""
        }
      });
      const others = Array.isArray(screen.otherWorktrees) ? screen.otherWorktrees : [];
      const otherViews = others.map(function(w4, i3) {
        const v3 = vcOtherRowOf(w4, t3);
        v3.displayText = fold.state.others[i3] !== void 0 ? fold.state.others[i3] : v3.displayText;
        return v3;
      });
      const otherShown = shownOf("other");
      const otherRows = fold.otherMode === "summary" ? [] : otherViews.slice(0, otherShown);
      const otherMore = fold.otherMode === "summary" ? 0 : Math.max(0, otherViews.length - otherShown);
      const summaryViews = fold.otherMode === "summary" ? otherViews.slice(0, VC_OTHER_SUMMARY_NAMES) : [];
