    const vcAiHandoffOf = function(o3) {
      const ai = o3 && o3.ai || {};
      const t3 = o3.t;
      const kind = String(ai.kind || "");
      const summary = String(ai.summary || "");
      if (!kind || !summary) return null;
      const s3 = o3 && o3.screen || {};
      const hasScreen = !!(o3 && o3.screen);
      const id = s3.identity || {};
      const repo = s3.repo || {};
      const repoName = String(id.worktreeDisplay || "") || (repo.bare === true ? t3("vc.other.bare") : "");
      const branchName = id.detached === true ? t3("vc.detached") : String(id.branch || "") || t3("vc.other.noBranch");
      const title = t3("vc.ai.title", { branch: branchName });
      const lines = [];
      if (repoName || hasScreen && branchName) {
        if (id.detached === true) lines.push(t3("vc.ai.repoDetached", { repo: repoName, oid: String(id.oid || "").slice(0, 7) }));
        else if (String(id.sync || "") === "no-upstream") lines.push(t3("vc.ai.repoNoUpstream", { repo: repoName, branch: branchName }));
        else if (String(id.sync || "") === "upstream-gone") lines.push(t3("vc.ai.repoUpstreamGone", { repo: repoName, branch: branchName }));
        else if (String(id.sync || "") === "tracked-known") lines.push(t3("vc.ai.repoKnown", { repo: repoName, branch: branchName, ahead: String(id.ahead || 0), behind: String(id.behind || 0) }));
        else if (repoName && branchName) lines.push(t3("vc.ai.repoUnknown", { repo: repoName, branch: branchName }));
      }
      if (hasScreen) {
        const midos = [];
        if (repo.merging === true) midos.push(t3("vc.ai.midopMerge"));
        if (repo.rebasing === true) midos.push(t3("vc.ai.midopRebase"));
        if (repo.cherryPicking === true) midos.push(t3("vc.ai.midopCherry"));
        if (repo.reverting === true) midos.push(t3("vc.ai.midopRevert"));
        const sep = t3("vc.ai.midopNone") === "none" ? ", " : "、";
        lines.push(t3("vc.ai.changes", { staged: String(s3.stagedCount || 0), unstaged: String(s3.unstagedCount || 0), conflicts: String(s3.conflictCount || 0), midop: midos.length ? midos.join(sep) : t3("vc.ai.midopNone") }));
      }
      lines.push(t3("vc.ai.intent", { op: ai.opText ? String(ai.opText) : t3("vc.ai.intentDefault") }));
      let seen = summary;
      const detail = ai.detail ? String(ai.detail) : "";
      if (detail && detail !== summary) seen += " " + detail;
      const tip = ai.tip ? String(ai.tip).slice(0, 300) : "";
      if (tip && seen.indexOf(tip) < 0) seen += (seen ? " " : "") + tip;
      lines.push(t3("vc.ai.seen", { text: seen }));
      if (kind === "conflict") {
        const stuck = [];
        ["staged", "unstaged"].forEach(function(g4) {
          (Array.isArray(s3[g4]) ? s3[g4] : []).forEach(function(r3) {
            if (r3 && r3.conflict === true && r3.path) stuck.push(String(r3.path));
          });
        });
        stuck.slice(0, 10).forEach(function(p3) {
          lines.push("- " + p3);
        });
        if (stuck.length > 10) lines.push("…");
      }
      lines.push(t3("vc.ai.goal"), t3("vc.ai.extra"));
      return { title, body: lines.join("\n") };
    };

    const VC_PHONES = { status: "wf.gitStatus", diff: "wf.gitDiff", log: "wf.gitLog" };
    const VC_LOG_BATCH = 50;
    const vcShouldRead = function(cwd) {
      return String(cwd === null || cwd === void 0 ? "" : cwd).trim() !== "";
    };
    const vcNewReads = function() {
      return {
        screen: { state: "idle", data: null, error: null },
        diffs: {},
        // 「这笔提交改了什么」那一路（规格故事 32）：文件清单一份，清单里每个文件的补丁各一份。
        //   补丁按「修订号 + 路径」两个一起当键 —— 同一个文件在不同提交里的补丁是两回事，不能互相顶替。
        commit: { rev: "", state: "idle", files: [], truncated: false, reason: "", error: null },
        commitDiffs: {},
        log: { state: "idle", commits: [], hasMore: false, fetched: 0, error: null }
      };
    };
    const vcCommitKeyOf = function(rev, path) {
      return String(rev || "") + "\0" + String(path || "");
    };
    const vcOkLog = function(method, kind, t0) {
      try {
        log("info", "host.call", { method, latencyMs: Date.now() - t0, ok: true, kind });
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    const vcFailLog = function(method, kind, t0, fail) {
      try {
        log("warn", "host.call.fail", { method, kind, errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(fail && fail.kind || "") + " " + String(fail && fail.message || ""), 120, "error")) });
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    const vcFailureOf = function(reply) {
      if (reply && reply.ok === false) {
        const e3 = reply.error || {};
        return { kind: String(e3.kind || "unknown"), message: String(e3.message || "") };
      }
      return { kind: "shape", message: "" };
    };
    const vcScreenShapeOk = function(s3) {
      if (!s3 || typeof s3 !== "object" || Array.isArray(s3)) return false;
      const id = s3.identity;
      if (!id || typeof id !== "object" || Array.isArray(id)) return false;
      if (typeof id.worktreePath !== "string" || typeof id.sync !== "string" || typeof id.detached !== "boolean") return false;
      if (typeof id.ahead !== "number" || typeof id.behind !== "number") return false;
      if (!(id.branch === null || typeof id.branch === "string")) return false;
      if (!(id.basisMs === null || typeof id.basisMs === "number")) return false;
      for (const k4 of ["staged", "unstaged", "otherWorktrees", "branches", "commits"]) {
        if (!Array.isArray(s3[k4])) return false;
      }
      for (const k4 of ["stagedCount", "unstagedCount", "conflictCount"]) {
        if (typeof s3[k4] !== "number" || !isFinite(s3[k4])) return false;
      }
      if (!s3.repo || typeof s3.repo !== "object" || Array.isArray(s3.repo)) return false;
      return true;
    };
    const vcReadStatus = function(reads, call, cwd) {
      const base = reads || vcNewReads();
      const prev = base.screen || { state: "idle", data: null, error: null };
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_PHONES.status, { cwd: String(cwd || "") });
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcScreenShapeOk(reply.screen)) {
          vcOkLog(VC_PHONES.status, "git-status", t0);
          return Object.assign({}, base, {
            screen: { state: "ok", data: { screen: reply.screen, tier: String(reply.tier || ""), gitVersion: String(reply.gitVersion || ""), readAtMs: Number(reply.readAtMs) || Date.now() }, error: null }
          });
        }
        const fail = vcFailureOf(reply);
        vcFailLog(VC_PHONES.status, "git-status", t0, fail);
        return Object.assign({}, base, { screen: { state: "err", data: prev.data, error: fail } });
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        const fail = { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) };
        vcFailLog(VC_PHONES.status, "git-status", t0, fail);
        return Object.assign({}, base, { screen: { state: "err", data: prev.data, error: fail } });
      });
    };
    const vcReadDiff = function(reads, call, cwd, path, untracked) {
      const base = reads || vcNewReads();
      const key = String(path || "");
      const diffs = Object.assign({}, base.diffs || {});
      const prev = diffs[key] || { state: "idle", lines: null, reason: "", truncated: false, error: null, seq: 0 };
      const seq = (Number(prev.seq) || 0) + 1;
      diffs[key] = { state: "loading", lines: prev.lines, reason: prev.reason, truncated: prev.truncated === true, error: prev.error, seq };
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_PHONES.diff, { cwd: String(cwd || ""), path: key, untracked: untracked === true });
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && Array.isArray(reply.lines)) {
          vcOkLog(VC_PHONES.diff, "git-diff", t0);
          diffs[key] = { state: "ok", lines: reply.lines, reason: String(reply.reason || "ok"), truncated: reply.truncated === true, error: null, seq };
          return Object.assign({}, base, { diffs: vcBoundedMap(diffs) });
        }
        const fail = vcFailureOf(reply);
        vcFailLog(VC_PHONES.diff, "git-diff", t0, fail);
        diffs[key] = { state: "err", lines: prev.lines, reason: prev.reason, truncated: prev.truncated === true, error: fail, seq };
        return Object.assign({}, base, { diffs: vcBoundedMap(diffs) });
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        const fail = { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) };
        vcFailLog(VC_PHONES.diff, "git-diff", t0, fail);
        diffs[key] = { state: "err", lines: prev.lines, reason: prev.reason, truncated: prev.truncated === true, error: fail };
        return Object.assign({}, base, { diffs });
      });
    };
    const vcReadCommitFiles = function(reads, call, cwd, rev) {
      const base = reads || vcNewReads();
      const key = String(rev || "");
      const prev = base.commit || { rev: "", seq: 0, state: "idle", files: [], truncated: false, reason: "", error: null };
      const same = prev.rev === key;
      const seq = (Number(prev.seq) || 0) + 1;
      const roll = { rev: key, seq, state: "loading", files: same ? prev.files : [], truncated: same ? prev.truncated === true : false, reason: same ? prev.reason : "", error: same ? prev.error : null };
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_PHONES.diff, { cwd: String(cwd || ""), rev: key });
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && Array.isArray(reply.files)) {
          vcOkLog(VC_PHONES.diff, "git-diff", t0);
          roll.state = "ok";
          roll.files = reply.files;
          roll.truncated = reply.truncated === true;
          roll.reason = String(reply.reason || "ok");
          roll.error = null;
          return Object.assign({}, base, { commit: roll });
        }
        const fail = vcFailureOf(reply);
        vcFailLog(VC_PHONES.diff, "git-diff", t0, fail);
        roll.state = "err";
        roll.error = fail;
        return Object.assign({}, base, { commit: roll });
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        const fail = { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) };
        vcFailLog(VC_PHONES.diff, "git-diff", t0, fail);
        roll.state = "err";
        roll.error = fail;
        return Object.assign({}, base, { commit: roll });
      });
    };
    const vcApplyCommitReply = function(currentReads, nextReads) {
      const cur = currentReads && currentReads.commit;
      const nxt = nextReads && nextReads.commit;
      if (!nxt) return currentReads;
      if (cur && (Number(cur.seq) || 0) > (Number(nxt.seq) || 0)) return currentReads;
      return nextReads;
    };
    const VC_DIFF_CACHE_MAX = 40;
    const vcBoundedMap = function(map) {
      const keys = Object.keys(map || {});
      if (keys.length <= VC_DIFF_CACHE_MAX) return map || {};
      const keep = {};
      keys.slice(keys.length - VC_DIFF_CACHE_MAX).forEach(function(k4) {
        keep[k4] = map[k4];
      });
      return keep;
    };
    const vcApplyDiffReply = function(currentReads, nextReads) {
      const cur = currentReads && currentReads.diffs || {};
      const nxt = nextReads && nextReads.diffs || {};
      const out = Object.assign({}, cur);
      Object.keys(nxt).forEach(function(k4) {
        const c3 = cur[k4] || {};
        const n2 = nxt[k4] || {};
        if ((Number(c3.seq) || 0) > (Number(n2.seq) || 0)) return;
        out[k4] = n2;
      });
      return Object.assign({}, currentReads || vcNewReads(), { diffs: vcBoundedMap(out) });
    };
    const vcApplyCommitFileDiffReply = function(currentReads, nextReads) {
      const cur = currentReads && currentReads.commitDiffs || {};
      const nxt = nextReads && nextReads.commitDiffs || {};
      const out = Object.assign({}, cur);
      Object.keys(nxt).forEach(function(k4) {
        const c3 = cur[k4] || {};
        const n2 = nxt[k4] || {};
        if ((Number(c3.seq) || 0) > (Number(n2.seq) || 0)) return;
        out[k4] = n2;
      });
      return Object.assign({}, currentReads || vcNewReads(), { commitDiffs: vcBoundedMap(out) });
    };
    const vcFreshOnCwd = function(lastCwd, cwd, reads, ui) {
      if (String(lastCwd) === String(cwd)) return { changed: false, reads, ui };
      return { changed: true, reads: vcNewReads(), ui: { fileShown: {}, openDiff: "", openCommit: "" } };
    };
    const vcMarkLogLoading = function(reads) {
      const base = reads || vcNewReads();
      const prev = base.log || { state: "idle", commits: [], hasMore: false, fetched: 0, error: null };
      return Object.assign({}, base, { log: { state: "loading", commits: prev.commits || [], hasMore: prev.hasMore === true, fetched: prev.fetched || 0, error: prev.error } });
    };
    const vcMarkDiffLoading = function(reads, key) {
      const base = reads || vcNewReads();
      const map = Object.assign({}, base.diffs || {});
      const prev = map[String(key || "")] || { state: "idle", lines: null, reason: "", truncated: false, error: null, seq: 0 };
      map[String(key || "")] = { state: "loading", lines: prev.lines, reason: prev.reason, truncated: prev.truncated === true, error: prev.error, seq: (Number(prev.seq) || 0) + 1 };
      return Object.assign({}, base, { diffs: vcBoundedMap(map) });
    };
    const vcMarkCommitLoading = function(reads, rev) {
      const base = reads || vcNewReads();
      const prev = base.commit || { rev: "", seq: 0, state: "idle", files: [], truncated: false, reason: "", error: null };
      return Object.assign({}, base, { commit: { rev: String(rev || ""), seq: (Number(prev.seq) || 0) + 1, state: "loading", files: prev.rev === String(rev || "") ? prev.files : [], truncated: false, reason: "", error: null } });
    };
    const vcMarkCommitFileDiffLoading = function(reads, rev, path) {
      const base = reads || vcNewReads();
      const key = vcCommitKeyOf(rev, path);

    const VC_PALETTE_MAX = 80;

    const vcCapabilityAliasOf = function(cap) {
      const cmd = String(cap && cap.command || "");

        const word = words[i3];
        if (!word || word === "git") continue;
        if (word.charAt(0) === "-") continue;
        if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/.test(word)) continue;
        out.push(word);
        if (out.length >= 2) break;
      }
      return out.join(" ");
    };

    const vcCapabilityListOf = function(h4, t3, o3) {

    const VC_HISTORY_BATCH = VC_LOG_BATCH;
    const VC_HISTORY_LANES_MAX = 6;
    const VC_HISTORY_DIFF_LINES_WIDE = 120;
    const VC_HISTORY_DIFF_LINES_NARROW = 60;
    const vcHistoryWidthOf = function(width) {
      const n2 = Number(width);
      return !isFinite(n2) || n2 <= 0 ? 460 : Math.round(n2);
    };
    const vcHistoryDiffContextOf = function(width) {
      return vcHistoryWidthOf(width) >= 520 ? VC_HISTORY_DIFF_LINES_WIDE : VC_HISTORY_DIFF_LINES_NARROW;
    };
    const vcHistorySliceOf = function(reads) {
      if (!reads) return { state: "idle", data: null, error: null };
      return {
        state: vcFirstScreenSliceStateOf(reads, "history"),
        data: function() {
          const slice = vcFirstScreenSliceOf(reads, "history");
          return slice && slice.data ? slice.data : null;
        }(),
        error: vcFirstScreenSliceErrorOf(reads, "history")
      };
    };
    const vcHistoryFirstPageOf = function(reads) {
      const slice = vcHistorySliceOf(reads);
      if (slice.state !== "ok" || !slice.data) return [];
      return Array.isArray(slice.data.commits) ? slice.data.commits : [];
    };
    const vcHistoryMoreOf = function(reads) {
      const log2 = reads && reads.log ? reads.log : null;
      return !log2 || log2.state !== "ok" || !Array.isArray(log2.commits) ? [] : log2.commits;
    };
    const vcHistoryStateOf = function(reads, firstPage, hasMore) {
      if (!reads) return "loading";
      if (vcFirstScreenSliceStateOf(reads, "history") === "err") return "error";
      const screenState = vcFirstScreenStateOf(reads);
      if (screenState === "err") return "error";
      if (screenState === "loading" || screenState === "idle") return "loading";
      return !firstPage.length && hasMore !== true ? "empty" : "ok";
    };
    const vcHistoryModelOf = function(reads, ui) {
      const u3 = ui || {};
      const firstPage = vcHistoryFirstPageOf(reads);
      const more = vcHistoryMoreOf(reads);
      const slice = vcHistorySliceOf(reads);
      const log2 = reads && reads.log ? reads.log : null;
      const logState = log2 ? String(log2.state || "idle") : "idle";
      let hasMore = false;
      if (logState === "ok") hasMore = log2.hasMore === true;
      else if (slice.state === "ok" && slice.data) hasMore = slice.data.hasMore === true;
      const commits = firstPage.concat(more);
      return {
        source: "first-screen",
        firstPage,
        more,
        commits,
        loaded: commits.length,
        hasMore,
        state: vcHistoryStateOf(reads, firstPage, hasMore),
        error: slice.error || (reads && reads.firstScreen ? reads.firstScreen.error : null),
        logState,
        logError: log2 ? log2.error : null,
        openCommit: String(u3.openCommit || ""),
        openFile: String(u3.openFile || "")
      };
    };
    const vcHistoryGraphOf = function(commits) {
      const list = Array.isArray(commits) ? commits : [];
      const inPage = {};
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < list.length; i3 += 1) inPage[String(list[i3] && list[i3].oid || "")] = true;
      const cols = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < VC_HISTORY_LANES_MAX; i3 += 1) cols.push(null);
      const freeColOf = function() {
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < VC_HISTORY_LANES_MAX; i3 += 1) if (cols[i3] === null) return i3;
        return -1;
      };
      const colOf = function(oid) {
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < VC_HISTORY_LANES_MAX; i3 += 1) if (cols[i3] === oid) return i3;
        return -1;
      };
      const rows = [];
      let hiddenLanes = 0;
      for (let r3 = 0; r3 < list.length; r3 += 1) {
        const c3 = list[r3] || {};
        const oid = String(c3.oid || "");
        let lane = colOf(oid);
        if (lane < 0) lane = freeColOf();
        if (lane < 0) {
          lane = VC_HISTORY_LANES_MAX - 1;
          hiddenLanes += 1;
        }
        cols[lane] = null;
        const parentList = Array.isArray(c3.parents) ? c3.parents : [];
        const edges = [];
        for (let p3 = 0; p3 < parentList.length; p3 += 1) {
          const poid = String(parentList[p3]);
          if (inPage[poid] !== true) {
            hiddenLanes += 1;
            continue;
          }
          let at = colOf(poid);
          if (at < 0) {
            const target = p3 === 0 && cols[lane] === null ? lane : freeColOf();
            if (target >= 0) {
              at = target;
              cols[target] = poid;
            } else hiddenLanes += 1;
          }
          if (at >= 0) edges.push(at);
        }
        rows.push({
          oid,
          short: String(c3.short || vcShortOid(oid)),
          subject: String(c3.subject || ""),
          author: String(c3.author || ""),
          authorDateMs: c3.authorDateMs,
          parents: parentList.slice(),
          edges,
          lane
        });
      }
      return { rows, hiddenLanes, lanes: VC_HISTORY_LANES_MAX, external: false };
    };
    const vcHistoryPlusMinusOf = function(file) {
      const added = file && file.added !== null && file.added !== void 0 ? "+ " + String(file.added) : "";
      const deleted = file && file.deleted !== null && file.deleted !== void 0 ? "− " + String(file.deleted) : "";
      return (added + " " + deleted).trim();
    };
    const vcHistoryRowNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {

      if (width >= 460) {
        kids.push(h4("span", { key: "author", className: "vcs-hist-author", "data-vc-history-author": "1" }, String(c3.author || "")));
        kids.push(h4("span", { key: "when", className: "vcs-hist-when", "data-vc-history-when": "1" }, vcWhenText(t3, opts.nowMs, c3.authorDateMs)));
      }
      const attrs = {
        key: "open",
        type: "button",
        className: "vcs-hist-open",
        "data-vc-history-open": String(c3.oid || ""),
        "aria-expanded": opts.expanded === true ? "true" : "false",
        "aria-controls": "vc-history-detail",
        title: t3("vc.shell.history.open", { subject: vcOneLine(String(c3.subject || ""), 120) })
      };
      return h4("li", { key: String(c3.oid || ""), className: "vcs-hist-row", "data-vc-history-row": String(c3.oid || "") }, h4("button", attrs, kids));
    };
    const vcHistoryListOf = function(h4, t3, o3) {
      const opts = o3 || {};
      const model = opts.model || {};
      const commits = Array.isArray(model.commits) ? model.commits : [];
      const rows = [];

        className: "vcs-hist-list",

        "aria-label": t3("vc.shell.history.listLabel")
      }, rows)];
      const hasMore = model.hasMore === true;
      if (hasMore === true) {
        kids.push(h4("button", {
          key: "more",
          type: "button",
          className: "vcs-hist-more",
          "data-vc-load-more": "1",
          "aria-controls": "vc-history-list",
          disabled: model.logState === "loading" ? true : void 0
        }, t3("vc.shell.history.loadMore", { batch: VC_HISTORY_BATCH })));
      }
      if (model.logState === "loading") {
        kids.push(h4("span", { key: "moreLoading", className: "vcs-hist-more-state", "data-vc-history-more-state": "loading" }, t3("vc.shell.history.loadingMore")));
      } else if (model.logState === "err") {
        kids.push(h4("span", { key: "moreError", className: "vcs-hist-more-state", "data-vc-history-more-state": "error" }, t3("vc.shell.history.moreError")));

      }
      const attrs = { key: "wrap", className: "vcs-hist-list-wrap" };

    };
    const vcHistoryFileDiffOf = function(h4, t3, o3) {
      const opts = o3 || {};
      const read = opts.read || null;
      const path = String(opts.path || "");
      const kids = [h4("h5", { key: "title", className: "vcs-hist-diff-title" }, t3("vc.shell.history.diffTitle", { path }))];

      if (read.state === "err") {
        kids.push(h4("p", { key: "err", className: "vcs-hist-diff-state", "data-vc-file-diff-error": "1" }, t3("vc.shell.history.diffError")));
        kids.push(h4("button", { key: "retry", type: "button", className: "vcs-hist-diff-retry", "data-vc-file-diff-retry": "1" }, t3("vc.shell.history.diffRetry")));
        return h4("div", { key: "diff", className: "vcs-hist-diff", "data-vc-file-diff": path }, kids);
      }
      if (read.state !== "ok") {
        kids.push(h4("p", { key: "loading", className: "vcs-hist-diff-state" }, t3("vc.shell.history.diffLoading")));
        return h4("div", { key: "diff", className: "vcs-hist-diff", "data-vc-file-diff": path }, kids);
      }
      const reason = String(read.reason || "");
      if (reason === "binary-diff") kids.push(h4("p", { key: "binary", className: "vcs-hist-diff-state", "data-vc-file-diff-binary": "1" }, t3("vc.shell.history.diffBinary")));
      else if (reason === "merge-commit") kids.push(h4("p", { key: "merge", className: "vcs-hist-diff-state", "data-vc-file-diff-merge": "1" }, t3("vc.shell.history.diffMerge")));
      else {
        if (read.truncated === true) kids.push(h4("p", { key: "trunc", className: "vcs-hist-diff-state", "data-vc-file-diff-truncated": "1" }, t3("vc.shell.history.diffTruncated")));
        const lines = Array.isArray(read.lines) ? read.lines : [];
        if (!lines.length) kids.push(h4("p", { key: "none", className: "vcs-hist-diff-state" }, t3("vc.shell.history.diffNoDiff")));
        else {
          kids.push(h4("pre", { key: "lines", className: "vcs-hist-diff-lines" }, lines.map(function(line, i3) {
            return h4("span", { key: "l" + i3, className: "vcs-hist-diff-line vcs-hist-line-" + String(line.kind || "context"), "data-vc-diff-line": String(line.kind || "context") }, String(line.text || "") + "\n");
          })));
        }
      }
      return h4("div", { key: "diff", className: "vcs-hist-diff", "data-vc-file-diff": path }, kids);
    };
    const vcHistoryDetailOf = function(h4, t3, o3) {

    const vcHistoryPageNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {

    const VC_SYNC_PHONES = {
      check: "wf.gitSyncCheck",
      write: "wf.gitSyncWrite"
    };
    const VC_SYNC_ACTION_ROWS = [
      { id: "8.5", action: "fetch", labelKey: "vc.sync.action.fetch" },
      { id: "8.6", action: "pull-merge", labelKey: "vc.sync.action.pullMerge" },
      { id: "8.7", action: "pull-rebase", labelKey: "vc.sync.action.pullRebase" },

      { id: "8.10", action: "push-upstream", labelKey: "vc.sync.action.pushUpstream" },

    const vcNewSyncReads = function() {
      return { sync: { state: "idle", data: null, error: null }, task: { state: "idle", data: null, error: null } };
    };
    const vcSyncStateOf = function(reads) {
      const slot = reads && reads.sync;
      return slot && typeof slot.state === "string" ? slot.state : "idle";
    };
    const vcSyncDataOf = function(reads) {
      const slot = reads && reads.sync;
      return slot && slot.data ? slot.data : null;
    };
    const vcSyncErrorOf = function(reads) {
      const slot = reads && reads.sync;
      return slot && slot.error ? slot.error : null;
    };
    const vcSyncTaskOf = function(reads) {
      const slot = reads && reads.task;
      return slot && slot.data ? slot.data : null;
    };
    function vcSyncMerge(reads, next) {
      return Object.assign({}, reads || {}, next);
    }
    function vcSyncLog(level, event, fields) {
      try {
        if (typeof log === "function") log(level, event, fields);
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    }
    const vcApplySyncReply = function(reads, reply) {
      const base = reads || {};
      if (reply && reply.ok === true) {
        return vcSyncMerge(base, { sync: { state: "ok", data: reply, error: null } });
      }
      const error = reply && reply.error || { kind: "host", message: "预检没有返回结果" };
      return vcSyncMerge(base, { sync: { state: "err", data: base.sync && base.sync.data || null, error } });
    };
    const vcApplySyncWriteReply = function(reads, reply) {
      const base = reads || {};
      if (reply && reply.ok === true) {
        return vcSyncMerge(base, {
          sync: { state: "ok", data: Object.assign({}, base.sync && base.sync.data || {}, { executed: true }), error: null },
          task: { state: "ok", data: reply.task || null, error: null }
        });
      }
      const error = reply && reply.error || { kind: "host", message: "执行没有返回结果" };
      return vcSyncMerge(base, { task: { state: "err", data: base.task && base.task.data || null, error } });
    };
    const vcReadSyncCheck = function(reads, call, cwd, action, input) {
      const startedAt = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_SYNC_PHONES.check, Object.assign({ cwd: String(cwd || ""), action: String(action || "") }, input || {}));
      }).then(function(reply) {
        vcSyncLog("info", "host.call", { method: VC_SYNC_PHONES.check, latencyMs: Date.now() - startedAt, ok: !!(reply && reply.ok === true), kind: "sync-check" });
        return vcApplySyncReply(reads, reply);
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        vcSyncLog("warn", "host.call.fail", { method: VC_SYNC_PHONES.check, kind: "sync-check", errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(e3 && e3.message || e3), 120, "error")) });
        return vcApplySyncReply(reads, { ok: false, error: { kind: "host", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) } });
      });
    };
    const vcRunSyncWrite = function(reads, call, cwd, ticketId, action, requestId, confirmed) {
      const startedAt = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_SYNC_PHONES.write, {
          cwd: String(cwd || ""),
          ticketId: String(ticketId || ""),
          action: String(action || ""),
          requestId: String(requestId || ""),
          confirmed: confirmed === true
        });
      }).then(function(reply) {
        vcSyncLog("info", "host.call", { method: VC_SYNC_PHONES.write, latencyMs: Date.now() - startedAt, ok: !!(reply && reply.ok === true), kind: "sync-write" });
        return vcApplySyncWriteReply(reads, reply);
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        vcSyncLog("warn", "host.call.fail", { method: VC_SYNC_PHONES.write, kind: "sync-write", errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(e3 && e3.message || e3), 120, "error")) });
        return vcApplySyncWriteReply(reads, { ok: false, error: { kind: "host", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) } });
      });
    };
    const VC_REMOTE_PHONES = {
      list: "wf.gitRemoteList",
      add: "wf.gitRemoteAdd",
      rename: "wf.gitRemoteRename",
      remove: "wf.gitRemoteRemove",
      setUrl: "wf.gitRemoteSetUrl",
      online: "wf.gitRemoteOnline"
    };
    const VC_REMOTE_WRITE_PHONES = {
      add: VC_REMOTE_PHONES.add,
      rename: VC_REMOTE_PHONES.rename,
      remove: VC_REMOTE_PHONES.remove,
      setUrl: VC_REMOTE_PHONES.setUrl
    };
    const VC_REMOTE_FORMS = VC_SHELL_FORMS.slice();
    const VC_REMOTE_ONLINE_FAIL_KINDS = ["timeout", "needs-credential", "no-network", "remote-missing", "truncated", "other"];
    const vcNewRemoteReads = function() {
      return {
        remote: { state: "idle", data: null, error: null },
        online: { state: "idle", name: "", data: null, error: null }
      };
    };
    const vcRmOkLog = function(method, kind, t0) {
      try {
        log("info", "host.call", { method, latencyMs: Date.now() - t0, ok: true, kind });
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    const vcRmFailLog = function(method, kind, t0, fail) {
      try {
        log("warn", "host.call.fail", { method, kind, errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(fail && fail.kind || "") + " " + String(fail && fail.message || ""), 120, "error")) });
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    const vcRmFailureOf = function(reply) {
      if (reply && reply.ok === false) {
        const e3 = reply.error || {};
        return { kind: String(e3.kind || "unknown"), reason: String(e3.reason || e3.kind || "unknown"), message: String(e3.message || ""), hint: String(e3.hint || "") };
      }
      return { kind: "shape", reason: "shape", message: "", hint: "" };
    };
    const vcRmLocalShapeOk = function(data) {
      if (!data || data.source !== "local") return false;
      if (typeof data.readAtMs !== "number" || !isFinite(data.readAtMs)) return false;
      return Array.isArray(data.remotes);
    };
    const vcRmOnlineShapeOk = function(data) {
      if (!data || data.source !== "network") return false;
      if (typeof data.readAtMs !== "number" || !isFinite(data.readAtMs)) return false;
      if (data.truncated === true) return false;
      return Array.isArray(data.refs);
    };
    const vcRemoteStateOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.remote;
      return r3 && typeof r3.state === "string" ? r3.state : "idle";
    };
    const vcRemoteReadAtOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.remote;
      const data = r3 && r3.data;
      return data && typeof data.readAtMs === "number" ? data.readAtMs : null;
    };
    const vcRemoteRemotesOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.remote;
      const data = r3 && r3.data;
      return data && Array.isArray(data.remotes) ? data.remotes : [];
    };
    const vcRemoteErrorOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.remote;
      return r3 && r3.state === "err" ? r3.error : null;
    };
    const vcRemoteOnlineStateOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.online;
      return r3 && typeof r3.state === "string" ? r3.state : "idle";
    };
    const vcRemoteOnlineNameOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.online;
      return r3 && typeof r3.name === "string" ? r3.name : "";
    };
    const vcRemoteOnlineOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.online;
      if (!r3 || r3.state !== "ok" || !vcRmOnlineShapeOk(r3.data)) return null;
      return r3.data;
    };
    const vcRemoteOnlineErrorOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.online;
      return r3 && r3.state === "err" ? r3.error : null;
    };
    const vcRmMerge = function(reads, key, next) {
      const base = reads || vcNewRemoteReads();
      const patch = {};
      patch[key] = next;
      return Object.assign({}, base, patch);
    };
    const vcApplyRemoteReply = function(reads, kind, reply) {
      const which = String(kind) === "online" ? "online" : "remote";
      const prev = reads && reads[which] || {};
      if (which === "remote") {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcRmLocalShapeOk(reply)) {
          return vcRmMerge(reads, "remote", { state: "ok", data: { source: "local", readAtMs: reply.readAtMs, remotes: reply.remotes }, error: null });
        }
        const fail = vcRmFailureOf(reply);
        return vcRmMerge(reads, "remote", { state: "err", data: prev.data || null, error: fail });
      }
      const name = String(reply && (reply.remoteName || reply.error && reply.error.remote) || prev.name || "");
      if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcRmOnlineShapeOk(reply)) {
        const data = { source: "network", remoteName: String(reply.remoteName || name), refs: reply.refs, count: typeof reply.count === "number" ? reply.count : reply.refs.length, readAtMs: reply.readAtMs, truncated: false };
        return vcRmMerge(reads, "online", { state: "ok", name: data.remoteName, data, error: null });
      }
      return vcRmMerge(reads, "online", { state: "err", name, data: null, error: vcRmFailureOf(reply) });
    };
    const vcReadRemoteList = function(reads, call, cwd) {
      const base = reads || vcNewRemoteReads();
      const prev = base.remote || { state: "idle", data: null, error: null };
      const loading = vcRmMerge(base, "remote", { state: "loading", data: prev.data || null, error: null });
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_REMOTE_PHONES.list, { cwd: String(cwd || "") });
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcRmLocalShapeOk(reply)) vcRmOkLog(VC_REMOTE_PHONES.list, "git-remote-list", t0);
        else vcRmFailLog(VC_REMOTE_PHONES.list, "git-remote-list", t0, vcRmFailureOf(reply));
        return vcApplyRemoteReply(loading, "remote", reply);
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        const fail = { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) };
        vcRmFailLog(VC_REMOTE_PHONES.list, "git-remote-list", t0, fail);
        return vcRmMerge(loading, "remote", { state: "err", data: prev.data || null, error: fail });
      });
    };
    const vcReadRemoteOnline = function(reads, call, cwd, name, refs) {
      const base = reads || vcNewRemoteReads();
      const remoteName = String(name || "");
      const selectors = Array.isArray(refs) ? refs.map(function(r3) {
        return String(r3);
      }) : [];
      const loading = vcRmMerge(base, "online", { state: "loading", name: remoteName, data: null, error: null });
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_REMOTE_PHONES.online, { cwd: String(cwd || ""), name: remoteName, refs: selectors });
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcRmOnlineShapeOk(reply)) vcRmOkLog(VC_REMOTE_PHONES.online, "git-remote-online", t0);
        else vcRmFailLog(VC_REMOTE_PHONES.online, "git-remote-online", t0, vcRmFailureOf(reply));
        return vcApplyRemoteReply(loading, "online", reply);
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        const fail = { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) };
        vcRmFailLog(VC_REMOTE_PHONES.online, "git-remote-online", t0, fail);
        return vcRmMerge(loading, "online", { state: "err", name: remoteName, data: null, error: fail });
      });
    };
    const vcRunRemoteWrite = function(reads, call, phone, args) {
      const base = reads || vcNewRemoteReads();
      const method = String(phone || "");
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(method, args || {});
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true) vcRmOkLog(method, "git-remote-write", t0);
        else vcRmFailLog(method, "git-remote-write", t0, vcRmFailureOf(reply));
        return { reads: base, reply };
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        const fail = { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) };
        vcRmFailLog(method, "git-remote-write", t0, fail);
        return { reads: base, reply: { ok: false, error: fail } };
      });
    };

    const vcQueryCatalogOf = function() {
      return VC_QUERY_CATALOG.map(function(e3) {
        const cap = vcCapabilityOf(e3.capId) || {};
        const page = String(cap.page || "");
        return {
          kind: e3.kind,

          limit: e3.limit,

          //   本页不另写一份名单；诊断页上这四条要额外标「主入口」并高亮。
          diagnostic: page === "diagnostics"
        };
      });

    const vcQueryEntriesOf = function(page) {

      return vcQueryCatalogOf().filter(function(e3) {
        return e3.page === want;
      });
    };
    const vcQueryEntryOf = function(kind) {
      const want = String(kind || "");
      const found = VC_QUERY_CATALOG.filter(function(e3) {
        return e3.kind === want;
      });
      return found.length === 1 ? vcQueryCatalogOf().filter(function(e3) {
        return e3.kind === want;
      })[0] : null;
    };
    const vcQueryDefaultsOf = function(kind) {
      const out = {};
      VC_QUERY_CATALOG.forEach(function(e3) {
        if (e3.kind !== String(kind || "")) return;
        e3.fields.forEach(function(f3) {
          if (f3.value !== void 0) out[f3.name] = String(f3.value);
        });
      });
      return out;
    };
    const vcQueryInputsOf = function() {

        out[e3.kind] = vcQueryDefaultsOf(e3.kind);
      });
      return out;

    const vcQueryInputValueOf = function(inputs, kind, field) {
      const one = inputs && inputs[String(kind)] || {};
      const v3 = one[String(field)];
      return v3 === void 0 || v3 === null ? "" : String(v3);

    const vcNewQueries = function() {
      return {};
    };
    const vcQueryStateOf = function(queries, kind) {
      const one = queries && queries[String(kind)];
      return one && typeof one === "object" ? one : { state: "idle", seq: 0, data: null, error: null };
    };
    const vcMarkQueryLoading = function(queries, kind) {
      const next = Object.assign({}, queries || {});
      const cur = vcQueryStateOf(queries, kind);
      next[String(kind)] = { state: "loading", seq: Number(cur.seq || 0) + 1, data: cur.data, error: null };
      return next;
    };
    const vcApplyQueryReply = function(current, next, kind) {
      const cur = vcQueryStateOf(current && current.queries, kind);
      const nxt = vcQueryStateOf(next && next.queries, kind);
      if (Number(cur.seq || 0) > Number(nxt.seq || 0)) return current;
      return next;
    };
    const vcQueryParamsOf = function(kind, values) {
      const entry = vcQueryEntryOf(kind);
      if (!entry) return { ok: false, field: "", reason: "unknown-kind" };
      const v3 = values || {};
      const pick = function(name) {
        const x4 = v3[String(name)];
        return x4 === void 0 || x4 === null ? "" : String(x4).trim();
      };
      const bad2 = function(field, reason) {
        return { ok: false, field: String(field), reason: String(reason) };
      };
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < entry.fields.length; i3 += 1) {
        const f3 = entry.fields[i3];
        const text2 = pick(f3.name);
        if (f3.required && text2 === "") return bad2(f3.name, "required-missing");
        if (f3.type === "number" && text2 !== "" && !/^[0-9]+$/.test(text2)) return bad2(f3.name, "not-number");
      }
      if (kind === "blame") {
        const a3 = Number(pick("lineStart"));
        const b3 = Number(pick("lineEnd"));
        if (b3 < a3) return bad2("lineEnd", "range-order");
        if (b3 - a3 + 1 > VC_QUERY_BLAME_SPAN_MAX) return bad2("lineEnd", "range-span");
      }
      const params = {};
      entry.fields.forEach(function(f3) {
        const text2 = pick(f3.name);
        if (text2 === "") return;
        params[f3.name] = f3.type === "number" ? Number(text2) : text2;
      });
      return { ok: true, params };
    };
    const vcQueryShapeOk = function(kind, reply) {
      if (!reply || reply.ok !== true || String(reply.kind || "") !== String(kind || "")) return false;
      if (kind === "file-history" || kind === "grep" || kind === "pickaxe") return Array.isArray(reply.commits) && typeof reply.count === "number";
      if (kind === "blame") return Array.isArray(reply.lines) && typeof reply.count === "number";
      if (kind === "compare") return Array.isArray(reply.files) && typeof reply.total === "number" && typeof reply.truncated === "boolean";
      if (kind === "range-diff") return Array.isArray(reply.pairs) && Array.isArray(reply.extraLines) && typeof reply.truncated === "boolean";
      if (kind === "describe") return typeof reply.text === "string" && typeof reply.dirty === "boolean";
      if (kind === "reflog") return Array.isArray(reply.entries) && typeof reply.count === "number";
      if (kind === "notes") return (reply.note === null || typeof reply.note === "string") && typeof reply.reason === "string";
      if (kind === "show-file") return typeof reply.text === "string" && typeof reply.binary === "boolean";
      return false;
    };
    const vcQueryOkLog = function(kind, t0) {
      try {
        log("info", "host.call", { method: VC_QUERY_PHONE, latencyMs: Date.now() - t0, ok: true, kind: "git-history-query" });
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    const vcQueryFailLog = function(kind, t0, error) {
      try {
        log("warn", "host.call.fail", { method: VC_QUERY_PHONE, kind: "git-history-query", errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(kind) + " " + String(error && error.message || error || ""), 120, "error")) });
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    const vcQuerySettle = function(reads, kind, patch) {
      const base = reads && typeof reads === "object" ? reads : {};
      const cur = vcQueryStateOf(base.queries, kind);
      const next = Object.assign({}, base);
      next.queries = Object.assign({}, base.queries || {});
      next.queries[String(kind)] = Object.assign({ state: "idle", seq: cur.seq, data: cur.data, error: null }, patch);
      return next;
    };
    const vcReadHistoryQuery = function(reads, call, cwd, kind, values) {
      const key = String(kind || "");
      const fail = function(error) {
        return Promise.resolve(vcQuerySettle(reads, key, { state: "err", error }));
      };
      if (!vcShouldRead(cwd)) return fail({ kind: "no-cwd", field: "", reason: "no-cwd", message: "" });
      const built = vcQueryParamsOf(key, values);
      if (!built.ok) return fail({ kind: "invalid-input", field: built.field, reason: built.reason, message: "" });
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_QUERY_PHONE, { cwd: String(cwd), kind: key, params: built.params });
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcQueryShapeOk(key, reply)) {
          vcQueryOkLog(key, t0);
          return vcQuerySettle(reads, key, { state: "ok", data: reply, error: null });
        }
        const bad2 = vcFailureOf(reply);
        vcQueryFailLog(key, t0, bad2);
        return vcQuerySettle(reads, key, { state: "err", error: { kind: bad2.kind, field: "", reason: bad2.kind === "shape" ? "shape" : "git", message: bad2.message } });
      }).catch(function(err) {
        const thrown = { kind: "throw", message: String(err && err.message || err || "") };
        vcQueryFailLog(key, t0, thrown);
        return vcQuerySettle(reads, key, { state: "err", error: { kind: "throw", field: "", reason: "git", message: thrown.message } });
      });
    };
    const vcQueryEmptyOf = function(kind, reply) {
      if (!reply) return "";
      if (kind === "notes") return reply.note === null ? "no-note" : "";
      const reason = String(reply.reason || "");
      if (reason === "empty") return "commits";
      if (reason === "same") return kind === "range-diff" ? "rangeSame" : "same";
      if (kind === "show-file" && reply.binary !== true && String(reply.text || "") === "") return "content";
      return "";
    };
    const vcQueryTruncatedOf = function(reply) {
      if (!reply || reply.truncated !== true) return null;
      const total = Number(reply.total);
      if (Array.isArray(reply.files)) return { shown: reply.files.length, total: isFinite(total) ? total : reply.files.length };
      if (Array.isArray(reply.pairs)) return { shown: reply.pairs.length, total: isFinite(total) ? total : reply.pairs.length };
      return null;
    };
    const vcQueryShownOf = function(kind, reply) {
      if (!reply) return 0;
      if (Array.isArray(reply.commits)) return reply.commits.length;
      if (Array.isArray(reply.lines)) return reply.lines.length;
      if (Array.isArray(reply.files)) return reply.files.length;
      if (Array.isArray(reply.pairs)) return reply.pairs.length;
      if (Array.isArray(reply.entries)) return reply.entries.length;
      return 0;
    };
    const VC_QUERY_MARK_KEY = {
      "<": "vc.query.range.onlyOld",
      ">": "vc.query.range.onlyNew",
      "=": "vc.query.range.same",
      "!": "vc.query.range.diff"
    };
    const vcQueryWidthOf = function(width) {
      const n2 = Number(width);
      return !isFinite(n2) || n2 <= 0 ? 460 : Math.round(n2);
    };
    const vcQueryLabelOf = function(t3, field) {
      return t3(String(field && field.labelKey || ""));
    };
    const vcQueryFieldNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {

    const vcQueryListNode = function(h4, o3) {

        ]);
      }
      if (kind === "notes") {

      }
      if (kind === "show-file") {
        if (reply.binary === true) return h4("p", { key: "b", className: "vcs-query-binary", "data-vc-query-binary": "1" }, t3("vc.query.result.binary"));
        return h4("pre", { key: "c", className: "vcs-query-content", "data-vc-query-content": "1" }, String(reply.text || ""));
      }
      return null;
    };
    const vcQueryFailTextOf = function(t3, entry, error) {
      const e3 = error || {};
      const field = function() {
        const fields = entry && entry.fields || [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < fields.length; i3 += 1) if (String(fields[i3].name) === String(e3.field || "")) return vcQueryLabelOf(t3, fields[i3]);

      };

        return t3("vc.query.failed");

      if (e3.kind === "truncated") return t3("vc.query.truncatedFail");
      return t3("vc.query.failedDetail", { msg: String(e3.message || "") });
    };
    const vcQueryStateNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {

    const vcQueryEntryNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {
      const entry = o3.entry;

        })));

        type: "button",
        className: "vcs-query-run",

        "data-log": "vc.query.run." + kind,
        "aria-label": t3("vc.query.run") + " " + String(entry.name || ""),
        onClick: o3.onRun ? function() {
          o3.onRun(kind);
        } : void 0
      }, t3("vc.query.run"))));
      kids.push(vcQueryStateNode(h4, t3, { entry, state, width: o3.width, nowMs: o3.nowMs, onRun: o3.onRun }));
      return h4("section", {
        key: kind,

        "data-vc-query": kind,
        "data-vc-query-cap": String(entry.capId || ""),
        "data-vc-query-page": String(entry.page || ""),
        "data-vc-query-primary": primary ? "1" : "0",
        "data-vc-query-state": String(state.state || "idle")
      }, kids);
    };
    const vcQueryPageNode = function(h4, t3, opts) {
      const o3 = opts || {};
      const page = String(o3.page || "");
      const entries = vcQueryEntriesOf(page);
      if (entries.length === 0) return null;
      const width = vcQueryWidthOf(o3.width);
      const readAt = Number(o3.nowMs) || Date.now();
      const inputs = o3.inputs || vcQueryInputsOf();
      const queries = o3.queries || vcNewQueries();
      const kids = [
        h4("h2", { key: "title", className: "vcs-query-title" }, t3("vc.query.title")),
        h4("p", { key: "note", className: "vcs-query-note" }, t3("vc.query.note"))
      ];
      if (page === "diagnostics") kids.push(h4("p", { key: "diag", className: "vcs-query-diagnostics", "data-vc-query-diagnostics": "1" }, t3("vc.query.diagnosticsNote")));
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        kids.push(vcQueryEntryNode(h4, t3, { entry, inputs, state: vcQueryStateOf(queries, entry.kind), width, nowMs: readAt, onInput: o3.onInput, onRun: o3.onRun }));
      });
      return h4("section", { className: "vcs-query", id: "vc-query-" + page, "data-vc-query-panel": page, "data-vc-query-panel-count": String(entries.length) }, kids);
    };
    const VC_QUERY_PANEL = function(props) {
      const p3 = props || {};
      const t3 = typeof p3.t === "function" ? p3.t : function(k4) {
        return String(k4);
      };
      const page = String(p3.page || "commits");
      const call = function(method, args) {
        if (typeof host === "undefined" || !host || typeof host.call !== "function") return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, error: { kind: "shape", message: "" } });
        return host.call(method, args);
      };
      const seed = p3.seed || null;
      const [inputs, setInputs] = React.useState(function() {
        return Object.assign(vcQueryInputsOf(), seed && seed.inputs || {});
      });
      const [queries, setQueries] = React.useState(function() {
        return seed && seed.queries || vcNewQueries();
      });
      const queriesRef = React.useRef(queries);
      queriesRef.current = queries;
      const inputsRef = React.useRef(inputs);
      inputsRef.current = inputs;
      const onInput = function(kind, field, value) {
        setInputs(function(cur) {
          const next = Object.assign({}, cur);
          const one = Object.assign({}, cur[String(kind)] || {});
          one[String(field)] = String(value);
          next[String(kind)] = one;
          return next;
        });
      };
      const onRun = function(kind) {
        const marked = vcMarkQueryLoading(queriesRef.current, kind);
        setQueries(marked);
        Promise.resolve(vcReadHistoryQuery({ queries: marked }, call, String(p3.cwd || ""), kind, (inputsRef.current || {})[String(kind)] || {})).then(function(next) {
          setQueries(function(cur) {
            return vcApplyQueryReply({ queries: cur }, next, kind).queries;
          });
        });
      };
      return vcQueryPageNode(React.createElement, t3, {
        page,
        width: p3.width,
        nowMs: p3.nowMs,
        inputs,
        queries,
        onInput,
        onRun
      });
    };
    const VC_COMMIT_PHONES = {
      form: "wf.gitCommitForm",
      check: "wf.gitWriteCheck",
      write: "wf.gitCommit"
    };
    function vcCommitInitialState() {
      return {
        plan: commitPlanOf(null),
        message: "",
        state: "idle",
        form: null,
        formProblem: "",
        decision: null,
        result: null,
        confirm: null
      };
    }
    const vcCommitOpsOf = function(deps) {
      const d3 = deps || {};
      const ui = d3.ui;
      const setUi = d3.setUi;
      const callHost = d3.callHost;
      const cwd = d3.cwd;
      const nowMs = typeof d3.nowMs === "function" ? d3.nowMs : function() {
        return Date.now();
      };
      const onDone = typeof d3.onDone === "function" ? d3.onDone : function() {
        return null;
      };
      let seq = 0;
      const state = function() {
        return ui && ui.commit || vcCommitInitialState();
      };
      const setCommit = function(patch) {
        setUi(function(cur) {
          const prev = cur && cur.commit || vcCommitInitialState();
          return Object.assign({}, cur, { commit: Object.assign({}, vcCommitInitialState(), prev, patch || {}) });
        });
      };
      const planNow = function() {
        return commitPlanOf(state().plan);
      };
      const requestIdOf = function() {
        seq += 1;
        return "c" + String(nowMs()).slice(-6) + "-" + String(seq);
      };
      const loadForm = function() {
        return Promise.resolve(callHost(VC_COMMIT_PHONES.form, { cwd })).then(function(reply) {
          if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) {
            setCommit({ form: null, formProblem: reply && reply.error && reply.error.message || "" });
            return reply;
          }
          setCommit({ form: reply, formProblem: "" });
          return reply;
        }, function(err) {
          setCommit({ form: null, formProblem: String(err && err.message || err) });
          return null;
        });
      };
      const selectMode = function(mode) {
        const plan = planNow();
        plan.mode = commitPlanOf({ mode }).mode;
        plan.target = "";
        const patch = { plan, decision: null, result: null, confirm: null };
        const form = state().form;
        if (plan.mode === "amend" && form && form.amend && form.amend.available === true) patch.message = String(form.amend.message || "");
        setCommit(patch);
      };
      const selectTarget = function(target) {
        const plan = planNow();
        plan.target = String(target === void 0 || target === null ? "" : target);
        setCommit({ plan, decision: null, result: null });
      };
      const setMessage = function(text2) {
        setCommit({ message: String(text2 === void 0 || text2 === null ? "" : text2), result: null });
      };
      const toggleOption = function(name) {
        const plan = planNow();
        const key = String(name || "");
        if (key === "skipHooks" || key === "sign" || key === "signoff") plan[key] = plan[key] !== true;
        setCommit({ plan, decision: null, result: null });
      };
      const applyTemplate = function() {
        const form = state().form;
        if (!form || !form.template || form.template.problem || !String(form.template.text || "")) return false;
        const text2 = String(form.template.text || "");
        const cur = String(state().message || "");
        setCommit({ message: cur.trim() === "" ? text2 : cur + (cur.slice(-1) === "\n" ? "" : "\n") + text2, templateApplied: true });
        return true;
      };
      const failureOf = function(reply, plan) {
        const err = reply && reply.error || {};
        return { state: "fail", reason: String(err.reason || ""), message: String(err.message || ""), hint: String(err.hint || ""), mode: plan.mode };
      };
      const runWrite = function(plan, ticketId) {
        setCommit({ state: "running", result: null, confirm: null });
        const payload = { cwd, ticketId, requestId: requestIdOf(), message: String(state().message || ""), plan };
        return Promise.resolve(callHost(VC_COMMIT_PHONES.write, payload)).then(function(reply) {
          if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) {
            const res2 = failureOf(reply, plan);
            setCommit({ state: "idle", result: res2 });
            return res2;
          }
          const res = { state: "ok", mode: plan.mode, headAfter: String(reply.headAfter || ""), atMs: Number(reply.atMs || nowMs()), ms: 0, cmd: "commit" };
          setCommit({ state: "idle", result: res, decision: null });
          if (plan.mode !== "amend") setCommit({ message: "" });
          onDone(res);
          return res;
        }, function(err) {
          const res = { state: "fail", reason: "unknown-write-failure", message: String(err && err.message || err), hint: "", mode: plan.mode };
          setCommit({ state: "idle", result: res });
          return res;
        });
      };
      const runCheck = function(plan) {
        setCommit({ state: "running", result: null });
        const extra = { cwd, op: "commit", message: String(state().message || ""), plan };
        return Promise.resolve(callHost(VC_COMMIT_PHONES.check, extra)).then(function(reply) {
          if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) {
            const res = failureOf(reply, plan);
            setCommit({ state: "idle", decision: reply && reply.decision || null, result: res });
            return res;
          }
          const ticket = reply && reply.ticket || {};
          if (commitPlanDangerous(plan)) {
            setCommit({ state: "idle", decision: reply && reply.decision || null, confirm: { plan, ticketId: ticket.id, checkedAtMs: ticket.checkedAtMs }, result: null });
            return { state: "confirm", mode: plan.mode };
          }
          return runWrite(plan, ticket.id);
        }, function(err) {
          const res = { state: "fail", reason: "unknown-write-failure", message: String(err && err.message || err), hint: "", mode: plan.mode };
          setCommit({ state: "idle", result: res });
          return res;
        });
      };
      const submit = function() {
        if (state().state === "running") return null;
        const plan = planNow();
        const problem = commitPlanProblem(plan);
        if (problem) {
          setCommit({ state: "idle", result: { state: "fail", reason: problem, message: "", hint: "", mode: plan.mode } });
          return null;
        }
        return runCheck(plan);
      };
      const confirmNow = function() {
        const confirm = state().confirm;
        if (!confirm || !confirm.ticketId) return null;
        return runWrite(commitPlanOf(confirm.plan), confirm.ticketId);
      };
      const cancelConfirm = function() {
        setCommit({ confirm: null, state: "idle" });
      };
      const retry = function() {
        setCommit({ result: null });
        return submit();
      };
      const clearResult = function() {
        setCommit({ result: null });
      };
      return {
        state,
        loadForm,
        selectMode,
        selectTarget,
        setMessage,
        toggleOption,
        applyTemplate,
        submit,
        confirmNow,
        cancelConfirm,
        retry,
        clearResult
      };
    };
    const VC_COMMIT_BLOCK_KEYS = {
      "need-commit-target": "vc.block.needCommitTarget",
      "bad-commit-target": "vc.block.badCommitTarget",
      "nothing-to-amend": "vc.block.nothingToAmend",
      "signing-failed": "vc.block.signingFailed",
      "nothing-staged": "vc.block.nothingStaged",
      "conflicts-unresolved": "vc.block.conflicts",
      "bare-repo": "vc.block.bareRepo",
      "detached-head": "vc.block.detachedHead",
      "mid-merge": "vc.block.midOperation",
      "mid-rebase": "vc.block.midOperation",
      "mid-cherry-revert": "vc.block.midOperation"
    };
    function commitBlockKeyOf(reason) {
      const key = String(reason === void 0 || reason === null ? "" : reason);
      return VC_COMMIT_BLOCK_KEYS[key] || "vc.block.unknown";
    }
    function commitModeSuffix(mode) {
      if (mode === "amend") return "Amend";
      if (mode === "fixup" || mode === "squash") return "Fixup";
      return "";
    }
    function vcCommitPanelOf(o3) {
      const opts = o3 || {};
      const t3 = opts.t;
      const ui = opts.ui || {};
      const commit = ui.commit || {};
      const plan = commitPlanOf(commit.plan);
      const form = commit.form || null;
      const decision = commit.decision || null;
      const message = String(commit.message === void 0 || commit.message === null ? "" : commit.message);
      const trailer = form ? commitTrailerOf(form.identity || {}) : "";
      const targets = Array.isArray(opts.targets) ? opts.targets : [];
      const running = commit.state === "running";
      const amendReady = !!(form && form.amend && form.amend.available === true);
      const noHead = !!(form && form.amend && form.amend.available === false);
      const modeLabel = function(mode) {
        return t3(VC_COMMIT_MODE_KEYS[mode] || "vc.commit.mode.staged");
      };
      const blockedReason = commitPlanProblem(commit.plan) || (decision && decision.verdict === "block" ? String((decision.reasons || []).filter(function(r3) {
        return r3 !== "ok";
      })[0] || "") : "");
      const blockedKey = blockedReason ? commitBlockKeyOf(blockedReason) : "";
      const needsMessage = message.trim() === "" && plan.mode !== "amend" && plan.mode !== "fixup";
      const msgProblemKey = needsMessage ? "vc.commitArea.needMessage" : "";
      const modes = VC_COMMIT_MODES.map(function(mode) {
        const disabled = (mode === "amend" || mode === "fixup" || mode === "squash") && noHead;
        return {
          mode,
          cap: VC_COMMIT_MODE_CAPS[mode],
          selected: plan.mode === mode,
          disabled,
          label: modeLabel(mode),
          hint: t3("vc.commit.mode.hint." + mode),
          reasonKey: disabled ? "vc.block.nothingToAmend" : "",
          tip: disabled ? t3("vc.block.nothingToAmend") : ""
        };
      });
      const target = targets.filter(function(c3) {
        return c3 && c3.oid === plan.target;
      })[0] || null;
      const targetRow = plan.mode === "fixup" || plan.mode === "squash" ? {
        show: true,
        label: t3("vc.commit.targetLabel"),
        value: plan.target,
        placeholder: t3("vc.commit.targetPlaceholder"),
        problem: plan.target === "" ? t3("vc.block.needCommitTarget") : "",
        options: targets.map(function(c3) {
          return { oid: String(c3.oid || ""), label: String(c3.short || "") + " " + String(c3.subject || "") };
        })
      } : { show: false };
      const template = form && form.template || null;
      const templateDisabled = running || !template || template.configured !== true || !!template.problem || !String(template.text || "");
      let templateNote = "";
      if (!form) templateNote = "";
      else if (!template || template.configured !== true) templateNote = t3("vc.commit.templateNone");
      else if (template.problem) templateNote = t3("vc.commit.templateMissing", { path: String(template.path || "") });
      else templateNote = t3("vc.commit.templateHint", { path: String(template.path || "") });
      const signing = form && form.signing || null;
      const signNoKey = !!signing && String(signing.key || "") === "";
      const preview = message + (plan.signoff && trailer ? (message === "" ? "" : "\n\n") + trailer : "");
      const options = [
        { key: "skipHooks", cap: "2.5", label: t3("vc.commit.opt.skipHooks"), hint: t3("vc.commit.opt.skipHooksHint"), checked: plan.skipHooks === true, disabled: running },
        { key: "sign", cap: "2.6", label: t3("vc.commit.opt.sign"), hint: signNoKey ? t3("vc.commit.opt.signNoKey") : signing ? t3("vc.commit.opt.signHint", { format: String(signing.format || "openpgp"), key: String(signing.key || "") }) : t3("vc.commit.opt.signHint", { format: "openpgp", key: "" }), checked: plan.sign === true, disabled: running || signNoKey },
        { key: "signoff", cap: "2.6", label: t3("vc.commit.opt.signoff"), hint: trailer ? t3("vc.commit.opt.signoffHint", { trailer }) : t3("vc.commit.opt.signoffNoIdentity"), checked: plan.signoff === true, disabled: running || trailer === "" }
      ];
      const submitDisabled = running || !!blockedKey || !!msgProblemKey;
      const submitTip = blockedKey ? t3(blockedKey) : msgProblemKey ? t3(msgProblemKey) : "";
      let amendNote = "";
      if (form && form.amend) {
        if (plan.mode === "amend" && form.amend.available === true) amendNote = t3("vc.commit.amendPrefill", { oid: String(form.amend.short || ""), subject: String(form.amend.subject || "") });
        else if (noHead && plan.mode === "amend") amendNote = t3("vc.commit.amendNoHead");
      }
      const confirm = commit.confirm ? function() {
        const suffix = commitModeSuffix(plan.mode);
        const params = { mode: modeLabel(plan.mode), oid: String(form && form.amend && form.amend.short || ""), target: target ? String(target.short || "") : plan.target };
        return {
          segments: [
            { seg: "what", text: t3("vc.commit.confirm.what" + suffix, params) },
            { seg: "wont", text: t3("vc.commit.confirm.wont" + suffix, params) },
            { seg: "reversible", text: t3("vc.commit.confirm.reversible", params) },
            { seg: "verb", text: t3("vc.commit.confirm.verb" + suffix, params) }
          ],
          trailerText: trailer ? t3("vc.commit.confirm.trailer", { trailer }) : "",
          messageText: t3("vc.commit.confirm.commitMsg", { message: message === "" ? t3("vc.commit.confirm.emptyMsg") : message }),
          cancelText: t3("vc.commit.confirm.cancel"),
          goText: t3("vc.commit.confirm.go", { mode: modeLabel(plan.mode) })
        };
      }() : null;
      let result = null;
      if (commit.result) {
        const r3 = commit.result;
        if (r3.state === "ok") {
          result = { state: "ok", retry: false, tip: "", text: t3(plan.mode === "amend" ? "vc.commit.result.okAmend" : "vc.commit.result.ok", { mode: modeLabel(plan.mode), ms: Number(r3.ms || 0), cmd: String(r3.cmd || "commit") }) };
        } else {
          const reasonKey = r3.reason ? commitBlockKeyOf(r3.reason) : "";
          const extra = [String(r3.message || ""), reasonKey ? t3(reasonKey) : ""].filter(function(s3) {
            return s3 !== "";
          }).join(": ");
          result = { state: "fail", retry: true, tip: String(r3.hint || ""), text: t3("vc.commit.result.fail", { mode: modeLabel(plan.mode), ms: Number(r3.ms || 0) }) + (extra ? ": " + extra : "") };
        }
      }
      return {
        mode: plan.mode,
        modeLabel: modeLabel(plan.mode),
        modeHint: t3("vc.commit.mode.hint." + plan.mode),
        modes,
        targetRow,
        message,
        preview,
        templateDisabled,
        templateNote,
        templateText: !templateDisabled && template ? String(template.text || "").slice(0, 2e3) : "",
        options,
        trailer,
        trailerText: trailer ? t3("vc.commit.confirm.trailer", { trailer }) : "",
        submitDisabled,
        submitTip,
        running,
        confirm,
        amendNote,
        amendOid: String(form && form.amend && form.amend.short || ""),
        formProblem: String(commit.formProblem || ""),
        result
      };
    }

    const VC_TASK_PHONES = {
      start: "wf.gitTaskStart",
      query: "wf.gitTaskQuery",
      cancel: "wf.gitTaskCancel"
    };
    const VC_TASK_OP_CAMEL = function(op) {
      return String(op || "").replace(/-([a-z])/g, function(_m, c3) {
        return c3.toUpperCase();
      });
    };
    const vcTaskOpLabelKeyOf = function(op) {
      return "vc.task.op." + VC_TASK_OP_CAMEL(op);
    };
    const vcTaskRequestIdOf = function(nowMs, salt) {
      return "t" + Number(nowMs || 0).toString(36) + String(salt || "").replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "").slice(0, 12);
    };
    const vcTaskStart = function(call, cwd, op, payload) {
      const p3 = payload || {};
      const args = {
        cwd: String(cwd || ""),
        op: String(op || ""),
        args: p3.args && typeof p3.args === "object" ? p3.args : {}
      };
      if (p3.confirm === true) args.confirm = true;
      if (p3.requestId) args.requestId = String(p3.requestId);
      if (p3.stdinFile && typeof p3.stdinFile === "object") {
        args.stdinFile = {
          path: String(p3.stdinFile.path || ""),
          sizeBytes: p3.stdinFile.sizeBytes,
          sha256: String(p3.stdinFile.sha256 || "")
        };
      }
      return call(VC_TASK_PHONES.start, args);
    };
    const vcTaskQuery = function(call) {
      return call(VC_TASK_PHONES.query, {});
    };
    const vcTaskCancel = function(call, taskId) {
      return call(VC_TASK_PHONES.cancel, { taskId: String(taskId || "") });
    };
    const vcTaskProgressOf = function(task) {
      const t3 = task || {};
      const raw = t3.percent;
      const percent = typeof raw === "number" && isFinite(raw) && raw >= 0 && raw <= 100 ? Math.round(raw) : null;
      return {
        phase: typeof t3.phase === "string" && t3.phase.length > 0 ? t3.phase : null,
        percent,
        uncertain: String(t3.state || "") === "running" && percent === null,
        receivedBytes: typeof t3.receivedBytes === "number" ? t3.receivedBytes : null,
        elapsedMs: typeof t3.elapsedMs === "number" ? t3.elapsedMs : null,
        truncated: t3.truncated === true
      };
    };
    const VC_TASK_CONCLUSIONS = ["succeeded", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted"];
    const vcTaskConclusionOf = function(task) {
      const t3 = task || {};
      const interrupted = t3.interrupted === true || String(t3.conclusion || "") === "interrupted";
      if (interrupted) {
        return { state: "interrupted", key: "vc.task.doneInterrupted", params: {}, noteKey: "vc.task.interruptedNote", noteParams: {} };
      }
      const raw = String(t3.conclusion || "");
      if (!raw) return null;
      const state = VC_TASK_CONCLUSIONS.indexOf(raw) >= 0 ? raw : "failed";
      if (state === "succeeded") {
        return { state: "succeeded", key: "vc.task.doneSucceeded", params: {}, noteKey: "", noteParams: {} };
      }
      if (state === "cancelled") {
        const residual2 = String(t3.residual || "");
        return { state: "cancelled", key: "vc.task.doneCancelled", params: {}, noteKey: residual2 ? "vc.task.residual" : "", noteParams: residual2 ? { residual: residual2 } : {} };
      }
      const line = String(t3.failureLine || "");
      const residual = String(t3.residual || "");
      if (line) {
        return { state: "failed", key: "vc.task.doneFailed", params: {}, noteKey: "vc.task.doneFailedLine", noteParams: { line } };
      }
      return { state: "failed", key: "vc.task.doneFailed", params: {}, noteKey: residual ? "vc.task.residual" : "", noteParams: residual ? { residual } : {} };
    };
    const vcTaskRowNode = function(h4, t3, task, handlers) {
      const tk = task || {};
      const hs = handlers || {};
      const id = String(tk.taskId || "");

      if (model.percent !== null) {
        kids.push(h4("div", { key: "percent", className: "vcs-task-percent", "data-vc-task-percent": String(model.percent) }, t3("vc.task.percent", { percent: String(model.percent) })));
      } else if (running) {
        kids.push(h4("div", { key: "percent", className: "vcs-task-percent", "data-vc-task-uncertain": "1" }, t3("vc.task.percentUnknown")));
      }
      if (model.phase !== null) {
        kids.push(h4("div", { key: "phase", className: "vcs-task-phase", "data-vc-task-phase": model.phase }, t3("vc.task.phase", { phase: model.phase })));
      } else if (running) {
        kids.push(h4("div", { key: "phase", className: "vcs-task-phase" }, t3("vc.task.phaseUnknown")));
      }
      if (model.receivedBytes !== null) {
        kids.push(h4("div", { key: "bytes", className: "vcs-task-bytes", "data-vc-task-bytes": String(model.receivedBytes) }, t3("vc.task.bytes", { bytes: String(model.receivedBytes) })));

    const vcBranchShapeOk = function(board) {
      if (!board || typeof board !== "object" || Array.isArray(board)) return false;
      if (String(board.contract || "") !== VC_BRANCH_BOARD_CONTRACT) return false;
      if (Number(board.version) !== VC_BRANCH_BOARD_VERSION) return false;

      if (!Array.isArray(board.branches) || !Array.isArray(board.tags)) return false;
      if (!board.descriptions || typeof board.descriptions !== "object" || Array.isArray(board.descriptions)) return false;
      return true;
    };
    const vcBranchCheckShapeOk = function(reply) {
      if (!reply || typeof reply !== "object" || Array.isArray(reply)) return false;
      if (reply.ok !== true && reply.ok !== false) return false;
      if (String(reply.contract || "") !== VC_BRANCH_CHECK_CONTRACT) return false;
      if (Number(reply.version) !== VC_BRANCH_CHECK_VERSION) return false;
      if (typeof reply.readAtMs !== "number" || !isFinite(reply.readAtMs)) return false;
      if (typeof reply.op !== "string" || reply.op === "") return false;
      if (reply.op === "verify") return true;
      if (reply.ok === true) return !!reply.ticket && typeof reply.ticket === "object" && typeof reply.ticket.id === "string" && reply.ticket.id !== "";
      return !!reply.error && typeof reply.error === "object";
    };
    const vcReadBranches = function(reads, call, cwd) {
      const base = reads || {};
      const prev = base.branch || vcNewBranchRead();
      const t0 = Date.now();

        }

        vcBrFailLog(VC_BRANCHES_PHONE, "git-branches", t0, fail);
        return Object.assign({}, base, { branch: { state: "err", data: prev.data, error: fail, check: prev.check || null, write: prev.write || null } });
      }).catch(function(e3) {

        vcBrFailLog(VC_BRANCHES_PHONE, "git-branches", t0, fail);

      });

    const vcBranchRequestOf = function(op, fields) {
      const want = String(op || "");
      const f3 = fields || {};
      let kind = "";
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < VC_BRANCH_ACTIONS.length; i3 += 1) if (VC_BRANCH_ACTIONS[i3].op === want) kind = VC_BRANCH_ACTIONS[i3].kind;

      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < keys.length; i3 += 1) if (f3[keys[i3]] !== void 0) req[keys[i3]] = f3[keys[i3]];

    const vcBranchCheck = function(reads, call, cwd, op, fields) {
      const base = reads || {};
      const prev = base.branch || vcNewBranchRead();
      const req = vcBranchRequestOf(op, fields);
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {

      }).then(function(reply) {
        const shapeOk = vcBranchCheckShapeOk(reply);
        const good = shapeOk && reply.ok === true;
        if (good) vcBrOkLog(VC_BRANCH_CHECK_PHONE, req.op, t0);
        else vcBrFailLog(VC_BRANCH_CHECK_PHONE, req.op, t0, { kind: shapeOk ? String(((reply || {}).error || {}).kind || "blocked") : "shape", message: "" });
        const check = shapeOk ? { state: good ? "ok" : "err", data: reply, error: good ? null : { kind: String((reply.error || {}).kind || "blocked"), message: String((reply.error || {}).message || "") } } : { state: "err", data: null, error: { kind: "shape", message: "预检回包形状不对" } };
        return Object.assign({}, base, { branch: { state: prev.state, data: prev.data, error: prev.error, check, write: prev.write || null } });
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        vcBrFailLog(VC_BRANCH_CHECK_PHONE, req.op, t0, { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) });
        const check = { state: "err", data: null, error: { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) } };
        return Object.assign({}, base, { branch: { state: prev.state, data: prev.data, error: prev.error, check, write: prev.write || null } });

    const vcBranchCheckKindOf = function(reply) {

      if (reply.ok === true) return "done";

      if (kind === "need-confirm") return "need-confirm";

      return kind === "blocked" ? "blocked" : "fail";

      const selector = String(entry.selector || "");
      const oid = String(entry.oid || "");
      const when = vcStashWhenOf(entry.atMs);
      const filesKnown = ctx2.detail && ctx2.detail.selector === selector && Array.isArray(ctx2.detail.files);
      const fileNote = filesKnown ? vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.entry.files", { n: String(ctx2.detail.fileCount) }) : vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.entry.filesUnknown", null);
      const head = h4("p", { className: "vcs-stash-line", "data-vc-stash-line": "summary" }, [
        h4("strong", { key: "subject", "data-vc-stash-subject": "1" }, vcStashEntrySubjectOf(t3, entry)),
        h4("span", { key: "selector", className: "vcs-stash-selector", "data-vc-stash-selector": selector }, selector),
        h4(Tip, { key: "oid", content: oid }, h4("span", { key: "oid", className: "vcs-stash-oid", "data-vc-stash-oid": "1" }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.entry.oid", { oid: vcStashShortOidOf(oid) }))),
        h4("span", { key: "at", className: "vcs-stash-when", "data-vc-stash-at": "1" }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.entry.at", { when })),
        h4("span", { key: "files", className: "vcs-stash-files", "data-vc-stash-files": "1" }, fileNote)
      ]);
      const actions = VC_STASH_ROW_OPS.map(function(op) {
        const def = stashOpOf(op);
        if (!def) return null;
        if (op === VC_STASH_STAGED_OP && !vcStashOpVisibleOf(op, ctx2.versionText)) return null;
        const isDanger = def.danger === true;
        const props = {
          type: "button",
          key: op,
          className: "vcs-stash-row-act" + (isDanger ? " vcs-stash-danger" : ""),
          "data-vc-stash-op": op,
          "data-vc-stash-cap": def.id,
          disabled: ctx2.pending === true,
          onclick: function() {
            ctx2.act({ op, selector });
          }
        };
        if (isDanger) props["data-vc-stash-danger"] = "1";
        return h4("button", props, vcStashText(t3, def.nameKey, null));
      }).filter(function(node) {
        return !!node;
      });
      const children = [head, h4("div", { key: "acts", className: "vcs-stash-row-acts" }, actions)];
      if (ctx2.branchFor === selector) {
        children.push(
          h4("div", { key: "branch", className: "vcs-stash-branch", "data-vc-stash-branch-box": selector }, [
            h4("input", {
              key: "input",
              type: "text",
              "data-vc-stash-branch-input": "1",
              placeholder: vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.branch.placeholder", null),
              value: ctx2.branchName,
              oninput: function(ev) {
                ctx2.edit({ branch: String(ev && ev.target && ev.target.value || "") });
              }
            }),
            h4("button", { key: "go", type: "button", "data-vc-stash-branch-go": "1", disabled: ctx2.pending === true, onclick: function() {
              ctx2.act({ op: "branch", selector, branch: ctx2.branchName });
            } }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.branch.go", null)),
            h4("button", { key: "cancel", type: "button", "data-vc-stash-branch-cancel": "1", onclick: function() {
              ctx2.edit({ branchFor: "" });
            } }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.branch.cancel", null))
          ])
        );
      }
      return h4("li", { key: selector, className: "vcs-stash-entry", "data-vc-stash-entry": selector, "data-vc-stash-oid-full": oid }, children);
    };
    const vcStashToolbarOf = function(h4, t3, ctx2) {
      const buttons = [];
      VC_STASH_TOOL_OPS.forEach(function(op) {
        const def = stashOpOf(op);
        if (!def) return;
        if (!vcStashOpVisibleOf(op, ctx2.versionText)) return;
        const isDanger = def.danger === true;
        const props = {
          type: "button",
          key: op,
          className: "vcs-stash-tool" + (isDanger ? " vcs-stash-danger" : ""),
          "data-vc-stash-op": op,
          "data-vc-stash-cap": def.id,
          disabled: ctx2.pending === true,
          onclick: function() {
            ctx2.act({ op, message: ctx2.message, selector: "" });
          }
        };
        if (isDanger) props["data-vc-stash-danger"] = "1";
        buttons.push(h4("button", props, vcStashText(t3, def.nameKey, null)));
      });
      const messageBox = h4("label", { key: "message", className: "vcs-stash-message" }, [
        h4("span", { key: "label" }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.message.label", null)),

          "data-vc-stash-message-input": "1",
          placeholder: vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.message.placeholder", null),
          value: ctx2.message,
          oninput: function(ev) {
            ctx2.edit({ message: String(ev && ev.target && ev.target.value || "") });
          }
        })
      ]);
      const staged = vcStashStagedStateOf(ctx2.versionText);

        ]));
      }
      return children;
    };
    const vcStashConfirmBlockOf = function(h4, t3, state, ctx2) {
      if (!state.confirm || !state.confirm.op) return null;
      const def = stashOpOf(state.confirm.op);
      const verb = def ? vcStashText(t3, def.nameKey, null) : vcStashText(t3, STASH_UNKNOWN_OP_KEY, null);

      return h4("div", { className: "vcs-stash-confirm-wrap", "data-vc-stash-confirm": state.confirm.op }, [
