            ctx2.actConfirmed();
          } }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.confirm.go", { verb })),

            ctx2.edit({ confirm: null });
          } }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.confirm.cancel", null))
        ])
      ]);

    const vcStashDetailBlockOf = function(h4, t3, state, ctx2) {

        h4("button", { key: "close", type: "button", "data-vc-stash-detail-close": "1", onclick: function() {
          ctx2.edit({ detail: null });
        } }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.detail.close", null))

    const vcStashRecentBlockOf = function(h4, t3, state, ctx2) {
      const recent = vcStashRecentOf(state);
      const items = recent.map(function(one) {
        return h4("li", { key: one.oid, "data-vc-stash-recent-item": one.oid }, [

        ]);
      });

      ]);
    };
    const vcStashResultBlockOf = function(h4, t3, state) {
      const result = state.result;
      if (!result) return null;
      if (result.ok === true) {
        return h4("div", { className: "vcs-stash-result", "data-vc-stash-result": "ok", role: "status" }, [
          vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.result.ok", { op: vcStashText(t3, stashOpNameKeyOf(result.op), null) }),
          " · ",
          vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.result.next", null)
        ]);
      }
      const key = vcStashFailKeyOf(result.kind);
      const vars = {};
      if (result.needed) vars.needed = result.needed;
      return h4("div", { className: "vcs-stash-result vcs-stash-result-fail", "data-vc-stash-result": "fail", "data-vc-stash-fail-kind": result.kind, role: "status" }, vcStashText(t3, key, vars));
    };
    const vcStashPageNode = function(h4, t3, opts) {
      const o3 = opts || {};
      const state = o3.state || vcStashStateNew();
      const reads = o3.seed || {};
      const entries = state.entries && state.entries.length ? state.entries : vcStashEntriesOf(reads);
      const listState = state.entries && state.entries.length ? "ok" : vcStashListStateOf(reads);
      const versionText = state.versionText || vcStashVersionTextOf(reads);
      const pending = !!state.pending;
      const act = function(input) {
        if (typeof o3.onStash === "function" && !pending) o3.onStash(vcStashActionPayloadOf(input));
      };
      const edit = function(patch) {
        if (typeof o3.onStashEdit === "function") o3.onStashEdit(patch || {});
      };
      const ctx2 = {
        versionText,
        message: String(state.message || ""),
        detail: state.detail,
        pending,
        branchFor: state.branch && state.branch.selector ? String(state.branch.selector) : "",
        branchName: state.branch && state.branch.name ? String(state.branch.name) : "",
        act,
        edit,
        actConfirmed: function() {
          const payload = vcStashConfirmPayloadOf(state.confirm);
          if (payload && !pending) act(payload);
        }
      };
      const sorted = entries.slice().sort(function(a3, b3) {
        return (Number(b3.atMs) || 0) - (Number(a3.atMs) || 0);
      });
      const rows = sorted.map(function(entry) {
        return vcStashRowOf(h4, t3, entry, ctx2);
      });
      const status = state.branch && state.branch.errorKey ? h4("p", { className: "vcs-stash-branch-err", "data-vc-stash-branch-err": state.branch.errorKey }, vcStashText(t3, state.branch.errorKey, null)) : null;
      let listNode;
      if (listState === "err" || listState === "load-fail") {
        listNode = h4("p", { className: "vcs-stash-list-err", "data-vc-stash-list": "err", role: "alert" }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.list.err", null));
      } else if (rows.length === 0) {
        listNode = h4("p", { className: "vcs-stash-list-empty", "data-vc-stash-list": "empty" }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.list.empty", null));
      } else {
        listNode = h4("ul", { className: "vcs-stash-list", "data-vc-stash-list": "ok", "data-vc-stash-count": String(rows.length) }, rows);
      }
      return h4("section", {
        className: "vcs-stash-page",
        "data-vc-stash-page": "1",
        "data-vc-stash-count": String(sorted.length),
        "data-vc-stash-version": versionText,
        "data-vc-stash-pending": pending ? "1" : "0"
      }, [
        h4("h2", { key: "title", className: "vcs-stash-title" }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.title", null)),
        h4("p", { key: "lede", className: "vcs-stash-lede" }, vcStashText(t3, "vc.stash.lede", null)),
        h4("div", { key: "tools", className: "vcs-stash-toolbar" }, vcStashToolbarOf(h4, t3, ctx2)),
        vcStashConfirmBlockOf(h4, t3, state, ctx2),
        status,
        h4("div", { key: "result" }, [vcStashResultBlockOf(h4, t3, state)]),
        listNode,
        h4("div", { key: "detail" }, [vcStashDetailBlockOf(h4, t3, state, ctx2)]),
        vcStashRecentBlockOf(h4, t3, state, ctx2)
      ]);
    };
    const VC_DIAG_PHONES = { read: "wf.gitDiagnosticsRead", check: "wf.gitDiagnosticsCheck", write: "wf.gitDiagnosticsWrite" };
    const VC_DIAG_QUERY_ROWS = [
      { cap: "13.4", kind: "ls-files", fields: ["paths"] },
      { cap: "13.5", kind: "cat-file", fields: ["object", "mode"] },
      { cap: "13.6", kind: "ls-tree", fields: ["rev"] },
      { cap: "13.7", kind: "rev-parse", fields: ["rev"] },
      { cap: "13.8", kind: "for-each-ref", fields: ["prefix"] },
      { cap: "13.9", kind: "is-ancestor", fields: ["ancestor", "descendant"] },
      { cap: "13.10", kind: "cherry", fields: ["upstream", "head"] },
      { cap: "13.11", kind: "rev-list", fields: ["mode", "left", "right"] }
    ];
    const VC_DIAG_BISECT_ACTIONS = [
      { key: "start", op: "bisect-start", needs: ["bad", "good"] },
      { key: "bad", op: "bisect-bad" },
      { key: "good", op: "bisect-good" },
      { key: "skip", op: "bisect-skip" },
      { key: "reset", op: "bisect-reset" }
    ];
    const VC_DIAG_POINTERS = [
      { cap: "13.3", page: "search" },
      { cap: "13.14", page: "commits" }
    ];
    const VC_DIAG_BISECT_CAP = "13.2";
    const VC_DIAG_PATCH_CAP = "13.12";
    const VC_DIAG_TRAILER_CAP = "13.13";
    const VC_DIAG_REPLACE_CAP = "5.12";
    const DANGEROUS_OPS = ["bisect-start", "bisect-reset", "replace-create", "replace-delete"];
    function vcDiagnosticsStateNew() {
      return { running: "", confirm: null, reads: {}, results: {}, inputs: {} };
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsInputOf(inputs, cap, key) {
      const holder = inputs && inputs[cap];
      const value = holder ? holder[key] : "";
      return value === void 0 || value === null ? "" : String(value);
    }
    const FIXED_READS = {
      "13.2": { kind: "bisect-status", params: {} },
      "5.12": { kind: "replace-list", params: {} }
    };
    function vcDiagnosticsReadPayloadOf(cap, inputs) {
      if (FIXED_READS[String(cap)]) return { phone: "read", args: { kind: FIXED_READS[String(cap)].kind, params: {} } };
      const rows = VC_DIAG_QUERY_ROWS.filter(function(row2) {
        return row2.cap === String(cap);
      });
      if (rows.length === 0) return null;
      const row = rows[0];
      const params = {};
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < row.fields.length; i3 += 1) {
        const key = row.fields[i3];
        const raw = vcDiagnosticsInputOf(inputs, cap, key);
        if (key === "paths") {
          params.paths = raw.split(/[\s,]+/).filter(function(s3) {
            return s3 !== "";
          });
        } else {
          params[key] = raw;
        }
      }
      return { phone: "read", args: { kind: row.kind, params } };
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsPatchPayloadOf(inputs) {
      const patch = vcDiagnosticsInputOf(inputs, VC_DIAG_PATCH_CAP, "patch");
      return { phone: "read", args: { kind: "apply-check", params: { patch } } };
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsTrailerPayloadOf(inputs) {
      const object = vcDiagnosticsInputOf(inputs, VC_DIAG_TRAILER_CAP, "object");
      return { phone: "read", args: { kind: "trailers", params: { object: object === "" ? "HEAD" : object } } };
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsReplaceListPayloadOf() {
      return { phone: "read", args: { kind: "replace-list", params: {} } };
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsWritePayloadOf(op, values) {
      const v3 = values || {};
      const args = { op: String(op) };
      if (args.op === "bisect-start") {
        args.bad = String(v3.bad === void 0 ? "" : v3.bad);
        args.good = String(v3.good === void 0 ? "" : v3.good);
      } else if (args.op === "replace-create") {
        args.from = String(v3.from === void 0 ? "" : v3.from);
        args.to = String(v3.to === void 0 ? "" : v3.to);
      } else if (args.op === "replace-delete") {
        args.object = String(v3.object === void 0 ? "" : v3.object);
      }
      return { phone: "check", args };
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsDangerousOf(op) {
      return DANGEROUS_OPS.indexOf(String(op)) >= 0;
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsCallOf(call, cwd, payload) {
      const p3 = payload || {};
      const name = VC_DIAG_PHONES[p3.phone] || p3.phone;
      return call(name, Object.assign({ cwd }, p3.args || {}));
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsFailKeyOf(kind, reason) {
      const k4 = String(kind || "");
      const r3 = String(reason || "");
      const reasonKeys = {
        "not-a-commit": "vc.diag.reason.notACommit",
        "already-bisecting": "vc.diag.reason.alreadyBisecting",
        "not-bisecting": "vc.diag.reason.notBisecting",
        "same-object": "vc.diag.reason.sameObject",
        "already-replaced": "vc.diag.reason.alreadyReplaced",
        "no-replace": "vc.diag.reason.noReplace",
        "bad-target": "vc.diag.reason.badTarget",
        "need-confirm": "vc.diag.reason.needConfirm"
      };
      if (reasonKeys[r3]) return reasonKeys[r3];
      const kindKeys = {
        args: "vc.diag.fail.args",
        blocked: "vc.diag.fail.blocked",
        timeout: "vc.diag.fail.timeout",
        truncated: "vc.diag.fail.truncated",
        exit: "vc.diag.fail.exit",
        "git-failed": "vc.diag.fail.git",
        env: "vc.diag.fail.env",
        parse: "vc.diag.fail.parse"
      };
      return kindKeys[k4] || "vc.diag.fail.unknown";
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsShortOidOf(oid) {
      const s3 = String(oid === void 0 || oid === null ? "" : oid);
      return s3.length > 8 ? s3.slice(0, 8) : s3;
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsResultOf(cap, phone, reply) {
      const r3 = reply || {};
      const error = r3.error || null;
      const base = { cap, phone, atMs: r3.atMs || null, ok: error === null };
      if (error) {
        base.failKey = vcDiagnosticsFailKeyOf(error.kind, r3.reason);
        base.message = String(error.message || "");
        base.git = String(r3.git || "");
        base.step = String(r3.step || "");
        base.expected = String(r3.expected || "");
        base.actual = String(r3.actual || "");
        base.cause = String(r3.cause || "");
      } else {
        base.command = String(r3.command || "");
        base.kind = String(r3.kind || "");
        base.op = String(r3.op || "");
        base.rows = vcDiagnosticsRowsOf(String(r3.kind || r3.op || cap), r3);
      }
      return base;
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsRowsOf(kind, payload) {
      const p3 = payload || {};
      const out = [];
      if (kind === "grep") {
        const matches = Array.isArray(p3.matches) ? p3.matches : [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < matches.length; i3 += 1) out.push(String(matches[i3].path) + ":" + String(matches[i3].line) + ": " + String(matches[i3].text));
      } else if (kind === "ls-files") {
        const paths = Array.isArray(p3.paths) ? p3.paths : [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < paths.length; i3 += 1) out.push(String(paths[i3]));
      } else if (kind === "cat-file") {
        if (p3.objectType) out.push(String(p3.objectType));
        if (p3.text !== void 0 && p3.text !== null) out.push(String(p3.text));
      } else if (kind === "ls-tree") {
        const rows = Array.isArray(p3.rows) ? p3.rows : [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < rows.length; i3 += 1) out.push(String(rows[i3].mode) + " " + String(rows[i3].type) + " " + vcDiagnosticsShortOidOf(rows[i3].oid) + " " + String(rows[i3].path));
      } else if (kind === "rev-parse") {
        out.push(p3.missing === true ? "" : String(p3.oid || ""));
      } else if (kind === "for-each-ref") {
        const rows = Array.isArray(p3.rows) ? p3.rows : [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < rows.length; i3 += 1) out.push(String(rows[i3].ref) + " " + vcDiagnosticsShortOidOf(rows[i3].oid) + " " + String(rows[i3].subject || ""));
      } else if (kind === "is-ancestor") {
        out.push(String(p3.isAncestor === true));
      } else if (kind === "cherry") {
        const rows = Array.isArray(p3.rows) ? p3.rows : [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < rows.length; i3 += 1) out.push(String(rows[i3].marker) + " " + vcDiagnosticsShortOidOf(rows[i3].oid) + " " + String(rows[i3].subject || ""));
      } else if (kind === "rev-list") {
        if (p3.count !== void 0) out.push(String(p3.count));
        else out.push(String(p3.left) + " / " + String(p3.right));
      } else if (kind === "trailers") {
        const trailers = Array.isArray(p3.trailers) ? p3.trailers : [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < trailers.length; i3 += 1) out.push(String(trailers[i3].token) + ": " + String(trailers[i3].value));
      } else if (kind === "replace-list") {
        const replaces = Array.isArray(p3.replaces) ? p3.replaces : [];
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < replaces.length; i3 += 1) out.push(String(replaces[i3]));
      } else if (kind === "bisect-status") {
        if (p3.active === true) {
          const bad2 = Array.isArray(p3.bad) ? p3.bad : [];
          const good = Array.isArray(p3.good) ? p3.good : [];
          out.push("bad: " + bad2.map(vcDiagnosticsShortOidOf).join(" "));
          out.push("good: " + good.map(vcDiagnosticsShortOidOf).join(" "));
          if (p3.firstBad) out.push("first-bad: " + vcDiagnosticsShortOidOf(p3.firstBad));
        } else out.push("0");
      } else if (kind === "apply-check") {
        out.push(p3.clean === true ? "clean" : "blocked");
        if (p3.gitSays) out.push(String(p3.gitSays));
      }
      return out;
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsApplyReadReply(state, cap, reply) {
      const next = Object.assign({}, state);
      next.running = "";
      const reads = Object.assign({}, state.reads || {});
      const results = Object.assign({}, state.results || {});
      const result = vcDiagnosticsResultOf(cap, "read", reply);
      results[cap] = result;
      if (result.ok) reads[cap] = { kind: reply.kind, atMs: reply.atMs || null, rows: result.rows };
      next.reads = reads;
      next.results = results;
      return next;
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsApplyWriteReply(state, cap, reply) {
      const next = Object.assign({}, state);
      next.running = "";
      next.confirm = null;
      const results = Object.assign({}, state.results || {});
      results[cap] = vcDiagnosticsResultOf(cap, "write", reply);
      next.results = results;
      return next;
    }
    function vcDiagnosticsActionsOf(deps) {
      const d3 = deps || {};
      let seq = 0;
      let localUi = d3.ui || {};
      const uiOf = function() {
        return localUi.diagnostics || vcDiagnosticsStateNew();
      };
      const set = function(next) {
        localUi = Object.assign({}, localUi, { diagnostics: next });
        d3.setUi(function() {
          return localUi;
        });
      };
      const state = function() {
        return uiOf();
      };
      const run = function(payload) {
        return Promise.resolve(vcDiagnosticsCallOf(d3.callHost, d3.cwd, payload));
      };
      const requestId = function() {
        seq += 1;
        return "d" + String(Number(d3.nowMs ? d3.nowMs() : 0)).slice(-6) + "-" + String(seq);
      };
      const setInput = function(cap, key, value) {
        const cur = state();
        const holder = Object.assign({}, (cur.inputs || {})[cap] || {});
        holder[key] = String(value === void 0 || value === null ? "" : value);
        const inputs = Object.assign({}, cur.inputs || {});
        inputs[cap] = holder;
        set(Object.assign({}, cur, { inputs }));
      };
      const read = function(cap, payload) {
        const cur = state();
        if (cur.running) return Promise.resolve(cur);
        set(Object.assign({}, cur, { running: String(cap) }));
        return run(payload || vcDiagnosticsReadPayloadOf(cap, cur.inputs)).then(function(reply) {
          const next = vcDiagnosticsApplyReadReply(state(), cap, reply);
          set(next);
          return next;
        });
      };
      const write = function(cap, op, ticketId, plan) {
        const cur = state();
        const args = { ticketId: String(ticketId), requestId: requestId(), op: String(op), confirmed: true };
        return run({ phone: "write", args }).then(function(reply) {
          const next = vcDiagnosticsApplyWriteReply(state(), cap, reply);
          set(next);
          return next;
        });
      };
      const submit = function(cap, op, values) {
        const cur = state();
        if (cur.running) return Promise.resolve(cur);
        set(Object.assign({}, cur, { running: String(op) }));
        const payload = vcDiagnosticsWritePayloadOf(op, values);
        return run(payload).then(function(reply) {
          const r3 = reply || {};
          if (r3.ok !== true) {
            const next = vcDiagnosticsApplyWriteReply(state(), cap, r3);
            set(next);
            return next;
          }
          const confirm = r3.confirm || null;
          if (r3.confirmRequired === true && confirm) {
            const next = Object.assign({}, state(), { running: "", confirm: { cap: String(cap), op: String(op), ticketId: String((r3.ticket || {}).id || ""), verb: String(confirm.verb || ""), target: String(confirm.target || "") } });
            set(next);
            return next;
          }
          return write(cap, op, (r3.ticket || {}).id, null);
        });
      };
      const confirmNow = function() {
        const cur = state();
        const c3 = cur.confirm;
        if (!c3 || cur.running) return Promise.resolve(cur);
        set(Object.assign({}, cur, { running: String(c3.op) }));
        return write(String(c3.cap), String(c3.op), c3.ticketId, null);
      };
      const cancelConfirm = function() {
        const cur = state();
        set(Object.assign({}, cur, { confirm: null }));
      };
      const clearResult = function(cap) {
        const cur = state();
        const results = Object.assign({}, cur.results || {});
        delete results[String(cap)];
        set(Object.assign({}, cur, { results }));
      };
      return {
        state,
        setInput,
        read,
        submit,
        confirmNow,
        cancelConfirm,
        clearResult
      };
    }

          primaryEntry: cap ? String(cap.primaryEntry || "") : "",

    function vcUndoPickOpOf(inputs, kind) {

    function vcUndoRevProblem(rev) {
      const text2 = String(rev === void 0 || rev === null ? "" : rev).trim();
      if (text2 === "") return "required";
      if (text2.length > VC_UNDO_REV_MAX) return "too-long";
      if (/[\s\u0000]/.test(text2)) return "bad-shape";
      if (text2.charAt(0) === "-") return "bad-shape";
      if (text2.indexOf("..") >= 0) return "bad-shape";
      if (text2.indexOf(":") >= 0) return "bad-shape";
      if (text2.indexOf("\\") >= 0) return "bad-shape";
      return null;
    }
    function vcUndoCommitsOf(input) {
      let raw = [];
      if (Object.prototype.toString.call(input) === "[object Array]") {
        const arr = input;
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < arr.length; i3 += 1) raw.push(String(arr[i3] === void 0 || arr[i3] === null ? "" : arr[i3]));
      } else {
        const text2 = String(input === void 0 || input === null ? "" : input).replace(/\r/g, "");
        raw = text2.split("\n");
      }
      const out = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < raw.length; i3 += 1) {
        const one = raw[i3].trim();
        if (one !== "") out.push(one);
      }
      if (out.length === 0) return { ok: false, reason: "commits-empty", index: 0, field: "commits" };
      if (out.length > VC_UNDO_COMMIT_MAX) return { ok: false, reason: "commits-too-many", index: 0, field: "commits" };
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < out.length; i3 += 1) {
        if (vcUndoRevProblem(out[i3]) !== null) return { ok: false, reason: "commits-invalid", index: i3 + 1, field: "commits" };
        for (let j4 = 0; j4 < i3; j4 += 1) if (out[j4] === out[i3]) return { ok: false, reason: "commits-duplicate", index: i3 + 1, field: "commits" };
      }
      return { ok: true, commits: out };
    }
    function vcUndoParamsOf(inputs) {
      const src = inputs || vcUndoInputsOf();
      const entry = vcUndoEntryOf(String(src.op === void 0 || src.op === null ? "" : src.op));
      if (!entry) return { ok: false, reason: "unknown-op", field: "op", index: 0 };
      const params = { op: entry.kind, target: "", message: "", commits: [] };
      if (entry.needsTarget === true) {
        const target = String(src.target === void 0 || src.target === null ? "" : src.target).trim();
        if (target === "") return { ok: false, reason: "required-target", field: "target", index: 0 };
        const problem = vcUndoRevProblem(target);
        if (problem === "too-long") return { ok: false, reason: "bad-target", field: "target", index: 0 };
        if (problem !== null) return { ok: false, reason: problem === "required" ? "required-target" : "bad-target", field: "target", index: 0 };
        params.target = target;
      }
      if (entry.needsMessage === true) {
        const message = String(src.message === void 0 || src.message === null ? "" : src.message);
        if (message.length > VC_UNDO_MESSAGE_MAX) return { ok: false, reason: "message-too-long", field: "message", index: 0 };
        params.message = message;
      }
      if (entry.needsCommits === true) {
        const picked = vcUndoCommitsOf(src.commits);
        if (picked.ok !== true) return { ok: false, reason: picked.reason, field: "commits", index: picked.index };
        params.commits = picked.commits;
      }
      return { ok: true, params };
    }
    function vcUndoCheckArgsOf(inputs, cwd) {
      const built = vcUndoParamsOf(inputs);
      if (built.ok !== true) return built;
      const p3 = built.params;
      const args = { cwd: String(cwd || ""), op: p3.op, target: p3.target, message: p3.message, commits: p3.commits };
      return { ok: true, args };
    }
    function vcUndoWriteArgsOf(inputs, cwd, ticketId, requestId) {
      const built = vcUndoCheckArgsOf(inputs, cwd);
      if (built.ok !== true) return built;
      const args = built.args;
      args.ticketId = String(ticketId || "");
      args.requestId = String(requestId || "");
      return { ok: true, args };
    }
    function vcUndoCheckShapeOk(reply) {
      if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) return false;
      if (String(reply.contract || "") !== "version-control.undo-check") return false;
      if (Number(reply.version) !== 1) return false;
      if (!reply.ticket || typeof reply.ticket.id !== "string" || reply.ticket.id === "") return false;
      if (!reply.plan || typeof reply.plan !== "object") return false;
      if (!reply.scene || typeof reply.scene !== "object") return false;
      if (typeof reply.danger !== "boolean") return false;
      if (Object.prototype.toString.call(reply.steps) !== "[object Array]") return false;
      return true;
    }
    function vcUndoWriteShapeOk(reply) {
      if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) return false;
      if (String(reply.op || "") === "") return false;
      if (!reply.after || typeof reply.after.headOid !== "string") return false;
      if (!reply.before || typeof reply.before.headOid !== "string") return false;
      if (typeof reply.stepsDone !== "number") return false;
      return true;
    }

    function vcUndoErrorOf(reply, fallback) {
      const r3 = reply || {};
      const err = r3.error || {};
      const detail = String(err.message || r3.message || "");
      const reason = String(err.reason || "");
      if (reason !== "") return { key: reason, reason, detail, field: String(r3.field || "") };
      const kind = String(err.kind || "");
      if (kind === "env" || kind === "parse" || kind === "exit" || kind === "not-repo") return { key: "git", reason: kind, detail, field: String(r3.field || "") };
      return { key: String(fallback || "git"), reason: kind, detail, field: String(r3.field || "") };
    }
    function vcUndoApplyCheck(state, seq, reply) {
      const src = state || vcUndoStateNew();
      if (Number(seq) < Number(src.seq || 0)) return src;
      if (vcUndoCheckShapeOk(reply)) {
        return { phase: "ready", seq: Number(seq), inputs: src.inputs, check: reply, result: src.result || null, error: null, requestId: String(src.requestId || "") };
      }
      return { phase: "failed", seq: Number(seq), inputs: src.inputs, check: null, result: src.result || null, error: vcUndoErrorOf(reply, "check"), requestId: String(src.requestId || "") };
    }
    function vcUndoApplyWrite(state, seq, reply) {
      const src = state || vcUndoStateNew();
      if (Number(seq) < Number(src.seq || 0)) return src;
      if (vcUndoWriteShapeOk(reply)) {
        return { phase: "done", seq: Number(seq), inputs: src.inputs, check: null, result: reply, error: null, requestId: String(src.requestId || "") };
      }
      return { phase: "failed", seq: Number(seq), inputs: src.inputs, check: src.check || null, result: src.result || null, error: vcUndoErrorOf(reply, "write"), requestId: String(src.requestId || "") };
    }

    }

    }

      };
      const setWt = function(patch) {
        const ui = uiNow() || {};
        const next = Object.assign(vcWorktreesUiOf(ui), patch || {});
        if (d3.setUi) d3.setUi(Object.assign({}, ui, { worktrees: next }));
        return next;
      };
      const setError = function(mode, op, reply) {
        const err = vcWorktreeFailureOf(reply);
        try {
          log("warn", "host.call.fail", { method: VC_WORKTREE_PHONES[String(err.kind) === "shape" ? "check" : "check"], kind: "git-worktree", errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(err.kind + " " + err.message, 120, "error")) });
        } catch (e3) {
        }
        return setWt({ mode, op, error: err, decision: null, plan: null, ticket: null, result: null, requestId: "" });
      };
      const refresh = function() {
        const reads = readsNow() || {};
        return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
          return vcReadFirstScreenOnManual(reads, call, cwdNow());
        }).then(function(next) {
          if (d3.setReads) d3.setReads(next);
          return next;
        });
      };
      const start = function(op, preset) {
        const action = vcWorktreeActionOf(op);
        const opName = vcWtStr(op);
        const prev = vcWorktreesUiOf(uiNow());
        const input = Object.assign({}, prev.input, preset || {});
        if (!action) return Promise.resolve(setError("failed", opName, { ok: false, error: { kind: "bad-op", message: "" } }));
        if (action.retry === true) return refresh();
        if (action.id === "list") return refresh();
        const model = vcWorktreesModelOf(readsNow() || {});
        const decision = vcWorktreesActionDecisionOf(model, opName, input);
        if (vcWorktreeDecisionStateOf(decision) === "block") {
          return Promise.resolve(setWt({ mode: "blocked", op: opName, input, decision, plan: null, ticket: null, result: null, error: null, requestId: "" }));
        }
        const t0 = Date.now();
        setWt({ mode: "checking", op: opName, input, decision, plan: null, ticket: null, result: null, error: null, requestId: "" });
        return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
          return call(VC_WORKTREE_PHONES.check, vcWorktreeCheckArgsOf(cwdNow(), opName, input));
        }).then(function(reply) {
          const ok = !!(reply && reply.ok === true);
          wtLog("check", t0, ok, { op: opName });
          if (!ok) return setError("failed", opName, reply);
          const nextDecision = reply.decision || decision;
          if (vcWorktreeDecisionStateOf(nextDecision) === "block") {
            return setWt({ mode: "blocked", op: opName, input, decision: nextDecision, plan: vcWorktreePlanOf(reply), ticket: null, result: null, error: null, requestId: "" });
          }
          const plan = vcWorktreePlanOf(reply);
          if (opName === "sparse-list") {
            return setWt({ mode: "plan", op: opName, input, decision: nextDecision, plan, ticket: null, result: null, error: null, requestId: "" });
          }
          return setWt({ mode: "confirm", op: opName, input, decision: nextDecision, plan, ticket: reply && reply.ticket || null, result: null, error: null, requestId: vcWorktreeRequestIdOf(Date.now(), String(reply && reply.ticket && reply.ticket.id || opName)) });
        }).catch(function(e3) {
          return setError("failed", opName, { ok: false, error: { kind: "throw", message: vcWtStr(e3 && e3.message) } });
        });
      };
      const confirmNow = function() {
        const prev = vcWorktreesUiOf(uiNow());
        if (prev.mode !== "confirm" || !prev.ticket) {
          return Promise.resolve(setError("failed", prev.op, { ok: false, error: { kind: "confirm-required", message: "" } }));
        }
        const opName = prev.op;
        const ticketId = vcWtStr(prev.ticket && prev.ticket.id);
        const requestId = prev.requestId !== "" ? prev.requestId : vcWorktreeRequestIdOf(Date.now(), ticketId);
        const t0 = Date.now();
        setWt({ mode: "running", requestId, error: null });
        return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
          return call(VC_WORKTREE_PHONES.run, vcWorktreeRunArgsOf(cwdNow(), opName, ticketId, requestId, prev.input));
        }).then(function(reply) {
          const ok = !!(reply && reply.ok === true);
          wtLog("run", t0, ok, { op: opName });
          if (!ok) {
            const next2 = setError("failed", opName, reply);
            return Promise.resolve(refresh()).then(function() {
              return next2;
            });
          }
          const result = vcWorktreeResultOf(reply);
          const next = setWt({ mode: "done", op: opName, result, error: null, ticket: null });
          return Promise.resolve(refresh()).then(function() {
            return next;
          });
        }).catch(function(e3) {
          return setError("failed", opName, { ok: false, error: { kind: "throw", message: vcWtStr(e3 && e3.message) } });
        });
      };
      const cancelConfirm = function() {
        const prev = vcWorktreesUiOf(uiNow());
        return setWt({ mode: "idle", op: "", decision: null, plan: null, ticket: null, result: null, error: null, requestId: "" });
      };
      const field = function(name, value) {
        const key = vcWtStr(name);
        if (["path", "dest", "branch", "reason"].indexOf(key) < 0) return vcWorktreesUiOf(uiNow());
        const prev = vcWorktreesUiOf(uiNow());
        const input = Object.assign({}, prev.input);
        input[key] = vcWtStr(value);
        return setWt({ input });
      };
      const pickDir = function(dir, on2) {
        const value = vcWtStr(dir);
        const prev = vcWorktreesUiOf(uiNow());
        const has = prev.input.dirs.indexOf(value) >= 0;
        const dirs = prev.input.dirs.slice(0);
        if (on2 === true && !has && value !== "") dirs.push(value);
        if (on2 !== true && has) dirs.splice(dirs.indexOf(value), 1);
        const input = Object.assign({}, prev.input, { dirs });
        return setWt({ input });
      };
      const retry = function() {
        const prev = vcWorktreesUiOf(uiNow());
        if (prev.mode === "blocked") return setWt({ mode: "idle", decision: null, plan: null, error: null });
        if (prev.op === "") return refresh();
        return start(prev.op, prev.input);
      };
      return {
        refresh,
        start,
        field,
        pickDir,
        confirmNow,
        cancelConfirm,
        retry
      };
    };
    const VC_WORKTREES_PAGE_SOURCE = "src/client/views/versionControl/vcWorktreesPage.ts";
    const VC_WORKTREES_ENTRY_DEFS = [
      { capId: "9.1", op: "list", row: false },
      { capId: "9.2", op: "add", row: false },
      { capId: "9.3", op: "add-branch", row: false },
      { capId: "9.4", op: "remove", row: true },
      { capId: "9.5", op: "prune", row: false },
      { capId: "9.6", op: "lock", row: true },
      { capId: "9.7", op: "move", row: true },
      { capId: "9.8", op: "sparse-list", row: true }
    ];

      if (rs.length === 0) return null;

      const version = vcWorktreeAvailabilityOf(model && model.version, capId);
      if (!version || version.state === "full") return null;
      const text2 = version.state === "hidden" || version.state === "degraded" ? vcWorktreesVersionHintOf(t3, capId) : String(t3("vc.wt.versionUnknown"));
      return h4("p", { key: "version", className: "vc-wt-version", "data-wt-version": String(version.state) }, text2);
    };
    const vcWtButtonNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {
      const opts = o3 || {};
      const decision = opts.decision || null;
      const blocked = decision ? vcWorktreeDecisionStateOf(decision) === "block" : false;
      const attrs = {
        key: opts.key || opts.op,
        type: "button",
        className: "vc-wt-btn vc-wt-btn-" + String(opts.op),
        "data-wt-action": String(opts.op),
        "data-wt-cap": String(opts.capId),
        "data-press": "button",
        "data-log": "vc.wt." + String(opts.op),
        onClick: function(ev) {
          const opName = String(opts.op);
          if (opName === "list") return vcWorktreeCall(opts.ops, "refresh");
          const preset = {};
          if (opts.path) preset.path = String(opts.path);
          if (opts.dirs) preset.dirs = opts.dirs;
          return vcWorktreeCall(opts.ops, "start", [opName, preset]);
        }
      };

        attrs.disabled = true;
        attrs["data-wt-why"] = k4;
        attrs.title = t3(k4);
      } else if (decision && vcWorktreeDecisionStateOf(decision) === "warn") {
        const rs = vcWorktreeDecisionReasonsOf(decision);
        attrs["data-wt-warn"] = vcWorktreeWhyKeyOf(rs.length ? rs[0] : "ok");
      }
      return h4("button", attrs, String(opts.label === void 0 ? t3("vc.wt.action." + String(opts.op)) : opts.label));
    };
    const vcWtFieldNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {

    const vcWtResultNode = function(h4, t3, ui, ops) {

    const vcWorktreesPageNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {
      const opts = o3 || {};

    const vcMigrateModelOf = function(reads, ui, width, nowMs) {

    const vcCloneCheckArgsOf = function(cwd, form) {

      const opt = cloneOptionsOf({
        depth: f3.depth,
        branch: f3.branch,
        recurseSubmodules: f3.recurseSubmodules,
        shallowSubmodules: f3.shallowSubmodules,
        offline: f3.offline
      });
      const args = { cwd: String(cwd || ""), op: "start", url: f3.url, dir: f3.dir };
      if (opt && opt.ok === true) {
        const o3 = opt.options || {};
        if (o3.depth !== null && o3.depth !== void 0) args.depth = o3.depth;
        if (o3.branch) args.branch = o3.branch;
        if (o3.recurseSubmodules === true) args.recurseSubmodules = true;
        if (o3.shallowSubmodules === true) args.shallowSubmodules = true;
        if (o3.offline === true) args.offline = true;

      args.ticketId = String(ticketId || "");
      args.requestId = String(requestId || "");
      if (confirmed === true) args.confirmed = true;
      return args;
    };
    const vcCloneCallOf = function(props) {
      const p3 = props || {};
      if (typeof p3.call === "function") return p3.call;
      if (typeof host !== "undefined" && host && typeof host.call === "function") return function(m3, a3) {
        return host.call(m3, a3);
      };
      return function() {
        return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, error: { kind: "shape", message: "" } });
      };
    };
    const vcCloneTicketOf = function(reply) {
      const t3 = reply && reply.ticket;
      if (!t3 || typeof t3 !== "object" || !t3.id) return null;
      return { id: String(t3.id), op: String(t3.op || ""), checkedAtMs: Number(t3.checkedAtMs || 0), expiresAtMs: Number(t3.expiresAtMs || 0) };
    };
    const vcCloneSceneOf = function(reply) {
      const s3 = reply && reply.scene;
      return s3 && typeof s3 === "object" ? s3 : null;
    };
    const vcCloneDecisionOf = function(reply) {
      const d3 = reply && reply.decision;
      if (!d3 || typeof d3 !== "object") return { verdict: "", reasons: [] };
      return { verdict: String(d3.verdict || ""), reasons: Array.isArray(d3.reasons) ? d3.reasons : [] };
    };
    const vcCloneReasonOf = function(reply) {
      const r3 = reply || {};
      if (typeof r3.reason === "string" && r3.reason) return r3.reason;
      const d3 = vcCloneDecisionOf(r3);
      if (d3.reasons.length > 0) return String(d3.reasons[0]);
      const e3 = r3.error || {};
      if (e3.reason) return String(e3.reason);
      return "";
    };
    const vcCloneReplyKindOf = function(reply) {
      const r3 = reply || {};
      if (r3 && r3.ok === true) {
        if (r3.task && typeof r3.task === "object") return "done";
        if (vcCloneTicketOf(r3)) return "checked";
      }
      const reason = vcCloneReasonOf(r3);
      const e3 = r3.error || {};
      const kind = String(e3.kind || "");
      if (reason === "ticket-missing" || reason === "ticket-expired" || reason === "ticket-op-mismatch" || reason === "target-changed" || reason === "stale-repo") return "stale";
      if (kind === "blocked" || reason === "target-not-empty" || reason === "target-not-directory" || reason === "target-unreadable" || reason === "cleanup-unregistered" || reason === "nothing-to-clean" || reason === "target-looks-complete") return "blocked";
      if (kind === "need-confirm" || reason === "need-confirm") return "need-confirm";
      if (r3 && r3.ok === false) return "fail";
      return "unknown";
    };
    const vcCloneTaskOf = function(reply, taskId) {
      const tasks = reply && Array.isArray(reply.tasks) ? reply.tasks : [];
      const id = String(taskId || "");
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < tasks.length; i3 += 1) {
        if (tasks[i3] && String(tasks[i3].taskId || "") === id) return tasks[i3];
      }
      return null;
    };
    const vcCloneProgressOf = function(task) {
      const t3 = task || {};
      const raw = t3.percent;
      const percent = typeof raw === "number" && isFinite(raw) && raw >= 0 && raw <= 100 ? Math.round(raw) : null;
      return {
        phase: typeof t3.phase === "string" && t3.phase ? t3.phase : "",
        percent,
        uncertain: String(t3.state || "") === "running" && percent === null
      };
    };
    const vcCloneResidualOf = function(task) {
      const t3 = task || {};
      if (String(t3.state || "") === "running") return "";
      return String(t3.residual || "");
    };
    const vcCloneTaskEndedOf = function(task) {
      const t3 = task || {};
      return t3.state !== "running" && !!t3.conclusion;
    };

    const vcCloneCheckNode = function(h4, t3, reply) {

    const vcClonePageNode = function(props) {

      React.useEffect(function() {
        return function() {
          aliveRef.current = false;
        };
      }, []);
      React.useEffect(function() {
        if (!taskId || !aliveRef.current) return;
        const timer2 = setInterval(function() {
          call(VC_CLONE_PHONES.query, {}).then(function(reply) {
            if (!aliveRef.current) return;
            const found = vcCloneTaskOf(reply, taskId);
            if (!found) return;

            if (vcCloneTaskEndedOf(found)) {
              setStep(String(found.conclusion) === "succeeded" ? "done" : String(found.conclusion) === "cancelled" ? "cancelled" : "failed");
            }
          }).catch(function() {
          });
        }, VC_TASK_POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
        return function() {
          clearInterval(timer2);
        };
      }, [taskId]);
      const failOf = function(reply) {

      };
      const onCheck = function() {
        setError("");
        setCheck(null);
        setStep("checking");
        call(VC_CLONE_PHONES.check, vcCloneCheckArgsOf(cwd, form)).then(function(reply) {

            setStep("form");
            setError(failOf(reply));
          }
        }).catch(function(e3) {

            setStep("form");
            setError(String(e3 && e3.message || e3));
          }

            setTask(null);
            setTaskId(String(started.taskId || reply.taskId || ""));
            return;
          }
          setStep("checked");
          setError(failOf(reply));
        }).catch(function(e3) {
          if (aliveRef.current) {
            setStep("checked");
            setError(String(e3 && e3.message || e3));
          }
        });
      };
      const onCancel = function() {

        call(VC_CLONE_PHONES.cancel, { taskId }).then(function(reply) {
          if (!aliveRef.current) return;

        }).catch(function() {
        });

            setCleanup(reply);
            setStep("cleanup");
          } else setCleanup(reply);
        }).catch(function() {
        });
      };

    function vcSubmoduleBoardShapeOk(board) {
      if (!board || typeof board !== "object") return false;
      if (board.ok !== true) return false;
      if (board.contract !== SUBMODULE_BOARD_CONTRACT) return false;
      if (board.version !== SUBMODULE_BOARD_VERSION) return false;
      return Array.isArray(board.rows);
    }
    function vcSubmoduleRowsOf(board) {
      const rows = board && Array.isArray(board.rows) ? board.rows : [];
      return rows.map(function(r3) {
        const row = r3 || {};
        return {
          name: String(row.name || ""),
          path: String(row.path || ""),
          oid: String(row.oid || ""),
          state: String(row.state || ""),
          initialized: row.initialized === true,
          describe: String(row.describe || ""),
          url: String(row.url || ""),
          urlDisplay: String(row.urlDisplay || row.url || ""),
          branch: String(row.branch || ""),
          headBranch: String(row.headBranch || ""),
          detached: row.detached === true,
          localCommits: typeof row.localCommits === "number" ? row.localCommits : 0,
          absorbable: row.absorbable === true,
          absorbFrom: String(row.absorbFrom || ""),
          absorbTo: String(row.absorbTo || "")
        };
      });
    }

    }
    function vcSubmoduleBatchOf() {

    function vcSubmoduleWhyKeyOf(reason) {

    }
    function vcSubmodulesStateOf(board) {
      if (!board) return "idle";
      if (board.state === "ok" && vcSubmoduleBoardShapeOk(board.board)) return "ok";
      if (board.state === "error") return "error";
      if (board.state === "loading" || board.state === "reading") return "loading";

    }

    function vcSubmoduleRequestIdOf(nowMs, salt) {
      const base = typeof nowMs === "number" && isFinite(nowMs) ? nowMs : Date.now();
      const tail = String(salt === void 0 || salt === null ? "" : salt).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, "");
      return ("s" + base.toString(36) + tail).slice(0, 12);
    }
    function vcSubmoduleCheckArgsOf(cwd, op, input, batch) {

      if (batch === true) out.batch = true;

      if (i3.url !== void 0 && String(i3.url) !== "") out.url = String(i3.url);
      if (i3.branch !== void 0 && String(i3.branch) !== "") out.branch = String(i3.branch);
      return out;
    }

"" : ticketId), requestId: String(requestId === void 0 || requestId === null ? "" : requestId), confirmed: true };
      if (p3.path !== void 0 && String(p3.path) !== "") out.path = String(p3.path);
      if (p3.url !== void 0 && String(p3.url) !== "") out.url = String(p3.url);
      if (p3.branch !== void 0 && String(p3.branch) !== "") out.branch = String(p3.branch);
      return out;
    }
    function vcSubmoduleTaskArgsOf(cwd, op, ticketId, requestId) {

    function vcSubmoduleFailureOf(reply) {
      const r3 = reply && typeof reply === "object" ? reply : {};
      const err = r3.error && typeof r3.error === "object" ? r3.error : {};
      return {
        kind: String(err.kind || r3.kind || "shape"),

        message: String(err.message || r3.message || ""),
        step: String(err.step || r3.step || ""),
        expected: String(err.expected || r3.expected || ""),
        actual: String(err.actual || r3.actual || ""),
        cause: String(err.cause || r3.cause || ""),
        gitText: String(err.git || r3.git || err.gitText || r3.gitText || "")
      };
    }
    function vcSubmoduleResultOf(reply) {
      const r3 = reply && typeof reply === "object" ? reply : {};
      if (r3.ok !== true) return null;
      const task = r3.task && typeof r3.task === "object" ? r3.task : null;
      return {
        state: "ok",
        op: String(r3.op || ""),
        command: String(r3.command || ""),
        ms: typeof r3.ms === "number" ? r3.ms : null,
        n: typeof r3.n === "number" ? r3.n : null,
        path: String(r3.path || ""),
        moves: Array.isArray(r3.moves) ? r3.moves : [],
        taskId: task ? String(task.taskId || task.id || "") : String(r3.taskId || "")
      };
    }
    function vcSubmoduleTicketOf(reply) {
      const r3 = reply && typeof reply === "object" ? reply : {};
      const t3 = r3.ticket && typeof r3.ticket === "object" ? r3.ticket : null;
      if (!t3 || !t3.id) return null;
      return { id: String(t3.id), op: String(t3.op || ""), expiresAtMs: typeof t3.expiresAtMs === "number" ? t3.expiresAtMs : 0 };
    }
    function vcSubmoduleActionOfId(id) {
      const want = String(id === void 0 || id === null ? "" : id);
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < SUBMODULE_ACTIONS.length; i3 += 1) {
        const a3 = SUBMODULE_ACTIONS[i3];
        if (a3 && a3.id === want) return a3;
      }
      return null;
    }
    function createSubmodulesOpsOf(deps) {
      const d3 = deps || {};
      const callHost = typeof d3.callHost === "function" ? d3.callHost : function() {
        return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, error: { kind: "env", message: "no-host" } });
      };
      const cwd = String(d3.cwd === void 0 || d3.cwd === null ? "" : d3.cwd);
      const uiOf = typeof d3.ui === "function" ? d3.ui : function() {
        return null;
      };
      const setUi = typeof d3.setUi === "function" ? d3.setUi : function() {
      };
      const boardOf = typeof d3.board === "function" ? d3.board : function() {
        return null;
      };
      const setBoard = typeof d3.setBoard === "function" ? d3.setBoard : function() {
      };
      function patch(next) {
        const base = vcSubmodulesUiOf(uiOf());
        setUi(Object.assign({}, base, next || {}));
        return Object.assign({}, base, next || {});
      }
      function logCall(method, ok, latencyMs) {
        try {
          log("info", "host.call", { method, latencyMs, ok: ok === true, kind: "git-submodule" });
        } catch (e3) {
        }
      }
      async function refresh() {
        patch({ mode: "reading", error: null });
        const startedAt = Date.now();
        let reply = null;
        try {
          reply = await callHost(VC_SUBMODULES_PHONES.read, { cwd });
        } catch (e3) {
          reply = { ok: false, error: { kind: "env", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) } };
        }
        logCall(VC_SUBMODULES_PHONES.read, reply && reply.ok === true, Date.now() - startedAt);
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcSubmoduleBoardShapeOk(reply)) {
          setBoard({ state: "ok", board: reply, error: null });
          patch({ mode: "board" });
          return reply;
        }
        const failure = vcSubmoduleFailureOf(reply);
        setBoard({ state: "error", board: null, error: failure });
        patch({ mode: "failed", error: failure });
        return null;
      }
      async function start(actionId, preset) {
        const id = String(actionId === void 0 || actionId === null ? "" : actionId);
        const base = vcSubmodulesUiOf(uiOf());
        const input = Object.assign({}, base.field, preset || {});
        const action = vcSubmoduleActionOfId(id);
        if (!action) {
          patch({ mode: "failed", error: { kind: "invalid", reason: "unknown-action", message: "页面里没有这个动作" } });
          return null;
        }
        if (action.kind === "read") return refresh();
        const batch = action.place === "batch";
        patch({ mode: "reading", op: id, batch, error: null, plan: null, ticket: null, decision: null, reasons: [] });
        const startedAt = Date.now();
        let reply = null;
        try {
          reply = await callHost(VC_SUBMODULES_PHONES.check, vcSubmoduleCheckArgsOf(cwd, id, input, batch));
        } catch (e3) {
          reply = { ok: false, error: { kind: "env", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) } };
        }
        logCall(VC_SUBMODULES_PHONES.check, reply && reply.ok === true, Date.now() - startedAt);
        if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) {
          const failure = vcSubmoduleFailureOf(reply);
          const blocked = failure.kind === "blocked";
          patch({ mode: blocked ? "blocked" : "failed", error: failure, reasons: blocked ? [failure.reason] : [] });
          return null;
        }
        const ticket = vcSubmoduleTicketOf(reply);
        if (!ticket) {
          patch({ mode: "failed", error: { kind: "shape", message: "预检回包里没有票号" } });
          return null;
        }
        const plan = reply.plan && typeof reply.plan === "object" ? reply.plan : { action: id };
        patch({ mode: "confirm", op: id, batch, ticket, plan, decision: reply.decision || null, reasons: Array.isArray(reply.reasons) ? reply.reasons : [], error: null });
        return reply;
      }
      function field(name, value) {
        const key = String(name === void 0 || name === null ? "" : name);
        if (key !== "path" && key !== "url" && key !== "branch") return null;
        const base = vcSubmodulesUiOf(uiOf());
        const nextField = Object.assign({}, base.field);
        nextField[key] = String(value === void 0 || value === null ? "" : value);
        return patch({ field: nextField });
      }
      async function confirmNow() {
        const base = vcSubmodulesUiOf(uiOf());
        if (base.mode !== "confirm" || !base.ticket) {
          patch({ mode: "failed", error: { kind: "invalid", reason: "confirm-required", message: "还没有预检过，或确认卡已经关了" } });
          return null;
        }
        const plan = base.plan || {};
        const op = String(plan.action || base.op || "");
        const task = plan.kind === "task";
        const requestId = vcSubmoduleRequestIdOf(Date.now(), base.ticket.id);
        patch({ mode: "running", requestId });
        const startedAt = Date.now();
        let reply = null;
        try {
          reply = task ? await callHost(VC_SUBMODULES_PHONES.task, vcSubmoduleTaskArgsOf(cwd, op, base.ticket.id, requestId)) : await callHost(VC_SUBMODULES_PHONES.write, vcSubmoduleRunArgsOf(cwd, op, base.ticket.id, requestId, plan));
        } catch (e3) {
          reply = { ok: false, error: { kind: "env", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) } };
        }
        logCall(task ? VC_SUBMODULES_PHONES.task : VC_SUBMODULES_PHONES.write, reply && reply.ok === true, Date.now() - startedAt);
        if (!reply || reply.ok !== true) {
          const failure = vcSubmoduleFailureOf(reply);
          patch({ mode: "failed", error: failure, ticket: null });
          return null;
        }
        const result = vcSubmoduleResultOf(reply);
        patch({ mode: "done", result, error: null, ticket: null, reasons: [] });
        void refresh();
        return reply;
      }
      function cancelConfirm() {
        return patch({ mode: "board", ticket: null, plan: null, decision: null, reasons: [], error: null });
      }
      function retry() {
        const base = vcSubmodulesUiOf(uiOf());
        if (base.mode === "blocked") return patch({ mode: "board", error: null, reasons: [] });
        if (base.op) return start(base.op, null);
        return refresh();
      }
      return { refresh, start, field, confirmNow, cancelConfirm, retry, uiOf, boardOf };
    }

        if (v3 !== null && v3 !== void 0) return String(v3);
      }
      if (node && node.props && node.props[name] !== void 0) return String(node.props[name]);
      return "";
    }

    }

    const VC_PLATFORM_PHONES = {
      read: "wf.gitPlatformRead",
      requestPull: "wf.gitRequestPull",
      patchFiles: "wf.gitPatchFiles"
    };
    const VC_PLATFORM_DATA_SOURCE = "src/client/views/versionControl/vcPlatformData.ts";
    const vcNewPlatformReads = function() {
      return {
        platform: { state: "idle", data: null, error: null },
        requestPull: { state: "idle", data: null, error: null },
        patches: { state: "idle", dir: "", data: null, error: null }
      };
    };
    const vcPfOkLog = function(method, kind, t0) {
      try {
        log("info", "host.call", { method, latencyMs: Date.now() - t0, ok: true, kind });
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    const vcPfFailLog = function(method, kind, t0, fail) {
      try {
        log("warn", "host.call.fail", { method, kind, errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(fail && fail.kind || "") + " " + String(fail && fail.message || ""), 120, "error")) });
      } catch (e3) {
      }
    };
    const vcPfFailureOf = function(reply) {
      if (reply && reply.ok === false) {
        const e3 = reply.error || {};
        return { kind: String(e3.kind || "unknown"), reason: String(e3.reason || e3.kind || "unknown"), message: String(e3.message || ""), hint: String(e3.hint || "") };
      }
      return { kind: "shape", reason: "shape", message: "", hint: "" };
    };
    const vcPfReadShapeOk = function(data) {
      if (!data || typeof data.readAtMs !== "number" || !isFinite(data.readAtMs)) return false;
      return !!data.credential && !!data.updateRefs;
    };
    const vcPfMerge = function(reads, key, next) {
      const base = reads || vcNewPlatformReads();
      const patch = {};
      patch[key] = next;
      return Object.assign({}, base, patch);
    };
    const vcPlatformStateOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.platform;
      return r3 && typeof r3.state === "string" ? r3.state : "idle";
    };
    const vcPlatformDataOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.platform;
      return r3 && r3.state === "ok" && vcPfReadShapeOk(r3.data) ? r3.data : null;
    };
    const vcPlatformErrorOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.platform;
      return r3 && r3.state === "err" ? r3.error : null;
    };
    const vcPlatformCredentialOf = function(reads) {
      const data = vcPlatformDataOf(reads);
      const c3 = data && data.credential;
      if (!c3 || c3.state !== "ok") return { state: c3 && c3.state === "error" ? "error" : "idle", helpers: [], store: "", risk: "ok", advice: "ok", error: c3 && c3.error || null };
      return {
        state: "ok",
        helpers: Array.isArray(c3.helpers) ? c3.helpers.map(function(h4) {
          return String(h4);
        }) : [],
        store: String(c3.store || ""),
        risk: String(c3.risk || "ok"),
        advice: String(c3.advice || "ok"),
        error: null
      };
    };
    const vcPlatformUpdateRefsOf = function(reads) {
      const data = vcPlatformDataOf(reads);
      const u3 = data && data.updateRefs;
      if (!u3 || u3.state !== "ok") return { state: u3 && u3.state === "error" ? "error" : "idle", value: "", enabled: false, error: u3 && u3.error || null };
      return { state: "ok", value: String(u3.value || ""), enabled: u3.enabled === true, error: null };
    };
    const vcPlatformRequestPullStateOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.requestPull;
      return r3 && typeof r3.state === "string" ? r3.state : "idle";
    };
    const vcPlatformRequestPullOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.requestPull;
      if (!r3 || r3.state !== "ok" || !r3.data || typeof r3.data.text !== "string") return null;
      return r3.data;
    };
    const vcPlatformRequestPullErrorOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.requestPull;
      return r3 && r3.state === "err" ? r3.error : null;
    };
    const vcPlatformPatchesStateOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.patches;
      return r3 && typeof r3.state === "string" ? r3.state : "idle";
    };
    const vcPlatformPatchesOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.patches;
      if (!r3 || r3.state !== "ok" || !r3.data || !Array.isArray(r3.data.patches)) return null;
      return r3.data;
    };
    const vcPlatformPatchesErrorOf = function(reads) {
      const r3 = reads && reads.patches;
      return r3 && r3.state === "err" ? r3.error : null;
    };
    const vcApplyPlatformReply = function(reads, reply) {
      const prev = reads && reads.platform || {};
      if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcPfReadShapeOk(reply)) {
        return vcPfMerge(reads, "platform", { state: "ok", data: { readAtMs: reply.readAtMs, repoRoot: String(reply.repoRoot || ""), credential: reply.credential, updateRefs: reply.updateRefs }, error: null });
      }
      return vcPfMerge(reads, "platform", { state: "err", data: prev.data || null, error: vcPfFailureOf(reply) });
    };
    const vcApplyRequestPullReply = function(reads, reply) {
      const prev = reads && reads.requestPull || {};
      if (reply && reply.ok === true && typeof reply.text === "string") {
        return vcPfMerge(reads, "requestPull", { state: "ok", data: { text: reply.text, truncated: reply.truncated === true, cmd: String(reply.cmd || "request-pull"), ms: typeof reply.ms === "number" ? reply.ms : null, range: String(reply.range || "") }, error: null });
      }
      return vcPfMerge(reads, "requestPull", { state: "err", data: prev.data || null, error: vcPfFailureOf(reply) });
    };
    const vcApplyPatchesReply = function(reads, reply, dir) {
      const prev = reads && reads.patches || {};
      if (reply && reply.ok === true && Array.isArray(reply.patches)) {
        return vcPfMerge(reads, "patches", { state: "ok", dir: String(reply.dir || dir || ""), data: reply, error: null });
      }
      return vcPfMerge(reads, "patches", { state: "err", dir: String(dir || prev.dir || ""), data: prev.data || null, error: vcPfFailureOf(reply) });
    };
    const vcReadPlatform = function(reads, call, cwd) {
      const base = reads || vcNewPlatformReads();
      const prev = base.platform || { state: "idle", data: null, error: null };
      const loading = vcPfMerge(base, "platform", { state: "loading", data: prev.data || null, error: null });
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_PLATFORM_PHONES.read, { cwd: String(cwd || "") });
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && vcPfReadShapeOk(reply)) vcPfOkLog(VC_PLATFORM_PHONES.read, "git-platform-read", t0);
        else vcPfFailLog(VC_PLATFORM_PHONES.read, "git-platform-read", t0, vcPfFailureOf(reply));
        return vcApplyPlatformReply(loading, reply);
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        const fail = { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) };
        vcPfFailLog(VC_PLATFORM_PHONES.read, "git-platform-read", t0, fail);
        return vcPfMerge(loading, "platform", { state: "err", data: prev.data || null, error: fail });
      });
    };
    const vcRunRequestPull = function(reads, call, cwd, form) {
      const base = reads || vcNewPlatformReads();
      const loading = vcPfMerge(base, "requestPull", { state: "loading", data: null, error: null });
      const f3 = form || {};
      const args = { cwd: String(cwd || ""), start: String(f3.start || ""), url: String(f3.url || ""), end: String(f3.end || "") };
      const t0 = Date.now();
      return Promise.resolve().then(function() {
        return call(VC_PLATFORM_PHONES.requestPull, args);
      }).then(function(reply) {
        if (reply && reply.ok === true && typeof reply.text === "string") vcPfOkLog(VC_PLATFORM_PHONES.requestPull, "git-request-pull", t0);
        else vcPfFailLog(VC_PLATFORM_PHONES.requestPull, "git-request-pull", t0, vcPfFailureOf(reply));
        return vcApplyRequestPullReply(loading, reply);
      }).catch(function(e3) {
        const fail = { kind: "throw", message: String(e3 && e3.message || e3) };
        vcPfFailLog(VC_PLATFORM_PHONES.requestPull, "git-request-pull", t0, fail);
        return vcPfMerge(loading, "requestPull", { state: "err", data: null, error: fail });
      });
    };
    const vcReadPatchFiles = function(reads, call, cwd, dir) {
      const base = reads || vcNewPlatformReads();

    const vcRewriteLinesOf = function(text2) {
      const raw = String(text2 === void 0 || text2 === null ? "" : text2).split(/\r?\n/);
      const out = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < raw.length; i3 += 1) {
        const line = raw[i3].trim();
        if (line !== "") out.push(line);
      }
      return out;
    };
    const vcRewriteRenamesOf = function(text2) {
      const lines = vcRewriteLinesOf(text2);
      const out = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < lines.length; i3 += 1) {
        const cut = lines[i3].indexOf("=>");
        if (cut < 0) return null;
        const from = lines[i3].slice(0, cut).trim();
        const to = lines[i3].slice(cut + 2).trim();
        if (from === "" || to === "") return null;
        out.push({ from, to });
      }
      return out;
    };
    const vcRewriteReplacementsOf = function(text2) {
      const lines = vcRewriteLinesOf(text2);
      const out = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < lines.length; i3 += 1) {
        const cut = lines[i3].indexOf("=>");
        if (cut < 0) return null;
        const from = lines[i3].slice(0, cut).trim();
        const to = lines[i3].slice(cut + 2).trim();
        if (from === "") return null;
        out.push({ from, to });
      }
      return out;
    };
    const vcRewriteAuthorsOf = function(text2) {
      const lines = vcRewriteLinesOf(text2);
      const out = [];
      const pattern = /^(.*?)\s*<([^<>]*)>\s*(?:\|\s*(.*?)\s*<([^<>]*)>\s*)?$/;
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < lines.length; i3 += 1) {
        const m3 = pattern.exec(lines[i3]);
        if (!m3) return null;
        const name = String(m3[1] || "").trim();
        const email = String(m3[2] || "").trim();
        if (name === "" || email === "") return null;
        const item = { name, email };
        if (m3[3] !== void 0 && m3[4] !== void 0) {
          const oldName = String(m3[3] || "").trim();
          const oldEmail = String(m3[4] || "").trim();
          if (oldName === "" || oldEmail === "") return null;
          item.oldName = oldName;
          item.oldEmail = oldEmail;
        }
        out.push(item);
      }
      return out;
    };
    const vcRewritePlanOf = function(values) {
      const v3 = values || {};
      const form = String(v3.form || VC_REWRITE_FORM_DEFAULT.form);
      const raw = { op: "rewrite", form, paths: [], renames: [], authors: [], threshold: "", replacements: [] };
      if (form === "remove-paths") raw.paths = vcRewriteLinesOf(v3.pathsText);
      else if (form === "rename-paths") {
        const renames = vcRewriteRenamesOf(v3.renamesText);
        if (renames === null) return null;
        raw.renames = renames;
      } else if (form === "rewrite-authors") {
        const authors = vcRewriteAuthorsOf(v3.authorsText);
        if (authors === null) return null;
        raw.authors = authors;
      } else if (form === "remove-large") raw.threshold = String(v3.threshold || "").trim();
      else if (form === "replace-text") {
        const items = vcRewriteReplacementsOf(v3.replacementsText);
        if (items === null) return null;
        raw.replacements = items;
      }
      return rewritePlanOf(raw);
    };

    const vcRewriteReplyKindOf = function(reply) {

      if (r3.ok === true && r3.confirm && r3.ticket) return "checked";
      if (r3.ok === true && r3.preview) return "previewed";

      if (reason === "need-confirm") return "need-confirm";
      if (r3.ok === false && (r3.error && r3.error.kind === "blocked" || r3.decision)) return "blocked";
      return "fail";

    const vcMaintenanceDiagNode = function(props) {
      const t3 = props.t;
      const cwd = String(props.cwd || "");
      const call = props.call;
      const h4 = React.createElement;
      const stateHook = React.useState({});
      const ops = stateHook[0];
      const setOps = stateHook[1];
      const taskHook = React.useState({ list: [], ids: {} });
      const taskState = taskHook[0];
      const setTaskState = taskHook[1];
      const readHook = React.useState({ unreachable: null, objects: null, at: "" });
      const readState = readHook[0];
      const setReadState = readHook[1];
      const alive = React.useRef(true);
      const timerRef = React.useRef(null);
      React.useEffect(function() {
        alive.current = true;
        return function() {
          alive.current = false;
          if (timerRef.current) {
            clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
            timerRef.current = null;
          }
        };
      }, []);
      const patchOp = function(op, patch) {
        setOps(function(prev) {
          const next = Object.assign({}, prev);
          next[op] = Object.assign({}, prev[op] || {}, patch, { id: op });
          return next;
        });
      };
      const readOnce = function(op) {
        if (typeof call !== "function") return Promise.resolve(null);
        return call(VC_MAINTENANCE_PHONES.read, vcMaintenanceReadArgsOf(cwd, op)).then(function(reply) {
          if (!alive.current) return null;
          setReadState(function(prev) {
            const next = Object.assign({}, prev);
            if (op === "unreachable") next.unreachable = reply;
            else next.objects = vcMaintenanceObjectsOf(reply);
            next.at = String(reply && reply.readAtMs ? new Date(reply.readAtMs).toISOString() : prev.at);
            return next;
          });
          return reply;
        }).catch(function() {
          return null;
        });
      };
      const poll = function() {
        if (typeof call !== "function") return;
        call(VC_MAINTENANCE_PHONES.taskQuery, {}).then(function(reply) {
          if (!alive.current) return;
          const list = reply && Array.isArray(reply.tasks) ? reply.tasks : [];
          setTaskState(function(prev) {
            return Object.assign({}, prev, { list });
          });
          const running = list.some(function(task) {
            return String(task && task.state || "") === "running";
          });
          if (running && timerRef.current === null) {
            timerRef.current = setTimeout(function() {
              timerRef.current = null;
              poll();
            }, VC_TASK_POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
          }
        }).catch(function() {
        });
      };
      React.useEffect(function() {
        readOnce("unreachable");
        readOnce("objects");
        poll();
      }, []);
      const start = function(op) {
        if (typeof call !== "function") return;
        patchOp(op, { busy: true, error: "" });
        const requestId = vcMaintenanceRequestIdOf(Date.now(), op);
        call(VC_MAINTENANCE_PHONES.taskStart, vcMaintenanceTaskArgsOf(cwd, op, requestId)).then(function(reply) {
          if (!alive.current) return;
          if (reply && reply.ok === true) {
            const task = reply.task || null;
            setTaskState(function(prev) {
              const ids = Object.assign({}, prev.ids);
              if (task && task.taskId) ids[op] = String(task.taskId);
              return Object.assign({}, prev, { ids });
            });
            patchOp(op, { busy: false });
            poll();
            return;
          }
          patchOp(op, { busy: false, error: vcMaintenanceFailTextOf(t3, reply, vcWriteErrFamilyOf) });
        }).catch(function() {
          if (alive.current) patchOp(op, { busy: false, error: t3("vc.maintenance.fail.network") });
        });
      };
      const cancel = function(taskId) {
        if (typeof call !== "function" || !taskId) return;
        call(VC_MAINTENANCE_PHONES.taskCancel, { taskId: String(taskId) }).then(function() {
          poll();
        }).catch(function() {
        });
      };
      const taskOf = function(op) {
        const id = String((taskState.ids || {})[op] || "");
        if (!id) return null;
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < taskState.list.length; i3 += 1) {
          const task = taskState.list[i3];
          if (task && String(task.taskId || "") === id) return task;
        }
        return { taskId: id, state: "running" };
      };
      const unreachable = readState.unreachable;
      const unreachableRead = unreachable && unreachable.ok === true ? unreachable : null;
      const objects = readState.objects;
      const exitKids = VC_MAINTENANCE_DIAG_EXITS.map(function(id) {
        return h4("p", { key: id, className: "vcs-muted", "data-vc-maint-exit": id }, t3("vc.maintenance.diag.exit." + id));
      });
      const itemRows = vcMaintDiagItemRowsOf(unreachableRead && unreachableRead.items);
      const kids = [
        h4("h3", { key: "title", "data-vc-maint-diag-title": "1" }, t3("vc.maintenance.diag.pageTitle")),
        h4("p", { key: "hint", className: "vcs-muted" }, t3("vc.maintenance.diag.pageHint")),
        h4(
          "section",
          { key: "tasks", "data-vc-maint-diag-tasks": "1" },
          VC_MAINTENANCE_DIAG_TASKS.map(function(op) {
            return vcMaintDiagTaskCardOf(h4, t3, op, ops[op] || {}, taskOf(op), { start, cancel });
          })
        ),
        h4(
          "section",
          { key: "unreachable", className: "vcs-card", "data-vc-maint-unreachable": "1" },
          h4("h4", null, t3(vcMaintenanceOpLabelKeyOf("unreachable"))),
          h4(
            "p",
            { key: "count", "data-vc-maint-unreachable-count": String(unreachableRead && typeof unreachableRead.count === "number" ? unreachableRead.count : "") },
            unreachableRead ? t3("vc.maintenance.diag.unreachableLine", {
              count: String(unreachableRead.count || 0),

            return h4("p", { key: row.key, "data-vc-maint-unreachable-item": row.oid }, row.type + " " + row.oid);
          }),
          exitKids,
          vcMaintDiagButtonOf(h4, t3, "vc.maintenance.diag.readAgain", "vc.maint.diag.read.unreachable", false, function() {
            readOnce("unreachable");
          }, null)
        ),
        h4(

          ) : h4("p", { key: "none", "data-vc-maint-diag-object-empty": "1" }, t3("vc.maintenance.read.empty")),
          vcMaintDiagButtonOf(h4, t3, "vc.maintenance.diag.readAgain", "vc.maint.diag.read.objects", false, function() {
            readOnce("objects");
          }, null)
        )
      ];
      return h4("section", { id: "vc-maintenance-diag", className: "vcs-page", "data-vc-maint-diag-page": "1", "data-vc-maint-diag-count": String(VC_MAINTENANCE_DIAG_TASKS.length) }, kids);

    const vcShellPageNode = function(h4, t3, o3) {
      const opts = o3 || {};
      const page = String(opts.page || "changes");
      const prefix = vcPagePrefixOf(opts.pagePrefix || "");
      const width = vcWidthOf(opts.width);
      const skin = vcSkinOf(opts.skin);
      const seed = opts.seed || {};
      const open = opts.open || {};
      const isManage = VC_MANAGE_PAGES.indexOf(page) >= 0;
      const isSearch = page === VC_SEARCH_PAGE;
      const branchOpen = !!open.branch;
      const paletteOpen = !!open.palette || isSearch;
      const gearOpen = !!open.gear || isManage;
      const branchOverlayId = prefix + "-branch-overlay";
      const paletteId = prefix + "-palette";
      const gearId = prefix + "-gear-index";

      const openSurface = isSearch ? String(open.surface || (CAPABILITIES.filter(function(c3) {
        return c3 && c3.page === "search";

        return Object.assign({}, node, { key });

      children.push(keyed(vcIdentityRowNode(h4, t3, {
        branch: seed.branch || "",
        remote: seed.remote || "origin",
        when: readAt,
        branchOpen,
        branchOverlayId,
        paletteOpen,
        paletteId,
        gearOpen,
        gearId
      }), "identity"));

        pagePrefix: opts.pagePrefix || "",
        openSurface,

        paletteLimit: seed.paletteLimit,
        confirm: seed.confirm,
        result: seed.result,
        changes: opts.changes,
        conflicts: opts.conflicts,
