        // #1747 T12 / #1749 T14：冲突向导与变基待办的交互态原样往下传，壳不改形状。
        // #1744 T09：提交历史页要真读数与交互态，页面壳原样往下传，不在壳里改形状。
        reads: opts.reads,
        ui: opts.ui,
        width,
        nowMs: seed.nowMs,
        // #1746 T11：分支与标签业务面板的读数与确认卡/结果（没给就不画，T03 既有渲染不变）。
        branchBoard: opts.branchBoard,
        branchConfirm: opts.branchConfirm,
        branchResult: opts.branchResult,
        onBranchRetry: opts.onBranchRetry,
        // #1745：历史高级查询面板的输入与四态由调用方带着走（不传就是空的「还没跑」）。
        queries: opts.queries,
        inputs: opts.inputs,
        // #1743：#1743 提交页的动作层、目标提交候选与现成面板模型也从调用方传进来（壳不自己造）。
        commitOps: opts.commitOps || null,
        commitTargets: opts.commitTargets || [],
        commitPanel: opts.commitPanel || null,
        // 页面要的真数据与回调原样往下传（不传就是骨架，既有页面渲染不变）：#1752 工作树、#1756 克隆向导、#1757 子模块页、#1760 配置与钩子页；#1761 诊断页的读数与五个回调也原样往下传
        diagnostics: opts.diagnostics || null,
        onDiagnosticsRead: opts.onDiagnosticsRead,
        onDiagnosticsWrite: opts.onDiagnosticsWrite,
        onDiagnosticsEdit: opts.onDiagnosticsEdit,
        onDiagnosticsConfirm: opts.onDiagnosticsConfirm,
        onDiagnosticsCancel: opts.onDiagnosticsCancel,
        config: opts.config,
        onConfig: opts.onConfig,
        onConfigEdit: opts.onConfigEdit,
        hooks: opts.hooks,
        onHooks: opts.onHooks,
        onHooksEdit: opts.onHooksEdit,
        ops: opts.ops,
        handlers: opts.handlers,
        submodules: opts.submodules,
        submoduleUi: opts.submoduleUi,
        submoduleOps: opts.submoduleOps,
        cwd: opts.cwd,
        call: opts.call,
        platform: opts.platform,
        platformUi: opts.platformUi,
        onPlatformRpInput: opts.onPlatformRpInput,
        onPlatformRequestPull: opts.onPlatformRequestPull,
        migrate: opts.migrate,
        migrateReads: opts.migrateReads,
        onMigrateEdit: opts.onMigrateEdit,
        onMigrateCheck: opts.onMigrateCheck,
        onMigrateRun: opts.onMigrateRun,
        onMigrateRescan: opts.onMigrateRescan,
        onMigrateCancel: opts.onMigrateCancel
        // #1761 诊断页读数与五个回调；#1760 配置页与钩子页要四组读数、身份两键编辑与钩子清单（回调原样往下传）；#1752 工作树页要真数据与处理函数；#1756 克隆向导要工作区与发电话的函数；#1757 T21 子模块页要读数、交互态与处理函数；#1762 T26 平台页的读数、交互态与回调，以及迁移页 14.1 导出向导的读数与回调，都从这里透传，页面壳不自己造数据
      }), "body"));
      if (page === "stash" && typeof vcStashPageNode === "function") {
        children.push(keyed(vcStashPageNode(h4, t3, { seed, state: opts.stash, onStash: opts.onStash, onStashEdit: opts.onStashEdit }), "stashPage"));
      }
      if (page === "rebase" && typeof vcUndoPageNode === "function") children.push(keyed(vcUndoPageNode(h4, t3, { seed, state: opts.undo, onUndoCheck: opts.onUndoCheck, onUndoWrite: opts.onUndoWrite, onUndoInput: opts.onUndoInput }), "undoPage"));
      if (opts.tasks !== void 0 && typeof vcTaskPanelNode === "function") {
        children.push(keyed(vcTaskPanelNode(h4, t3, { tasks: opts.tasks, running: opts.running, onCancel: opts.onCancel }), "tasks"));
      }
      return h4("div", {
        id: prefix + "-root",
        className: "vcs-root",
        "data-vc-root": "1",
        "data-vc-shell": "1",
        "data-vc-page": page,
        "data-vc-width": String(width),
        "data-vc-skin": skin,
        "data-vc-depth": String(vcPageDepthOf(page))
      }, children);
    };
    const vcRenderTabAt = function(h4, t3, o3) {
      return vcShellPageNode(h4, t3, o3 || {});
    };
    const vcRenderAllPages = function(h4, t3, o3) {
      const opts = o3 || {};
      const pages = PAGE_SURFACES.map(function(p3) {
        return p3.id;
      });
      const rendered = pages.map(function(page) {
        return vcShellPageNode(h4, t3, {
          page,
          pagePrefix: page,
          width: opts.width,
          skin: opts.skin,
          seed: opts.seed,
          open: opts.open
        });
      });
      return h4("div", { className: "vcs-all-pages", "data-vc-pages": "1", "data-vc-page-count": String(rendered.length) }, rendered);
    };
    const VC_TONE = {
      // #853：这六个色档改指本页的皮肤令牌，不再吃宿主那一套 —— 换肤就换这一处。
      //   注明 Record<string, string> 只为过类型检查（tone() 拿变量取值），转译后与原来一字不差。
      success: "var(--vc-accent,#22c55e)",
      warning: "var(--vc-warn,#f59e0b)",
      error: "var(--vc-danger,#ef4444)",
      accent: "var(--vc-info,#38bdf8)",
      caption: "var(--vc-mut,#94a3b8)",
      primary: "var(--vc-ink,#e6edf3)"
    };
    const VersionControlTab = function(props) {
      const cx2 = React.useContext(DswsCtx);
      const h4 = cx2 ? cx2.h : React.createElement;
      const st = props && props.st;
      const cwd = st && st.cwd ? String(st.cwd) : "";
      const [reads, setReads] = React.useState(function() {
        return vcCacheSeedOf(cwd) || vcNewReads();
      });
      const [ui, setUi] = React.useState(function() {
        return { fileShown: {}, openDiff: "", openCommit: "", view: vcRememberedView(), write: { op: "", state: "idle", message: "", confirm: null, result: null, remoteChoice: null } };
      });
      const [width, setWidth] = React.useState(0);
      const [tier, setTier] = React.useState(0);
      const lastWidthRef = React.useRef(0);
      const rootRef = React.useRef(null);
      const moreStateRef = React.useRef({});
      const logBusyRef = React.useRef(false);
      const [stateCwd, setStateCwd] = React.useState(cwd);
      const stateCwdRef = React.useRef(cwd);
      stateCwdRef.current = stateCwd;
      const fresh = vcFreshOnCwd(stateCwd, cwd, reads, ui);
      const staleCwd = fresh.changed;
      if (staleCwd) {
        setStateCwd(cwd);
        setReads(vcCacheSeedOf(cwd) || fresh.reads);
        setUi(Object.assign({}, fresh.ui, { view: "changes", write: { op: "", state: "idle", message: "", confirm: null, result: null, remoteChoice: null } }));
        vcResetViewMemory();
        setTier(0);
        lastWidthRef.current = 0;
        logBusyRef.current = false;
      }
      const readsRef = React.useRef(reads);
      readsRef.current = reads;
      const callHost = function(method, args) {
        if (typeof host === "undefined" || !host || typeof host.call !== "function") return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, error: { kind: "shape", message: "" } });
        return host.call(method, args);
      };
      const screenOf = function(r3) {
        return r3 && r3.screen && r3.screen.data ? r3.screen.data.screen : null;
      };
      const cwdEmpty = !vcShouldRead(cwd);
      React.useEffect(function() {
        if (!cwd) return;
        let alive = true;
        vcReadStatus(staleCwd ? vcNewReads() : readsRef.current, callHost, cwd).then(function(next) {
          if (alive) {
            setReads(next);
            vcCacheSave(cwd, next);
          }
        });
        return function() {
          alive = false;
        };
      }, [cwd]);
      React.useEffect(function() {
        const el = rootRef.current;
        if (!el || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
        const ro = new ResizeObserver(function(entries) {
          try {
            const w4 = Math.round(entries[0].contentRect.width);
            if (lastWidthRef.current === w4) return;
            lastWidthRef.current = w4;
            setTier(0);
            setWidth(w4);
          } catch (e3) {
          }
        });
        ro.observe(el);
        return function() {
          try {
            ro.disconnect();
          } catch (e3) {
          }
        };
      }, []);
      const screen = screenOf(reads);
      const ops = vcWriteOpsOf({ ui, setUi, callHost, cwd, readsRef, setReads, screen });
      const decisions = ops.decisions;
      const foldData = vcFoldDataOf(screen, reads, {
        push: tr("vc.action.push"),
        pull: tr("vc.action.pull"),
        stageAll: tr("vc.action.stageAll"),
        commit: tr("vc.action.commit", { n: String(screen ? Number(screen.stagedCount) || 0 : 0) })
      });
      const fold = vcFoldOf(width, foldData);
      const foldState = vcFoldStateAt(fold.ladder, tier);
      const contentKey = (screen ? String(screen.commits ? screen.commits.length : 0) : "-") + "|" + String(reads.log.commits ? reads.log.commits.length : 0) + "|" + String(ui.openDiff || "") + "|" + String(ui.openCommit || "") + "|" + String(screen ? screen.stagedCount + screen.unstagedCount : -1);
      React.useLayoutEffect(function() {
        const el = rootRef.current;
        if (!el || tier >= fold.ladder.steps.length) return;
        try {
          if (width > 0 && width < VC_FOLD_BANDS[2]) {
            setTier(fold.ladder.steps.length);
            return;
          }
          if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth + 1) setTier(tier + 1);
        } catch (e3) {
        }
      }, [tier, width, contentKey]);
      const loadMore = function() {
        if (logBusyRef.current) return false;
        logBusyRef.current = true;
        setReads(vcMarkLogLoading(readsRef.current));
        const skip = vcNextSkipOf(screenOf(readsRef.current), readsRef.current.log);
        vcReadMoreCommits(readsRef.current, callHost, cwd, skip).then(function(next) {
          logBusyRef.current = false;
          setReads(next);
          vcCacheSave(cwd, next);
        });
        return true;
      };
      const drawMore = function(key) {
        if (key === "commits") return loadMore();
        vcMoreShownOf(setUi, key);
        return true;
      };
      const moreSight = vcUseMoreSightOf({
        stateOf: function(key) {
          return moreStateRef.current[key];
        },
        draw: drawMore
      });
      const blocks = vcBlocksOf(screen, reads, ui, { t: tr, nowMs: Date.now(), cwdEmpty, decisions, fold: Object.assign({}, fold, { state: foldState }) });
      if (staleCwd) blocks.length = 0;
      moreStateRef.current = vcMoreStateOf(blocks, reads);
      const tone = function(name) {
        return VC_TONE[name] || VC_TONE.primary;
      };
      const retryScreen = function() {
        vcReadStatus(readsRef.current, callHost, cwd).then(function(next) {
          setReads(next);
          vcCacheSave(cwd, next);
        });
      };
      const pickView = function(v3) {
        vcRememberView(v3);
        setUi(function(cur) {
          return vcPickViewStateOf(cur, v3);
        });
      };
      const openHandoff = function(ai) {
        const handoff = vcAiHandoffOf({ ai, t: tr, screen });
        if (handoff) vcOpenAiHandoff({ opener: typeof openTextInNewSession === "function" ? openTextInNewSession : null, st, handoff });
      };
      const diffOps = vcDiffOpsOf({ ui, setUi, setReads, readsRef, callHost, cwd, stateCwdRef, vcDiffOpenKeyOf, vcReadDiff, vcReadCommitFiles, vcReadCommitFileDiff, vcApplyDiffReply, vcApplyCommitReply, vcReadsOf, vcMarkDiffLoading, vcMarkCommitLoading, vcMarkCommitFileDiffLoading, vcApplyCommitFileDiffReply, onView: pickView });
      const diffKeyOf = diffOps.diffKeyOf;
      const entryOf = diffOps.entryOf;
      const toggleDiff = diffOps.toggleDiff;
      const retryDiff = diffOps.retryDiff;
      const openCommit = diffOps.openCommit;
      const closeCommit = diffOps.closeCommit;
      const retryCommit = diffOps.retryCommit;
      const reloadNow = function() {
        retryScreen();
      };
      const tipNode = function(content, child) {
        return content ? h4(Tip, { key: child && child.key !== void 0 ? child.key : void 0, content }, child) : child;
      };
      const button = function(label, onClick, logId) {
        return h4("button", { className: "dsws-btn dsws-hov", type: "button", "data-press": "button", "data-log": logId, onClick, style: { flex: "none" } }, label);
      };
      const diffLine = function(l3, i3) {
        const kind = l3 && l3.kind ? String(l3.kind) : "context";
        const raw = l3 && l3.text !== void 0 ? String(l3.text) : "";
        let body = raw;
        let col = tone("primary");
        if (kind === "add") {
          body = raw.slice(1);
          col = tone("success");
        } else if (kind === "del") {
          body = raw.slice(1);
          col = tone("error");
        } else if (kind === "context") {
          body = raw.slice(1);
          col = tone("caption");
        } else if (kind === "hunk") {
          col = tone("accent");
        } else if (kind === "filehead") {
          col = tone("caption");
        }
        return h4("div", { key: i3, "data-vc-line": kind, style: { color: col, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", wordBreak: "break-all" } }, body);
      };
      const diffNode = function(row, rowId) {
        const d3 = row.diff;
        if (!d3) return null;
        if (d3.state === "loading") return h4("div", { key: "diff", "data-vc-diff": "loading", style: { marginTop: 4 } }, [
          h4("div", { key: "l1", className: "dsws-vc-skel", "data-vc-skel": 1, style: { width: "80%", height: 12 } }),
          h4("div", { key: "l2", className: "dsws-vc-skel", "data-vc-skel": 1, style: { width: "62%", height: 12 } }),
          h4("div", { key: "l3", className: "dsws-vc-skel", "data-vc-skel": 1, style: { width: "70%", height: 12 } })

        if (d3.state !== "ok") return h4("div", { key: "diff", className: "dsws-vc-caption", "data-vc-diff": d3.state, style: { marginTop: 4, display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center" } }, [

          //   不写清，用户会把「已暂存」组里点开的差异当成「将要提交的那一部分」。
          d3.scopeText ? h4("div", { key: "scope", "data-vc-scope": 1, style: { color: tone("caption"), marginBottom: 4, fontFamily: "inherit", whiteSpace: "normal" } }, d3.scopeText) : null,
          d3.hunks.length ? h4("div", { key: "hunks", "data-vc-hunks": 1, style: { marginBottom: 4 } }, [h4("div", { key: "title", style: { color: tone("caption") } }, d3.hunksTitle)].concat(d3.hunks.map(function(s3, i3) {
            return h4("div", { key: i3, style: { color: tone("accent") } }, s3);

          d3.lines.map(diffLine),
          d3.shownNote ? h4("div", { key: "note", style: { color: tone("caption"), marginTop: 4 } }, d3.shownNote) : null
        ]);

      const fileRow = function(row, rowId) {

          // 文件行按 854 原型排两行：首行路径（等宽 12px），次行状态词（11px）；加减行数与暂存按钮右对齐。
          // 接线（#1335 界面反馈）：文件行整行点得动（点开差异），所以整行按 row 档接按压与悬停反馈；
          //   定位名带「组序号.行序号」，同一页里几组文件行不会撞名；路径不进定位名（路径会变，也不是标识）。
          h4("div", { key: "main", className: "dsws-vc-row dsws-hov", "data-press": "row", "data-log": "vc.row.open." + rowId, onClick: function() {
            toggleDiff(row);
          }, style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, cursor: "pointer" } }, [
            showBadge ? tipNode(row.changeText, h4("span", { key: "badge", className: "dsws-vc-badge " + String(row.badgeClass || ""), "data-vc-badge": row.badge }, row.badge)) : null,

            ]),
            row.conflict ? h4("span", { key: "conflict", style: { flex: "none", fontSize: 10.5, color: tone("warning"), border: "1px solid " + tone("warning"), borderRadius: 4, padding: "0 4px" } }, row.conflictText) : null,

          ].concat(vcRowStageNodes(h4, { row, rowId, tone, tipNode, stagePaths: ops.stagePaths })).concat(vcRowUnstageNodes(h4, { row, rowId, tone, tipNode, unstagePaths: ops.unstagePaths }))),
          diffNode(row, rowId)
        ]);

      const groupNode = function(g4, gIndex) {
        return h4("div", { key: g4.key, "data-vc-group": g4.key }, [

          tipNode(g4.tip, h4("div", { key: "title", className: "dsws-vc-sec", style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 6 } }, g4.title)),

      const node = function(b3) {
        if (b3.kind === "hint") return h4("div", { key: b3.key, "data-vc-hint": 1, style: { display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center", color: tone(b3.tone), background: "var(--vc-inset,#16181d)", borderRadius: "var(--vc-radius,6px)", padding: "4px 8px" } }, [h4("span", { key: "text", style: { flex: 1 } }, b3.text), b3.retry ? h4("span", { key: "retry", style: { display: "contents" } }, button(b3.retry, retryScreen, "vc.hint.retry")) : null]);

        }));

            h4("button", { key: "reload", className: "dsws-btn dsws-hov" + (screenState === "loading" ? " dsws-fb-busy" : ""), type: "button", "data-vc-reload": 1, "data-press": "button", "data-log": "vc.reload", disabled: screenState === "loading", onClick: reloadNow }, screenState === "loading" ? [h4("span", { key: "t", className: "fb-t", "aria-hidden": "true" }, tr("vc.reload")), h4("span", { key: "s", className: "fb-spin", "aria-hidden": "true" }, h4("span", { className: "dsws-spinner", style: { width: 11, height: 11, borderWidth: 2 } }))] : tr("vc.reload"))

        ] : [];
        if (b3.kind === "changes" && b3.commitMode) return h4("div", { key: b3.key, "data-vc-changes": 1, "data-vc-commit-mode": 1 }, [
          // 接线（#1335 界面反馈）：看单笔提交时的「回去」是行内文字按钮，按下要有反馈；它与改动页那颗「回去」不是同一颗，定位名分开。
          b3.back ? h4("div", { key: "back", className: "dsws-vc-link dsws-hov", "data-vc-back": 1, "data-press": "button", "data-log": "vc.commit.back", onClick: closeCommit, style: { marginBottom: 4 } }, b3.back) : null,

    const truthFreshnessAt = function(st) {
      const snap = st && st.snapshot;
      const at = snap && typeof snap.generatedMs === "number" ? snap.generatedMs : 0;
      return at > 0 ? at : 0;
    };
    const truthFreshnessLine = function(st, nowMs) {
      const at = truthFreshnessAt(st);
      if (!at) return null;
      const now = typeof nowMs === "number" && isFinite(nowMs) ? nowMs : Date.now();
      const d3 = new Date(at);
      const pad = function(n2) {
        return (n2 < 10 ? "0" : "") + n2;
      };
      return { at, key: "truth.updatedAt", params: { time: pad(d3.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d3.getMinutes()) }, tone: freshnessLevel(now - at), kind: "freshness" };
    };
    const TRUTH_MINUTE_MS = 6e4;
    const truthAgoViewOf = function(nowMs, atMs) {
      const at = Number(atMs) || 0;
      if (!at) return null;
      const now = typeof nowMs === "number" && isFinite(nowMs) ? nowMs : Date.now();
      const age = Math.max(0, now - at);
      const hour = 60 * TRUTH_MINUTE_MS;
      const day = 24 * hour;
      if (age >= day) return { key: "truth.updatedDayAgo", params: { n: Math.floor(age / day) } };
      if (age >= hour) return { key: "truth.updatedHourAgo", params: { n: Math.floor(age / hour) } };
      if (age >= TRUTH_MINUTE_MS) return { key: "truth.updatedMinAgo", params: { n: Math.floor(age / TRUTH_MINUTE_MS) } };
      return { key: "truth.updatedJustNow", params: {} };
    };
    const truthFreshnessBox = function(st, nowMs) {
      const line = truthFreshnessLine(st, nowMs);
      if (!line) return null;
      const now = typeof nowMs === "number" && isFinite(nowMs) ? nowMs : Date.now();
      const ago = truthAgoViewOf(now, line.at) || { key: "truth.updatedJustNow", params: {} };
      return {
        at: line.at,
        tone: line.tone,
        agoKey: ago.key,
        agoParams: ago.params,
        time: line.params.time
      };
    };
    const freshnessToneColor = function(tone) {
      return tone === "red" ? "var(--dsw-alias-state-error-primary,#f87171)" : tone === "yellow" ? "var(--dsw-alias-state-warning-primary,#f59e0b)" : "var(--dsw-alias-label-caption,#8b8b95)";
    };
    const BUDGET_TONE_BY_TIER = { green: "fresh", yellow: "yellow", red: "red" };
    const KNOWN_BUDGET_KINDS = ["two-buckets", "requests", "none"];
    function budgetBucketOf(bucket) {
      if (!bucket || typeof bucket !== "object") return null;
      if (typeof bucket.remaining !== "number" || !isFinite(bucket.remaining) || bucket.remaining < 0) return null;
      if (typeof bucket.limit !== "number" || !isFinite(bucket.limit) || bucket.limit < 0) return null;
      return bucket;
    }
    function budgetToneOf(bucket) {
      if (!(bucket.limit > 0)) return "fresh";
      return BUDGET_TONE_BY_TIER[tierFor(1 - bucket.remaining / bucket.limit)] || "fresh";
    }
    function budgetBucketLine(key, bucket) {
      return { key, params: { remaining: bucket.remaining, limit: bucket.limit }, tone: budgetToneOf(bucket), kind: "budget" };
    }
    const budgetNoticeLines = function(refresh) {
      const backend = refresh && refresh.backend;
      if (!backend || typeof backend !== "object") return [];
      if (backend.offNetwork === true) return [{ key: "truth.budgetOffNetwork", params: {}, tone: "fresh", kind: "budget" }];
      const unknown = function() {
        const sync = backend.sync;
        if (sync && sync.lastFailKind === "hard") return [{ key: "truth.budgetSyncFailedHard", params: {}, tone: "yellow", kind: "budget" }];
        if (sync && sync.lastFailKind === "soft") return [{ key: "truth.budgetSyncFailedSoft", params: {}, tone: "fresh", kind: "budget" }];
        return [{ key: "truth.budgetUnknown", params: {}, tone: "fresh", kind: "budget" }];
      };
      const staleAfterFail = function() {
        const sync = backend.sync;
        if (sync && sync.lastFailKind === "hard") return [{ key: "truth.budgetStaleSyncFailedHard", params: {}, tone: "yellow", kind: "budget" }];
        if (sync && sync.lastFailKind === "soft") return [{ key: "truth.budgetStaleSyncFailedSoft", params: {}, tone: "fresh", kind: "budget" }];
        return [];
      };
      if (KNOWN_BUDGET_KINDS.indexOf(String(backend.budgetKind || "")) < 0) {
        return [{ key: "truth.budgetUnknownModel", params: {}, tone: "fresh", kind: "budget" }];
      }
      if (backend.readKnown !== true) return unknown();
      if (backend.budgetKind === "requests") {
        const requests = budgetBucketOf(backend.requests);
        if (!requests) return unknown();
        if (requests.remaining === 0) return [{ key: "truth.failQuota", params: {}, tone: "red", kind: "fail" }];
        return [budgetBucketLine("truth.budgetRequests", requests)].concat(staleAfterFail());
      }
      if (backend.budgetKind !== "two-buckets") return [];
      const graphql = budgetBucketOf(backend.buckets && backend.buckets.graphql);
      const rest = budgetBucketOf(backend.buckets && backend.buckets.rest);
      if (!graphql && !rest) return unknown();
      if (graphql && rest && graphql.remaining === 0 && rest.remaining === 0) return [{ key: "truth.failQuota", params: {}, tone: "red", kind: "fail" }];
      const lines = [];
      if (graphql) lines.push(budgetBucketLine("truth.budgetGraphql", graphql));
      if (rest) lines.push(budgetBucketLine("truth.budgetRest", rest));
      return lines.concat(staleAfterFail());
    };
    const truthNoticeLines = function(st, nowMs) {
      const lines = [];
      const push = function(ln2) {
        for (let i3 = 0; i3 < lines.length; i3++) if (lines[i3].key === ln2.key) return;
        lines.push(ln2);
      };
      const snap = st && st.snapshot || null;
      const refresh = snap && snap.refresh || null;
      const tierPaused = !!(refresh && refresh.tier && lagPromiseFor(refresh.tier).paused);
      const paused = !!(refresh && refresh.paused === true) || tierPaused;
      if (st && st.snapMode === "err" && st.snapError && st.snapPending === true) {
        return [{ key: "truth.pendingLate", params: {}, tone: "yellow", kind: "pending" }];
      }
      if (!snap) return lines;
      if (st && st.snapMode === "err" && st.snapError) {
        const byOthers = (st.snapFail && st.snapFail.kind || "") === "quota-exhausted";
        push({ key: byOthers ? "truth.failQuota" : paused ? "truth.failPaused" : "truth.failRetry", params: {}, tone: "red", kind: "fail" });
      }

    const mdInline = function(text2, keyBase, opts) {
      const o3 = opts || {};

      const out = [];

      });
      const linkParts = [];
      const mdSafeUrl = function(u3) {
        const s3 = String(u3 == null ? "" : u3).trim();

        if (/^(https?:|mailto:)/i.test(s3)) return s3;
        if (/^[#/]/.test(s3) || /^\.\.?\//.test(s3)) return s3;
        if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:/i.test(s3)) return s3;

      };
      rest = rest.replace(MD_LINK_RE, function(m3, label, url) {

        return "L" + (linkParts.length - 1) + "";
      });
      const makeImg = function(part, key) {
        const clickable = !inLink && !!st;
        const props = { key, src: part.src, alt: part.alt || "Image", loading: "lazy", decoding: "async", style: mdImgStyle(part.width, part.height, !clickable) };

    const mdToHtml = function(md, opts) {
      const o3 = opts || {};
      const pass = o3 && o3.st ? { st: o3.st } : o3 && o3.inLink ? { inLink: true } : {};
      const nodes = [];
      const lines = String(md == null ? "" : md).split(/\r?\n/);
      let i3 = 0;
      let k4 = 0;
      const inlineWith = function(t3, kb) {
        return mdInline(t3, kb, pass.st ? { st: pass.st } : void 0);
      };
      const pushList = function(items, ordered) {
        if (!items.length) return;
        if (ordered) {
          nodes.push(h3("ol", { key: "ol" + k4++, style: { margin: "2px 0", paddingLeft: 16 } }, items.map(function(it, ii) {

            return h3("li", { key: "li" + ii }, inlineWith(it.text, "t" + ii));
          })));
          return;
        }
        nodes.push(h3("ul", { key: "ul" + k4++, style: { margin: "2px 0", paddingLeft: 16 } }, items.map(function(it, ii) {

              h3("input", { type: "checkbox", checked: it.task === "x" || it.task === "X", disabled: true, style: { marginRight: 5, verticalAlign: "middle" } }),
              h3("span", null, inlineWith(it.text, "t" + ii))
            ]);
          }
          return h3("li", { key: "li" + ii }, inlineWith(it.text, "t" + ii));
        })));
      };
      const tableHasPipe = function(line) {
        const s3 = String(line == null ? "" : line);
        for (let ci = 0; ci < s3.length; ci++) if (s3.charAt(ci) === "|" && s3.charAt(ci - 1) !== "\\") return true;
        return false;
      };
      const tableCells = function(line) {
        let t3 = String(line == null ? "" : line).trim();
        if (t3.charAt(0) === "|") t3 = t3.slice(1);
        if (t3.charAt(t3.length - 1) === "|" && t3.charAt(t3.length - 2) !== "\\") t3 = t3.slice(0, -1);
        const cells = [];
        let cur = "";
        for (let ci = 0; ci < t3.length; ci++) {
          const ch = t3.charAt(ci);
          if (ch === "\\" && t3.charAt(ci + 1) === "|") {
            cur += "|";
            ci++;
            continue;
          }
          if (ch === "|") {
            cells.push(cur.trim());
            cur = "";
            continue;
          }
          cur += ch;
        }
        cells.push(cur.trim());
        return cells;
      };
      const tableAlign = function(cell) {
        const s3 = String(cell == null ? "" : cell).trim();
        if (/^:-+:$/.test(s3)) return "center";
        if (/^:-+$/.test(s3)) return "left";
        if (/^-+:$/.test(s3)) return "right";
        return null;
      };
      const tableDelimCells = function(line) {
        if (!tableHasPipe(line)) return null;
        const cells = tableCells(line);
        for (let ci = 0; ci < cells.length; ci++) if (!/^:?-+:?$/.test(cells[ci])) return null;
        return cells;
      };
      const pushTable = function(headCells, delimCells, rowLines) {
        const aligns = delimCells.map(tableAlign);
        const cols = headCells.length;
        const cellStyle = function(align, isHead) {
          const st = { border: "1px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l1,#2a2d35)", padding: "4px 8px", verticalAlign: "top" };
          if (align) st.textAlign = align;
          if (isHead) {
            st.fontWeight = 700;
            st.background = "var(--dsw-alias-markdown-code-block,rgba(255,255,255,.06))";
          }
          return st;
        };
        const mkCells = function(cells, tag, keyBase, isHead) {
          const out = [];
          for (let ci = 0; ci < cols; ci++) {
            out.push(h3(tag, { key: keyBase + "c" + ci, style: cellStyle(aligns[ci], isHead) }, inlineWith(cells[ci] == null ? "" : cells[ci], keyBase + "c" + ci)));

        const tableChildren = [h3("thead", { key: tkey + "thead" }, [h3("tr", { key: tkey + "th" }, mkCells(headCells, "th", tkey + "th", true))])];

          const bodyRows = [];
          for (let ri = 0; ri < rowLines.length; ri++) {

          }
          tableChildren.push(h3("tbody", { key: tkey + "tbody" }, bodyRows));
        }
        nodes.push(h3("div", { key: tkey + "wrap", style: { overflowX: "auto", margin: "4px 0" } }, [
          h3("table", { key: tkey, style: { borderCollapse: "collapse", width: "100%", fontSize: 11, lineHeight: 1.5 } }, tableChildren)
        ]));
      };
      while (i3 < lines.length) {
        const line = lines[i3];

          const codeLines = [];
          i3++;
          while (i3 < lines.length && lines[i3].trim().indexOf("```") !== 0) {
            codeLines.push(lines[i3]);
            i3++;
          }
          if (i3 < lines.length && lines[i3].trim().indexOf("```") === 0) i3++;
          nodes.push(h3("pre", { key: "cb" + k4++, style: { margin: "4px 0", padding: "8px 10px", background: "var(--dsw-alias-markdown-code-block,rgba(255,255,255,.06))", border: "1px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l1,#2a2d35)", borderRadius: 6, overflowX: "auto", fontSize: 11, lineHeight: 1.5 } }, [
            h3("code", { style: { fontFamily: "var(--ds-font-family-code,Consolas,Menlo,monospace)", whiteSpace: "pre" } }, codeLines.join("\n"))
          ]));
          continue;
        }
        const hm = /^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/.exec(trim);
        if (hm) {
          const lv = hm[1].length;
          const sizes = { 1: 16, 2: 14, 3: 13, 4: 12, 5: 11, 6: 10 };
          const sz = sizes[lv] || 12;
          nodes.push(h3("div", { key: "h" + k4++, style: { fontSize: sz, fontWeight: 700, margin: lv <= 2 ? "6px 0 3px" : "4px 0 2px", color: "var(--dsw-alias-markdown-heading,var(--dsw-alias-label-primary,#e6edf3))", fontFamily: lv === 2 ? "var(--dsw-font-markdown-h2,var(--dsw-font-family))" : void 0 } }, inlineWith(hm[2], "h" + k4)));
          i3++;
          continue;
        }
        const hr = /^---+$/.test(trim) || /^\*\*\*+$/.test(trim);
        if (hr) {
          nodes.push(h3("hr", { key: "hr" + k4++, style: { border: "none", borderTop: "1px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l1,#2a2d35)", margin: "4px 0" } }));
          i3++;
          continue;
        }
        const q4 = /^>\s?(.*)$/.exec(trim);
        if (q4) {
          nodes.push(h3("blockquote", { key: "bq" + k4++, style: { margin: "2px 0", paddingLeft: 8, borderLeft: "3px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l1,#2a2d35)", color: "var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary,#a1a1aa)" } }, inlineWith(q4[1], "q" + k4)));
          i3++;
          continue;
        }
        const headCells = i3 + 1 < lines.length && tableHasPipe(line) ? tableCells(line) : null;
        const delimCells = i3 + 1 < lines.length ? tableDelimCells(lines[i3 + 1]) : null;
        if (headCells && delimCells && headCells.length === delimCells.length) {
          const rowLines = [];
          let ri = i3 + 2;
          while (ri < lines.length) {
            const rt = lines[ri].trim();
            if (rt === "" || !tableHasPipe(rt)) break;
            rowLines.push(lines[ri]);
            ri++;
          }
          pushTable(headCells, delimCells, rowLines);
          i3 = ri;
          continue;
        }
        const listItems = [];
        let j4 = i3;
        let isOrdered = false;
        while (j4 < lines.length) {
          const lt = lines[j4].trim();
          const taskM = MD_TASK_RE.exec(lt);
          const bullet = /^-\s+(.+)$/.exec(lt) || /^\*\s+(.+)$/.exec(lt);
          const ordered = /^(\d+)\.\s+(.+)$/.exec(lt);
          if (taskM) {
            listItems.push({ task: taskM[1], text: taskM[2] });
            j4++;
            continue;
          }
          if (bullet) {
            listItems.push({ task: null, text: bullet[1] });
            j4++;
            continue;
          }
          if (ordered) {
            listItems.push({ task: null, text: ordered[2] });
            isOrdered = true;
            j4++;
            continue;
          }
          break;
        }
        if (listItems.length) {
          pushList(listItems, isOrdered);
          i3 = j4;
          continue;
        }
        if (trim === "") {
          i3++;
          continue;
        }
        nodes.push(h3("div", { key: "p" + k4++, style: { margin: "1px 0" } }, inlineWith(line, "p" + k4)));
        i3++;
      }
      if (o3.single) return nodes[0] || null;
      return nodes;
    };
    const tStatus = function(t3) {
      if (t3.state === "CLOSED") return { key: "done", color: "#3fb950", icon: "check" };
      if (t3.progress === null || t3.progress === void 0 || t3.progress <= 0) return { key: "todo", color: "#8b8b95", icon: "dot" };
      if (t3.progress >= 100) return { key: "accept", color: "#f59e0b", icon: "alert" };
      if (t3.progress >= 95) return { key: "confirm", color: "#f59e0b", icon: "alert" };

    function ticketFactsContextOf(rows, env) {
      const openByNumber = {};
      const blockerStates = {};

      const cardIdByNumber = {};

        titleByNumber[key] = text(row.title);
        if (cardIdByNumber[key] === void 0) {
          cardIdByNumber[key] = rowCardIdOf(env.cardIdPrefix, key, text(row.key) || key);
        }
      }

          if (!key) continue;

          else if (state === CLOSED_STATE && blockerStates[key] !== "open") blockerStates[key] = "closed";
          const refTitle = text(ref && ref.title);
          if (refTitle && !titleByNumber[key]) titleByNumber[key] = refTitle;
        }
      }
      for (const row of rows) {
        const number = ticketNumberOf(row);
        if (number === null) continue;
        if (ticketCardStatusOf(row, openByNumber, blockerStates) !== "blocked") continue;
        const primary = primaryBlockerNumberOf(row, openByNumber, blockerStates);
        if (!primary) continue;
        const blockedKey = String(number);
        const previous = firstBlockedByBlocker[primary];
        if (previous === void 0) {
          firstBlockedByBlocker[primary] = blockedKey;
          continue;
        }
        if (parseInt(blockedKey, 10) < parseInt(previous, 10)) firstBlockedByBlocker[primary] = blockedKey;
      }
      return {
        cardIdPrefix: env.cardIdPrefix,
        colorOf: env.colorOf || null,
        actionOf: env.actionOf,
        textOf: env.textOf,
        openByNumber,
        blockerStates,
        titleByNumber,
        cardIdByNumber,
        firstBlockedByBlocker
      };
    }
    function primaryBlockerNumberOf(row, openByNumber, blockerStates) {
      let best = "";

        if (!best || parseInt(blockerNo, 10) < parseInt(best, 10)) best = blockerNo;

    }

    function ticketCardFactsOf(row, ctx2) {

    const STATUS_RANK = { doing: 0, ready: 1, blocked: 2, closed: 3 };
    function numberOrLast(facts) {

    }
    function blockerNumberOrLast(facts) {
      if (!facts.blockedBy) return Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
      const parsed = Number(String(facts.blockedBy.no).replace(/^#/, ""));
      return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    }
    function compareWithinSection(left, right) {
      const byNumber = numberOrLast(left) - numberOrLast(right);
      if (byNumber !== 0) return byNumber;
      if (left.rowKey !== right.rowKey) return left.rowKey < right.rowKey ? -1 : 1;
      if (left.title !== right.title) return left.title < right.title ? -1 : 1;
      return 0;
    }
    function compareForOpenPlacement(left, right) {
      const byRank = STATUS_RANK[left.status] - STATUS_RANK[right.status];
      if (byRank !== 0) return byRank;
      if (left.status === "blocked" && right.status === "blocked") {
        const byBlocker = blockerNumberOrLast(left) - blockerNumberOrLast(right);
        if (byBlocker !== 0) return byBlocker;
      }
      return compareWithinSection(left, right);
    }
    function orderOpenTickets(facts) {
      const open = facts.filter(function(one) {
        return one.status !== "closed";
      });
      return open.sort(compareForOpenPlacement);
    }
    function closedStampOf(facts) {

    }
    function orderClosedTickets(facts) {
      const closed = facts.filter(function(one) {
        return one.status === "closed";
      });
      return closed.sort(function(left, right) {
        const byStamp = closedStampOf(right) - closedStampOf(left);
        if (byStamp !== 0) return byStamp;
        return compareWithinSection(left, right);
      });
    }
    function orderTicketBoard(facts) {

    function boardCountsOf(facts) {
      const counts = { total: 0, closed: 0, ready: 0, doing: 0, blocked: 0 };
      for (const one of facts) {
        counts.total += 1;
        if (one.status === "closed") counts.closed += 1;
        else if (one.status === "ready") counts.ready += 1;
        else if (one.status === "doing") counts.doing += 1;
        else counts.blocked += 1;
      }
      return counts;
    }

        state: "ready",
        source: "snapshot",

        missing: 0,
        failedMessage: "",

    function charWidthOf(font) {

    function fitFlowLabels(root) {

    const issueDetailFoldLadderOf = function(data) {
      const d3 = data || {};
      const ladder = {
        back: String(d3.back || ""),
        crumb: String(d3.crumb || ""),
        snapshot: String(d3.snapshot || ""),
        primary: String(d3.primary || ""),
        newSession: String(d3.newSession || ""),
        steps: []
      };
      const push = function(el, n2) {
        for (let i3 = 1; i3 <= n2; i3++) ladder.steps.push({ el, n: i3 });
      };
      push("back", ladder.back.length);
      push("crumb", ladder.crumb.length);
      push("snapshot", ladder.snapshot.length);
      push("primary", ladder.primary.length);
      push("newSession", ladder.newSession.length);
      return ladder;
    };
    const issueDetailFoldStateAt = function(ladder, tier) {
      const l3 = ladder || { back: "", crumb: "", snapshot: "", primary: "", newSession: "", steps: [] };
      const steps = Array.isArray(l3.steps) ? l3.steps : [];
      const n2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.floor(Number(tier) || 0), steps.length));
      const dropped = { back: 0, crumb: 0, snapshot: 0, primary: 0, newSession: 0 };
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < n2; i3++) {
        const s3 = steps[i3];
        if (s3.el === "back" || s3.el === "crumb" || s3.el === "snapshot" || s3.el === "primary" || s3.el === "newSession") dropped[s3.el] = s3.n;
      }
      const cut = function(text2, drop) {
        return String(text2 || "").slice(0, Math.max(0, String(text2 || "").length - drop));
      };
      return {
        tier: n2,
        back: cut(l3.back, dropped.back),
        crumb: cut(l3.crumb, dropped.crumb),
        snapshot: cut(l3.snapshot, dropped.snapshot),
        primary: cut(l3.primary, dropped.primary),
        newSession: cut(l3.newSession, dropped.newSession)
      };
    };
    const useIssueDetailFold = function(st, issueNumber, issueEffort) {
      const topBarRef = React.useRef(null);
      React.useEffect(function() {
        const applyDetailFold = function() {
          const bar = topBarRef.current;
          if (!bar || typeof document === "undefined") return;
          const q4 = function(sel) {
            try {
              return bar.querySelector(sel);
            } catch (e3) {
              return null;
            }
          };
          const backEl = q4("[data-detail-back-text]");
          const crumbEl = q4("[data-detail-crumb]");
          const snapEl = q4("[data-detail-snapshot]");
          const primEl = q4("[data-detail-primary-text]");
          const newEl = q4("[data-detail-new-text]");
          const items = [backEl, crumbEl, snapEl, primEl, newEl].filter(function(x4) {
            return !!x4;
          });
          if (!items.length) return;
          items.forEach(function(el) {
            try {
              const full = el.getAttribute("data-full");
              if (full !== null && full !== void 0) el.textContent = full;
            } catch (e3) {
            }
          });
          let ladder = null;
          try {
            if (typeof issueDetailFoldLadderOf === "function") {
              ladder = issueDetailFoldLadderOf({
                back: backEl ? backEl.getAttribute("data-full") || "" : "",
                crumb: crumbEl ? crumbEl.getAttribute("data-full") || "" : "",
                snapshot: snapEl ? snapEl.getAttribute("data-full") || "" : "",
                primary: primEl ? primEl.getAttribute("data-full") || "" : "",
                newSession: newEl ? newEl.getAttribute("data-full") || "" : ""
              });
            }
          } catch (e3) {
            ladder = null;
          }
          const fits = function() {
            try {
              return bar.scrollWidth <= bar.clientWidth + 1;
            } catch (e3) {
              return true;
            }
          };
          if (fits()) return;
          if (ladder && typeof issueDetailFoldStateAt === "function") {
            for (let t3 = 1; t3 <= ladder.steps.length; t3++) {
              let cur = null;
              try {
                cur = issueDetailFoldStateAt(ladder, t3);
              } catch (e3) {
                break;
              }
              try {
                if (backEl) backEl.textContent = cur.back;
                if (crumbEl) crumbEl.textContent = cur.crumb;
                if (snapEl) snapEl.textContent = cur.snapshot;
                if (primEl) primEl.textContent = cur.primary;
                if (newEl) newEl.textContent = cur.newSession;
              } catch (e22) {
                break;
              }
              try {
                void bar.offsetWidth;
              } catch (e3) {
              }
              if (fits()) return;
            }
            return;
          }
          const els = [backEl, crumbEl, snapEl, primEl, newEl].filter(function(x4) {
            return !!x4;
          });
          for (let i3 = 0; i3 < els.length; i3++) {
            while (els[i3] && els[i3].textContent && !fits()) {
              try {
                els[i3].textContent = els[i3].textContent.slice(0, -1);
              } catch (e3) {
                break;
              }
            }
            if (fits()) return;
          }
        };
        applyDetailFold();
        let ro = null;
        try {
          ro = new ResizeObserver(function() {
            applyDetailFold();
          });
          if (topBarRef.current) ro.observe(topBarRef.current);
        } catch (e3) {
        }
        const onWin = function() {
          applyDetailFold();
        };
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") window.addEventListener("resize", onWin);
        if (typeof document !== "undefined" && document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(function() {
          applyDetailFold();
        });
        return function() {
          if (ro) try {
            ro.disconnect();
          } catch (e3) {
          }
          ;
          if (typeof window !== "undefined") window.removeEventListener("resize", onWin);
        };
      }, [issueNumber, issueEffort, st.cwd, st.snapshot, st.issueDetail, st.issueMode, st.navStack]);
      return topBarRef;
    };

    const fitAllTags = function() {
      if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
      const all = document.querySelectorAll(".dsws-tags");
      const rows = [];
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < all.length; i3++) {
        const tags = all[i3];
        const more = tags.querySelector(".dsws-more");
        if (!more) continue;
        const chips = Array.prototype.slice.call(tags.querySelectorAll(".dsws-chip:not(.dsws-more):not(.dsws-blocked)"));
        for (let k4 = 0; k4 < chips.length; k4++) chips[k4].style.display = "inline-flex";
        more.style.display = "inline-flex";
        rows.push({ tags, more, chips });
      }
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < rows.length; i3++) {
        const r3 = rows[i3];
        r3.avail = r3.tags.clientWidth;
        r3.moreW = r3.more.offsetWidth;
        const widths = [];
        for (let k4 = 0; k4 < r3.chips.length; k4++) widths.push(r3.chips[k4].offsetWidth);
        r3.widths = widths;
      }
      for (let i3 = 0; i3 < rows.length; i3++) {
        const r3 = rows[i3];
        const gap = 3;
        const room = r3.avail - r3.moreW - gap;
        let used = 0, shown = 0;
        for (let k4 = 0; k4 < r3.chips.length; k4++) {
          const w4 = r3.widths[k4];
          if (used + w4 <= room || k4 === 0) {
            used += w4 + gap;
            shown++;
          } else r3.chips[k4].style.display = "none";
        }
        const hidden = r3.chips.length - shown;
        r3.more.textContent = "+" + hidden;
        r3.more.style.display = hidden > 0 ? "inline-flex" : "none";
      }
    };

          card.error = tr("panel.noRepoErr.bad-name");
          card.errorRepoUrl = "";
          emit(st);

    const useClosedPageScroll = function(st, enabled) {
      React.useEffect(function() {
        if (!enabled) return;
        try {
          loadIssuePage(st, { view: "list" });
        } catch (e3) {
        }
        if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
        const el = document.querySelector(".dsws-body");
        const bound = el && typeof el.addEventListener === "function" ? el : document;
        const onScroll = function(ev) {
          try {
            const target = ev && ev.target && ev.target.scrollHeight !== void 0 ? ev.target : document.querySelector(".dsws-body") || el;
            if (!target || target.scrollHeight === void 0) return;
            if (target.scrollTop + target.clientHeight < target.scrollHeight - 80) return;
            loadIssuePage(st, { view: "list", next: true });
          } catch (e3) {
          }
        };
        bound.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true, capture: true });
        return function() {
          try {
            bound.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { capture: true });
          } catch (e3) {
          }
        };
      }, [enabled]);
    };

        if (!doc || !doc.createElement) return null;
        const ctx2 = doc.createElement("canvas").getContext("2d");
        if (!ctx2) return null;
        let family = "";
        try {
          family = typeof getComputedStyle === "function" && doc.body ? String(getComputedStyle(doc.body).fontFamily || "") : "";
        } catch (e3) {
          family = "";
        }

        }

        if (hm) {
          const lv = Math.min(hm[1].length, 3);
          nodes.push(h4("h" + lv, { key: key() }, pxInline(hm[2], false)));
          i3 += 1;
          continue;
        }
        if (/^---+$/.test(trim) || /^\*\*\*+$/.test(trim)) {
          nodes.push(h4("hr", { key: key() }));
          i3 += 1;
          continue;
        }
        const q4 = /^>\s?(.*)$/.exec(trim);
        if (q4) {
          nodes.push(h4("blockquote", { key: key() }, pxInline(q4[1], false)));
          i3 += 1;
          continue;
        }
        if (matchListLine(line)) {
          const flat = [];
          while (i3 < lines.length) {
            const r3 = matchListLine(lines[i3]);
            if (!r3) break;
            flat.push(r3);
            i3 += 1;
          }
          renderListSeq(takeList(flat, 0, flat[0].indent).lists).forEach(function(n2) {
            nodes.push(n2);
          });
          continue;
        }
        if (trim === "") {
          i3 += 1;
          continue;
        }
        nodes.push(h4("p", { key: key() }, pxInline(line, false)));
        i3 += 1;
      }
      const ov = st && st.pixelImgOverlay && st.pixelImgOverlay.src ? st.pixelImgOverlay : null;
      return h4("div", null, [

          // 它不是按钮，用 data-press 的 other 档，表示「按下去的是个没有固定形状的东西」。
          "data-press": "other",

    const pixelFail = function(st, created, isMissing) {

    const pixelFetch = function(st, created, args, failCode, onOk) {
      pixelClearSkel();
      pixelSkelTimer = setTimeout(function() {
        const d3 = created;
        if (!d3 || !pixelAlive(st, d3) || d3.phase !== "loading") return;
        d3.showSkel = true;
        try {
          if (typeof emit === "function") emit(st);
        } catch (e3) {
        }
      }, SKILL_SKELETON_DELAY_MS);
      const t0 = Date.now();
      let pending = null;
      try {
        pending = typeof host !== "undefined" && host && typeof host.call === "function" ? host.call("skill.readDoc", args) : null;
      } catch (e3) {
        pending = null;
      }
      if (!pending || typeof pending.then !== "function") {
        pixelFail(st, created, false);
        return;
      }
      pending.then(function(res) {
        try {
          if (res && res.ok === true) log("info", "host.call", { method: "skill.readDoc", latencyMs: Date.now() - t0, ok: true, kind: "skill-doc" });
          else log("warn", "host.call.fail", { method: "skill.readDoc", kind: "skill-doc", errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(failCode), 120, "error")) });
        } catch (eL) {
        }
        const d3 = created;
        if (!d3 || !pixelAlive(st, d3)) return;
        pixelClearSkel();
        if (res && res.ok === true) {
          onOk(res);
          return;
        }
        pixelFail(st, created, true);
      }, function(e3) {
        try {
          log("warn", "host.call.fail", { method: "skill.readDoc", kind: "skill-doc", errorHash: dswsLogHash(dswsLogTrunc(String(e3 && e3.message || e3), 120, "error")) });
        } catch (eL) {
        }
        pixelFail(st, created, false);
      });
    };

        }

  var WORKSPACE_URI = "ui://zcode-mattpocock-skills-deck/workspace.json";
  async function fetchWorkspace(client) {
    if (!client || typeof client.readResource !== "function") return null;
    try {
      const r3 = await client.readResource(WORKSPACE_URI);
      const t3 = r3 && r3.contents && r3.contents[0] && r3.contents[0].text;
      return t3 ? JSON.parse(t3) : null;
    } catch (e3) {
      return null;
    }
  }
  async function fetchDeckData(client) {
    if (!client || typeof client.callTool !== "function") return null;
    try {
      const [listRes, countsRes] = await Promise.all([
        client.callTool("deck_issue_list", {}),
        client.callTool("deck_issue_counts", {})
      ]);
      const rows = listRes && listRes.structuredContent && listRes.structuredContent.rows || [];
      const counts = countsRes && countsRes.structuredContent && countsRes.structuredContent.counts || null;
      let labels = null;
      try {
        const lr = await client.callTool("deck_issue_list_labels", {});
        const sc = lr && lr.structuredContent;
        if (sc && sc.colors && typeof sc.colors === "object") {
          labels = Object.keys(sc.colors).map(function(n2) {
            return { name: String(n2), color: String(sc.colors[n2] || "").replace(/^#/, "") };
          }).filter(function(l3) {
            return l3.color !== "";
          });
        }
      } catch (e22) {
      }
      return { rows, counts, labels };
    } catch (e3) {
      if (typeof console !== "undefined" && console.warn) console.warn("[upstream] 工具数据拉取失败:", e3);
      return null;
    }
  }
  async function boot(deps) {
    const d3 = deps || {};
    const client = d3.client || null;
    clientRef = client;
    const doc = d3.doc || (typeof document !== "undefined" ? document : null);
    const workspace = d3.workspace || await fetchWorkspace(client);
    let root = d3.root || null;
    if (!root && doc && doc.createElement && doc.body) {
      root = doc.createElement("div");
      root.setAttribute("id", "dsws-surface");
      doc.body.appendChild(root);
    }
    const ctx = createSeamCtx({ client, doc, root, workspace });
    apply(ctx);
    const data = d3.deckData || (d3.fetchData === true ? await fetchDeckData(client) : null);
    if (data && showDeckDataRef) {
      try {
        showDeckDataRef({ rows: data.rows, counts: data.counts, labels: data.labels, workspaceRoot: workspace && workspace.root || "" });
      } catch (e3) {
        if (typeof console !== "undefined" && console.warn) console.warn("[upstream] ingest 接驳失败:", e3);
      }
    }
    return ctx;
  }
